gist: Standard channel disclaimer: no promotion of drugs or alcohol, content is for information and education, community guidelines followed.
Greeting and thanks to the audience for joining; says the classes are going on with their blessings.
Says many questions about Jyotish keep coming in; a garbled clause about 'which category it was put in' follows.

hindi: ज्योतिष एक ऐसा अद्भुत और मजेदार स्यापा है कि इसके दम पर आप जीवन को बड़े विचित्र तरीके से ठीक कर सकते हैं
says: He presents Jyotish as a remarkable and entertaining discipline whose practical use is that a person can set his life right in unusual ways, i.e. a corrective tool and not only a forecasting tool.
ambiguity: 'स्यापा' normally means mourning or fuss; here it is used humorously for 'business' or 'affair'.
classical_check: Classical texts present Jyotish as a vedanga that guides timing and remedies; the 'fix life' framing is consistent with the remedial tradition but is not a textual rule.

gist: Analogy: when allopathy was new many people could not accept it, and many still reject homeopathy, so a new method is always resisted.
Says people do not do what they do not know; like those who ask 'show me whether God exists', it has to be experienced, not demonstrated.
Story begins: long ago in China a lame, quarrelsome man had made so many enemies that people wherever he went threatened to kill him; no guns then, only bows and arrows.
His enemies corner him in a lane, aim an arrow and say they will kill him today; he flees limping and they laugh and say they will shoot him as he runs.
Quip that the threat would really have been in Chinese (ching mang chhang), and he is giving the Hindi translation.
The lame man was clever and ran in a zig-zag; an arrow aimed at his back missed and lodged in his leg, after which he suddenly ran straight and the enemies were amazed.
While running he noticed his body had become straight, pulled the arrow out, bled a lot, but escaped; he says acupressure was born here.

hindi: क्योंकि शरीर तो ऊर्जा को फॉलो करता है ऊर्जा बुद्धि दिमाग से पैदा पैदा होती है उस ऊर्जा के टेढ़े प्रवाह ने उसके पैर को टेढ़ा कर रखा खा था
says: Body follows energy, and that energy is generated by the intellect or brain; in the story a crooked flow of mental energy had kept the man's leg crooked. This is the first link of his chain: mind state shapes the body and, later, life events.
ambiguity: 'ऊर्जा' (energy) is used loosely for prana or mental force; no planet is named in this sentence.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; classically Moon is manas karaka and Mercury is buddhi karaka, but body-follows-energy is an Eastern-medicine style claim, so the classical texts are silent.

gist: By chance the needle-like arrow pricked one specific point and the tangled energy straightened automatically (sentence runs into the next slice line).
Once the energy was straight he walked straight; acupressure was born after this and about 700 points have now been identified where pins are pricked on different body parts.
Medical-style claim, not astrology: acupressure specialists prick the hand for a headache or the back for a stomach upset and are really setting the energy flow right.

hindi: ये ऊर्जा टेढ़ी है तो शरीर टेढ़ा चलता है क्योंकि यह ऊर्जा शरीर को दिमाग ने दी है कि टेढ़ा ही दिमाग चलेगा और टेढ़ी ऊर्जा होगी और टेढ़ी ही जिंदगी चलेगी
says: Chain of causation: a crooked brain gives crooked energy, crooked energy gives a crooked body, and in the end a crooked life. Life outcome is made to follow from the state of the mind.
ambiguity: 'टेढ़ा' (crooked) is used both literally for the body and figuratively for a troubled life.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on this causal chain; they read life events directly from houses and dashas, not through an energy intermediary.

hindi: इस दिमाग को चलाने वाले अंतरिक्ष में इतने सारे ग्रह गोल-गोल घूम रहे हैं जो अपनी-अपनी टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी पोजीशंस के टाइम अपने-अपने टेनोर पर आने के पश्चात ऐसी स्थिति पैदा कर देते हैं कि बंदे की ऐसी तैसी फिर जाए
says: The brain is driven by the planets circling in space; when each planet reaches an unfavourable position during its own tenure, it creates a situation that wrecks the person's fortunes. This is his core claim: planets drive the mind, and bad planetary periods make the mind produce crooked energy.
ambiguity: 'टेनोर' (tenure) could mean the planet's dasha period or its transit period; he does not say which.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the dasha and gochara principle that planets give results in their periods, and with Moon as ruler of mind; the strong claim that planets run the brain is a tradition claim, not a text rule.

hindi: टेढ़ी ऊर्जा के कारण उस व्यक्ति का जीवन जो सीधा चल रहा था अचानक टेढ़ा हो जाए
says: Effect side of the same claim: a life that was running smoothly can suddenly go off track when the crooked mental energy sets in, so a sudden reversal marks the start of a bad planetary phase.
ambiguity: He gives no duration or trigger; 'suddenly' is the only timing information.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea that a change of dasha or a heavy transit can reverse a person's circumstances; no specific rule is cited.

hindi: जैसे ही व ग्रह ऊपर ठीक होते हैं ऑटोमेटिक व्यक्ति के पास सीधी ऊर्जा आने लगती है यानी उसका दिमाग सीधा चलने लगता है
says: The reverse of the bad phase: once those planets become favourable, straight energy returns on its own and the person's mind starts working properly again, so recovery needs no extra effort once the planetary phase turns.
ambiguity: 'ठीक होते हैं' may mean the planets move out of the bad position, the period ends, or the planets are remedied; the caption 'ऊपर' (above) is probably 'from above, in the sky'.
classical_check: Consistent with improvement at the end of a malefic period; texts do not state it as a mind-clearing rule.

hindi: हमारी जिंदगी को कौन चला रहा है यह खोपड़ा यह खोपड़ा सही चलता है तो सब सही चलता है
says: What runs our life is the head: if the mind functions correctly, everything in life runs correctly. He places the mind as the single control point between the planets and life results.
classical_check: Classically Moon (mind) and the 5th house (buddhi) are central to judgment, but the texts do not claim the head alone controls all outcomes.

hindi: शब्द बना है विनाश काले विपरीत बुद्धि यार विनाश काले काल यानी समय का चक्र जब टेढ़ा आता है तो ये बुद्धि टेढ़ी चलती है
says: He quotes the proverb 'when ruin comes, the intellect turns perverse' and reads 'kaal' as the cycle of time: when the time cycle turns bad, the intellect itself runs crooked and the person decides badly.
ambiguity: The proverb is usually read 'at the time of destruction' (vinash kale); he reinterprets 'kaal' as the time cycle (planetary period).
classical_check: The proverb is a popular saying, not a Parashari rule; the Jyotish counterpart is a malefic dasha or transit afflicting Mercury, Moon or the 5th house.

hindi: इसीलिए साक्षी भाव बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट है हर समय यह जानते रहे कि यार खोपड़ी में चल क्या रहा है
says: Advice: keep a witness attitude at all times, constantly watching what is going on in your own head, so that you can catch the crooked-mind effect of a bad phase before acting on it.
classical_check: A meditation-tradition (sakshi bhava) practice, not a prescribed Jyotish remedy; classical remedies are mantra, daan, gemstones and worship.

hindi: कहीं ऐसा तो नहीं मंगल राहु केतु शनि ने हमारे दिमाग को कंकर कर लिया है और हम एक यंत्र की भाति गलती कर रहे हैं
says: Ask yourself whether Mars, Rahu, Ketu or Saturn have taken control of your mind and you are making mistakes like a machine. He names these four malefic planets as the ones that most commonly hijack judgment.
cells_derived_method: Mind is read from the 1st (self), 4th (peace of mind), 5th (intellect) and the Moon. A malefic from this list sitting in or aspecting those houses, or joining the Moon or Mercury, distorts judgment more. The sign it sits in colours how: own or exalted sign gives disciplined rather than careless error, debilitation or a shadow planet's confusing sign gives impulsive or deluded error.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 5th house in Sagittarius (lagna Leo) can distort intellect with over-confident beliefs or doctrinal mistakes, because Sagittarius is a belief and teaching sign and the 5th is buddhi.

Derived: Saturn in the 4th house in its own sign Capricorn (lagna Libra) makes the mind heavy, serious and slow rather than careless, so the error is over-caution and low mood, not impulsive mistakes.
Derived: Mars in the 1st house in Cancer, its debilitation sign (lagna Cancer), points to an impulsive, emotion-driven mind that acts first and regrets later.
Derived: Ketu in the 12th house in Pisces (lagna Aries) pulls the mind into withdrawal and escapism, so the mistake is neglect and drifting, not aggressive error.

ambiguity: 'कंकर' is a garbled caption, most likely 'capture' (कैप्चर); Venus and Mercury are not named as hijackers here.
classical_check: Mars, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu are classically the natural malefics (krura grahas) and Rahu/Ketu are linked to confusion; the 'machine-like error' wording is his own.

hindi: गलती करने के पश्चात हर व्यक्ति कहता है अरे मैं थोड़ी करना चाहता हूं लोग कहते हैं यह व्यक्ति ऐसा नहीं है जो कर डाला
says: Evidence he offers: after a blunder people say they never wanted to do it and others say 'this person is not like that', which he reads as a sign that something outside the person's will was driving the act.
ambiguity: This is an everyday observation used as support; it does not itself name a planet or a rule.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on this argument; the nearest idea is graha-driven buddhi-bhramsha during a malefic period.

hindi: अरे ये व्यक्ति तो चौथी फेल है ये इतना ऊंचा कैसे उठ गया भैया सितारे बुलंद है इसके
says: When a person who failed 4th class rises very high, the explanation is that his stars are strong: success need not come from education or intelligence but from planetary strength.
ambiguity: 'सितारे बुलंद' means a strong fortune; he does not say which planets or houses.
classical_check: Consistent with classical rajayoga and dhana yoga giving success independent of schooling; no specific yoga is named.

hindi: अरे बड़ा बुद्धिमान था सितारे गर्दिश में है
says: The mirror case: a very intelligent person can fail or struggle because his stars are in adversity, so intelligence alone does not guarantee results when the planetary period is bad.
ambiguity: The sentence starts in the 4:06 line and its verb ends in the 5:02 line; no planet or house is named.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical view that a weak or afflicted dasha lord can suppress even a good intellect; no text is cited.

hindi: ये जो सितारे हैं यही हमारे ज्योतिष शास्त्र में सूर्य चंद्र मंगल बुध बृहस्पति राहु केतु है
says: He identifies the 'stars' he keeps mentioning with the Jyotish planets: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Rahu and Ketu. Venus and Saturn are not named in this list.
ambiguity: Venus and Saturn are missing from the spoken list, probably a slip or a caption drop since Saturn was named a moment earlier; the three outer planets he uses elsewhere are also not named here.
classical_check: The classical navagraha list also includes Venus and Saturn; the omission looks accidental, not a different theory.

hindi: जो आपके जीवन के ऊपर ऐसी किरणें फेंक के रखते हैं कि आप सारी जिंदगी दरिद्र रहते हैं या बहुत कंगाल रहते हैं या परेशान रहते हैं प्रेम नहीं मिलता
says: The planets keep throwing rays on your life that can leave you poor, penniless, troubled or without love for an entire lifetime, so poverty and lack of love are attributed to planetary influence.
ambiguity: No planet-wise or house-wise split is given; 'rays' is used loosely for planetary influence.
classical_check: Consistent with classical daridra yoga and afflictions to the 2nd, 5th and 7th houses, but he cites none.

hindi: या फ्री फंड में धन मिल जाता है फ्री फंड में मकान बन जाते हैं
says: The same planetary rays can also give money without effort and houses that get built almost free, so unearned gains are also attributed to planets and not to hard work.
ambiguity: No specific yoga or house is given; classically windfall wealth is linked to the 8th, 11th and 4th houses.
classical_check: Consistent with classical windfall and inheritance indications (8th house, 11th house, 4th for property), though he names none.

gist: Lists the lay explanations people give for someone's fortune: hard work, God's grace, a hill-temple baba's blessing, or an inheritance from the father.

hindi: यह जितना मर्जी बातें हम कर ले यह सारी की सारी सितारों से लिंक है हम इसे माने ना माने कोई फर्क नहीं है
says: Whatever explanation people prefer, all of them are ultimately tied to the stars, and whether you believe in it makes no difference to the planets working on you.
classical_check: Consistent with the karma and graha doctrine that planets indicate the fruit of past action; the claim that effort and grace are 'all linked' to stars is his emphasis.

gist: Aspirin analogy: a headache goes after the tablet whether or not you believe in it, so Jyotish works whether or not you believe; repeats the previous point.

hindi: इन्हीं ग्रहों ने राम को वनवास कराया कृष्ण को जेल में पैदा कराया यही रावण को मरवाते हैं यही प्रधानमंत्री बनाते हैं यही पद से नीचे डालते हैं
says: He credits the planets with Rama's exile, Krishna's birth in prison, Ravana's death, and with both making a prime minister and removing a person from office, i.e. the same planets rule the rise and fall of status even for avatars.
ambiguity: The mention of Ravana's death is a mythological reference, not a prediction; classical sources do give Rama and Krishna charts but he cites none here.
classical_check: Classical texts and later commentaries do erect charts for Rama and Krishna; the statement that planets caused the events is traditional, not a specific rule.

gist: Starts 'if we understand the movement of these planets', then breaks off into the remark (next slice line) that understanding it is a heavy task needing stubborn persistence; the consequence is never stated.
People who do something big think big and keep working at it continuously; 'we do not manage that', a motivational aside.
Analogy of a housewife who chats while cooking quickly because she is a specialist; likewise an expert astrologer reads your life at a glance.
Says gaining knowledge in life needs a kind of madness, a decision that 'now I will learn'.
The old habitual mind will say 'leave it, I am old, children are studying, who gets into these cycles'; he warns against listening to it.

hindi: याद रखिए जिसने यह जीवन की कला सीख ली उसके जीवन के अंदर ऑटोमेटिक यहां से मौज आती है अपने आप साक्षी भावन होता है
says: Whoever learns this art of living gets joy in life automatically and a witness attitude arises in him by itself, so he presents learning Jyotish as a source of contentment.
ambiguity: 'यह जीवन की कला' (this art of life) most likely means Jyotish, but could mean the wider knowledge and self-observation he has been describing.
classical_check: Not a classical claim; it is a benefit he asserts for students of the subject.

gist: Fragment 'and one more fun thing, there are such planets that...' is cut off at the end of this slice; the sentence continues in the next slice.

hindi: तत्पर हैं ऊपर से कोई किरणें फेंक रहे हैं कि भैया सीख जा बच्चे तू मेरा बच्चा ही तो है मैं तुझे सिखाना चाहता हूं
says: Completing the last line of the previous slice: there are planets that are eager to teach and keep sending rays from above that say 'learn, child, you are my child, I want to teach you'. So certain planets are said to actively push a person toward learning.
ambiguity: He does not say which planets are the teaching ones; the sentence started at the end of the previous slice ('such planets exist that...').
classical_check: Jupiter (guru, karaka of knowledge) and Mercury (learning) are the classical teaching planets, but he names none here; the picture of rays that coax you to learn is his own.

gist: Says we do not want to learn and that our real affliction (klesh) is this unwillingness to learn, a general remark about human resistance.

hindi: और हम उन्हीं ग्रहों के कारण आलसी भी बने क्रोधी भी बने
says: The same planets are also the reason we became lazy and became angry, so character faults such as laziness and anger are put down to planetary influence and not to the person's own choice.
ambiguity: No planet is named for laziness or anger; the sentence refers back to 'those planets' of the previous lines.
classical_check: Classically laziness is linked to Saturn and anger to Mars (and Sun, Rahu), but he names no planet in this sentence.

hindi: अगर आप यह जानकारी लेंगे साक्षी भाव रखेंगे प्लेनेट को समझेंगे तो आपका जीवन आप बदल सकते हो
says: Advice with a promise: if you take up this knowledge, keep a witness attitude and understand the planets, you can change your own life. The change is attributed to awareness plus understanding, not to a ritual.
ambiguity: He gives no step-by-step method for how understanding the planets changes outcomes.
classical_check: Self-awareness is not a classical remedy; the classical remedies are mantra, daan, puja and gemstones, though the idea of free will modifying karma is discussed in the commentaries.

gist: Voices the audience objection 'I am 50 or 60 now, who will change at this age' and brushes it off with 'never mind'.
Bank analogy: money deposited on the 10th is still there when you wake on the 11th (the amounts in the caption are garbled, '00' and '20'), so what you build is not lost.

hindi: ऐसे इस जन्म में मर जाओगे ना जब अगले जन्म में जब पैदा होगे वही बैंक बैलेंस लेकर मिलेगा
says: Extending the bank image to rebirth: when this life ends and you are born again, you get the same balance, so the knowledge and merit built in this life carry into the next birth.
ambiguity: 'वही बैंक बैलेंस' is a metaphor, most likely for knowledge and karmic merit; the exact thing carried over is not stated.
classical_check: Carrying over of samskara and karma is classical doctrine (the 5th and 9th houses are read for past-life merit), but the balance image is his own; the remark is general and gives no date.

gist: Concludes that there is no age limit for gaining knowledge.

hindi: जब ज्ञान आ गया कोई पोर्टल खुल गया बटन खुल गया अचानक एक्यूप्रेशर की तरह एक ऐसा ऊर्जा का प्रवाह खुल जाएगा
says: Knowledge arrives all at once: like a portal or switch opening, or like the acupressure release in his earlier story, a flow of energy suddenly opens and understanding comes without gradual build-up.
ambiguity: It is a motivational image about learning, not a chart rule; the trigger for the 'opening' is not given.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; the nearest idea is sudden insight in a Jupiter or Rahu period, which he does not mention.

hindi: शायद पिछले जन्म में भी आप ज्ञानी हो जान हो ज्योतिषी हो वास्तु शास्त्री हो कौन जानता है
says: Speculation that in a past life you may have been a learned person, an astrologer or a vastu expert, which would explain why knowledge can open so suddenly in this life. He says 'who knows', so it is a guess, not a rule.
ambiguity: 'शायद' (maybe) and 'कौन जानता है' (who knows) mark this as a guess; the sentence runs across the 8:00 timestamp.
classical_check: Classical texts read past-life merit (purva punya) from the 5th and 9th houses; he gives no chart rule here.

gist: Says knowledge will open suddenly and you will not even notice when you became knowledgeable; repeats the previous portal image.
Repeats that if we absorb these planet matters we can change our whole life, the same promise already given a minute earlier.
Announces that today the topic is planets and their signs.

hindi: अब हमारे पास यह खाका बना होता है इसमें 12 खाने हैं 12 खाने क्योंकि 12 ही राशियां है
says: The chart diagram has 12 boxes, one for each of the 12 signs; the box count is 12 because the zodiac has 12 rashis.
ambiguity: He uses 'खाना' (box) for what later behaves as a fixed house, so it is unclear whether a box means a house or a sign in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that the rasi chart has 12 divisions; in the North Indian style the boxes are houses and in the South Indian style they are signs, and he blends the two.

hindi: सूरज देवता 12 राशि गोलगोल घूमते हैं 360 डिग्री एक पूरे के पूरे अंतरिक्ष में जो गोला है हर गोला 360 डिग्री का है इससे ऊपर होता ही नहीं है
says: The Sun goes around through the 12 signs, and the full circle of space is 360 degrees; no circle is more than 360 degrees, so the whole zodiac is one complete 360-degree ring.
ambiguity: He does not say whether the Sun's round is the yearly path or the daily apparent path; the next lines treat it as a daily path.
classical_check: Agrees: the ecliptic is 360 degrees, and the Sun's apparent annual path covers the 12 signs.

hindi: अब ये हर एक 3030 डिग्री का कहानी कहता है कि भैया हर कोई 30 डिग्री का बना हुआ है
says: Each of the 12 divisions is 30 degrees, so every sign (and the space of every box) is built from exactly 30 degrees of the 360-degree circle.
ambiguity: The caption '3030' stands for 'thirty, thirty' (30 each); the sentence that follows is garbled and also mentions 30 degrees per division.
classical_check: Agrees: 360 divided by 12 gives 30 degrees per sign.

hindi: भाव फिक्स है यह फिक्स है कि यह कमरा ड्राइंग रूम है वो फिक्स है ये टॉयलेट है यह फिक्स है वो किचन है ये फिक्स है इसलिए इसी तरह से यह खाने फिक्स है
says: Recalling the previous class, he says the houses (bhava) are fixed in meaning like the rooms of a home: this room is always the drawing room, that one the toilet, that one the kitchen; in the same way each chart box has a permanent meaning whichever sign sits in it.
cells_derived_method: The house topic stays the same in every chart (the room), while the sign in it changes the flavour: house topic x sign nature x occupant planet nature. So the 4th box is always home and mother, the 10th always work and status, the 7th always partner; the sign only colours how that room behaves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 4th box is always the home and mother room; with Cancer in it (lagna Aries) the Moon-ruled sign colours it with emotional attachment to home and family.
Derived: the 10th box is always the work and status room; with Libra in it (lagna Capricorn) the room carries Venus-type diplomacy, balance and partnership into career.
Derived: the 7th box is always the partner room; with Aries in it (lagna Libra) the room has an assertive, independent, Mars-type flavour in partnerships.

ambiguity: The preceding fragment 'और 30 30 डिग्री के हर ग्रह के भाव में' is garbled; 'खाना' may mean house or sign box.
classical_check: Agrees that each bhava has a fixed signification (1 self, 4 home, 7 spouse, 10 career and so on); the room analogy is his.

hindi: लेकिन यह सिर ही है यह पेट ही है यह पैर ही है यह छाती ही है यह फिक्स है
says: The chart boxes also map onto fixed body parts: one box is always the head, others the stomach, the feet and the chest. Whatever has happened to the part (an injury, or being fine), the box still stands for that same part.
cells_derived_method: Body area follows the house (kalapurusha order: 1 head, 4 chest, 5 stomach or upper abdomen, 12 feet) and is further marked by the sign in it, since signs also map to the same body order from Aries (head) to Pisces (feet). A house and sign that agree on the same body area mark it doubly. The sentence names no house numbers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 1st box is the head; with Aries in it (lagna Aries) the head is doubly marked, since Aries also stands for the head in the natural zodiac.
Derived: the 12th box is the feet; with Pisces in it (lagna Aries) the feet are doubly marked, since Pisces stands for the feet in the natural zodiac.
Derived: the 4th box is the chest; with Leo in it (lagna Taurus) the heart region joins the chest theme, as Leo stands for the heart in the natural zodiac.

ambiguity: He says which parts but not which box matches which part; the opening 'यह मेरा सिराय सिरी है' is garbled and the sentence runs across the 9:04 timestamp.
classical_check: Agrees with the Kalapurusha body mapping; he gives no house numbers, so the numbers in the derived examples come from the classical scheme.

hindi: आपके सूरज देवता गोला गोला गोला गोला करके घूमते रहते हैं धरती गोल गल घूम रही है उसके अनुसार यह भाव में सूरज अलग-अलग जगह घूमता रहता है
says: Because the earth rotates, the Sun appears to circle round and so keeps moving to different places among the fixed houses; the boxes stay put while the Sun travels through them during the day.
ambiguity: He calls the Sun's daily apparent circuit its movement through the houses; he mixes the Sun's own motion with the earth's rotation.
classical_check: Astronomically correct for apparent daily motion; classical texts use the same idea to define lagna and the bhava points.

gist: Analogy of an uncle who sits in the drawing room, goes to the toilet, then the kitchen, then the bedroom to sleep: rooms are fixed, the occupant moves, as planets and signs move through the houses.

hindi: यह एक नंबर राशि यहां इसलिए क्योंकि जिस समय आप पैदा हुए उस समय सूरज देवता अपने खास टाइम पर किसी एक खास राशि में थे
says: At birth, the sign that stands in the first box of the chart is there because of where the Sun was at the exact time of birth: the birth time and the Sun's position decide which sign occupies the first house.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's house depends on the time of birth relative to sunrise: it is in the 1st house at sunrise and moves back one house about every two hours after that (12th, 11th, and so on), so the same date gives a different lagna and a different house for the Sun at different hours. Before sunrise it is in the 2nd, 3rd and later houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: born about two hours after sunrise in the month when the Sun is in Aries, the Sun is in the 12th house in Aries (lagna Taurus): the Sun is exalted but sits in the house of loss and withdrawal.
Derived: born about four hours after sunrise in the same month, the Sun is in the 11th house in Aries (lagna Gemini): an exalted Sun in the house of gains and networks.
Derived: born about two hours before sunrise in the month when the Sun is in Libra, the Sun is in the 2nd house in Libra (lagna Virgo): a debilitated Sun in the house of family and speech.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर की राशि' (the number-1 sign) means the sign standing in the first box (the lagna), not necessarily Aries; he also ignores the birth place, which matters for the rising sign.
classical_check: Agrees that lagna is the sign rising at birth and depends on birth time (the sunrise lagna equals the Sun's sign); he leaves out that latitude and longitude also matter.

hindi: यह यूनिवर्स लॉ है कि जैसे ही सुबह सुबह का टाइम होगा उस समय सूरज यहां होगा मान लो सुबह सुबह का टाइम 6:00 बजे का है
says: A universal law: at early morning, around sunrise (say 6:00 a.m.), the Sun stands at the first-house point of the chart, so a sunrise birth always has the Sun in the first house.
cells_derived_method: At sunrise the Sun is on the ascendant, so the Sun's sign equals the lagna sign, and the sign changes with the month (about one sign a month). The sunrise Sun is therefore in house 1 in whichever sign it is transiting that month, and its dignity in that sign colours the self-house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a sunrise birth in about mid-April to mid-May has the Sun in the 1st house in Aries (lagna Aries); the Sun is exalted in the self-house, which classically gives vitality and confidence.

Derived: a sunrise birth in about mid-October to mid-November has the Sun in the 1st house in Libra (lagna Libra); the Sun is debilitated there, so authority and ego themes are weaker in the self-house.

ambiguity: The 'यहां' (here) is a pointing gesture; the house is inferred from 'morning' and from the later lines, not spoken as a number.
classical_check: Agrees: at sunrise the Sun is on the eastern horizon, in the lagna sign and the 1st house.

hindi: 6:00 बजे सूरज उदय है किसी समय 5:30 है कभी हो सकता है 6:30 क्योंकि मौसम बदलना है तो सूरज आगे पीछे होता है
says: Sunrise is not always at 6:00; it can be 5:30 or 6:30 as the seasons change, so the Sun's rising time shifts earlier or later through the year while the rule that it rises in the first house stays the same.
ambiguity: The times are examples; the real shift depends on the latitude and is larger than half an hour away from the equator.
classical_check: Agrees: sunrise time varies with season and latitude, and classical Jyotish uses actual local sunrise as the day boundary.

hindi: तो सूरज देवता यहां होते हैं सुबह चाहे कोई भी राशि हो एक नंबर दो नंबर चार नंबर भाव यही है मतलब भाव में तो फिक्स है यही आएगा
says: In the morning the Sun is at the first-house point whichever sign it is in (sign number 1, 2, 4 and so on): the house is fixed, only the sign changes, so house position is a fixed fact of time of day while the sign depends on the month.
cells_derived_method: With the house fixed at 1 for a sunrise birth, the reading changes only through the sign: Sun in a fire sign gives open, commanding self-expression; in an earth sign, steadier and practical; in an enemy sign (Saturn's signs) more restraint. Sun in its own or exalted sign is strongest, and in Libra weakest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a sunrise birth in about mid-August to mid-September puts the Sun in the 1st house in its own sign Leo (lagna Leo): a strong, regal, self-assured personality.

Derived: a sunrise birth in about mid-January to mid-February puts the Sun in the 1st house in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn), a sign of Saturn, the Sun's enemy: a reserved, serious self-image with recognition coming slowly.

ambiguity: He says 'number 1, 2, 4' for signs, meaning sign numbers (Aries 1) wherever the Sun is; 'भाव यही है' again points to a place on the diagram.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun at sunrise is always in the 1st house and only its sign changes with the month.

hindi: दोपहर को सूरज यहां आएगा 12:00 बजे 12 बजे सूरज यहां होगा यहां 6 बजे होगा शाम यहां पर सूरज शाम को होगा यहां पर आधी रात रात 12 बजे सूरज यहां होगा
says: The Sun's place follows the clock: at noon it is at one point of the chart (high), at 6 in the evening at another, and at midnight at a third; so the time of birth decides the house in which the Sun falls.
cells_derived_method: He points at the diagram, so no house numbers are in the caption. The standard positions are sunrise in the 1st, noon in the 10th, sunset in the 7th and midnight in the 4th house. The sign then depends on the month, so each time of day combines with each month to give a different (house, sign) cell for the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a noon birth in about mid-April to mid-May has the Sun in the 10th house in Aries (lagna Cancer): an exalted Sun at the top of the chart, classically strong for career, status and authority.

Derived: a sunset birth in about mid-October to mid-November has the Sun in the 7th house in Libra (lagna Aries): a debilitated Sun in the partnership house, so the ego is tested in marriage and partnerships.

Derived: a midnight birth in about mid-January to mid-February has the Sun in the 4th house in Capricorn (lagna Libra): the Sun is in a Saturn sign at the base of the chart, hinting at a reserved home life and a distant relation with the father or mother.

ambiguity: The positions are shown by pointing ('यहां'), so the house numbers are not in the caption; they are filled in from the standard diurnal scheme.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical diurnal positions: noon at the 10th house, sunset at the 7th and midnight at the 4th.

gist: Stresses that the morning rule is universal for everyone: the Sun sits in the lagna (the caption cuts the word to 'ल') in the morning, rises toward the top by noon, goes down, then goes round behind.
Completing the circle on the diagram: here is the noon Sun, here the midnight Sun, here the 6 o'clock Sun, and the in-between times lie between them.

hindi: तो 24 घंटे में 12 राशि में घूमेगा तो क्या बैठे हर दो घंटे में एक राशि घूम रहा है लगभग दो घंटे कभी हो सकता है कुछ टाइम पीछे होगा कभी दो घंटे से थोड़ा ऊपर होगा
says: In 24 hours the circle passes through all 12 signs, so about one sign every two hours, sometimes a little less and sometimes a little more than two hours. In other words the lagna changes roughly every two hours.
cells_derived_method: The 2-hour average hides unequal rising times: at northern latitudes some signs rise fast and others slowly, so the width of the birth-time window for a given lagna differs by sign. A short-window lagna needs more accurate birth time to be certain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: at northern latitudes such as Delhi the sidereal Aries lagna lasts noticeably less than two hours, so a small error in birth time can move the lagna out of Aries sooner.
Derived: at the same latitudes the sidereal Virgo lagna lasts noticeably more than two hours, so the Virgo lagna holds across a longer window of birth time.

ambiguity: He describes it as the Sun moving through the 12 signs in 24 hours; what really changes every two hours is the rising sign (lagna), not the Sun's sign.
classical_check: Agrees on the two-hour average per lagna; the exact rising time varies by sign and latitude, and he states this variation himself ('a bit less, a bit more').

hindi: क्योंकि सूरज ऐसे गोल नहीं घूमता यह बनाने के लिए टू डायमेंशन में ऐसे ही बन सकता है थ्री डायमेंशन में वो ऐसे नहीं घूम रहा है गोल एग्जैक्ट वो थोड़ा सा ऐसे अंडाकार घूमता है
says: The circle drawn on paper is only a two-dimensional simplification; in three dimensions the motion is not an exact circle but a slightly oval (elliptical) path, which is why the two-hour split is not exact.
ambiguity: He says the Sun moves in an ellipse and then corrects himself that it is the earth that moves around the Sun; the point about unequal timing stays the same.
classical_check: Astronomically correct: the earth's orbit is slightly elliptical; Surya Siddhanta handles the unequal motion through mean-to-true corrections.

hindi: तो मौसम भी बदलते हैं एक्सिस भी चेंज होती है और डिग्रियां भी बदलती है
says: Because of the earth's tilted and elliptical motion the seasons change, the axis orientation changes and the degrees of the divisions shift through the year, so the same clock time maps to different degrees in different months.
ambiguity: The caption is rough; 'एक्सिस' (axis) most likely refers to the earth's tilt and 'डिग्रियां' to the degrees of the rising sign, but he does not spell it out.
classical_check: Plausible reading: the rising degree at a fixed clock time changes with the season; classical texts compute it from the Sun's longitude and the sidereal time, not in these terms.

hindi: इसीलिए हमने बात की थी कि एक ही भाव में 2 डिग्री काम कर रही होती है कई बार तीन भी करती है
says: Recalling an earlier point: that is why a single house has 2 (sometimes 3) divisions working in it, so every house is touched by two or three signs and not by just one.
cells_derived_method: A house of about 30 degrees almost never matches one sign exactly: if the house spans from 15 degrees before its cusp to 15 degrees after it, it takes part of two signs (a major and a minor), and where houses are unequal it can reach three. A planet in that house then acts through both signs, weighted by the share of the house each sign covers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with the lagna at 22 degrees Aries and each house taken as 30 degrees centred on its cusp, the 1st house runs from 7 degrees Aries to 7 degrees Taurus, so Aries is the major sign (23 degrees) and Taurus the minor (7 degrees).

Derived: with the lagna at 22 degrees Aries (lagna Aries), the 7th cusp is at 22 degrees Libra, so the 7th house runs from 7 degrees Libra to 7 degrees Scorpio: Libra is the major sign and Scorpio the minor, and partnership topics carry both Venus-type and Mars-type flavour.

Derived: at high latitudes with unequal houses (Sripati or Placidus type) a house can stretch past 30 degrees and touch parts of three signs, so a planet in the 12th house in Pisces (lagna Aries) may also carry shares of Aquarius or Aries.

ambiguity: The caption says '2 डिग्री' and '3' (degrees) but he means two or three signs/divisions working in one house; this reading is inferred from the sentence he refers back to.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sripati and bhava-chalit idea that a house spans parts of two signs, but differs from the whole-sign system where one house is one sign.

hindi: ऐसा भी होता है सूरज समय अंतरिक्ष में इस प्रकार घूमता है किसी किसी समय कि जब कई कई राशि भी गायब हो जाती है बट एनीवे वो केस स्पेसिफिक है
says: Sometimes, at certain times of day, one or more whole signs can go missing from the chart (they are not seen in any house); he calls this a special case and moves on.
cells_derived_method: This happens in unequal-house systems at higher latitudes, where a sign can sit wholly inside one house and never appear at a house cusp. Planets in that sign are judged from the house they fall in, not from a cusp, so the sign's lord still acts but its sign shows no cusp.
ambiguity: 'गायब' (disappear) is not defined; it may mean intercepted signs, or signs that do not appear as a house in the box diagram.
classical_check: Matches intercepted signs in unequal-house systems at higher latitudes; in the whole-sign system no sign ever disappears.

hindi: इसी के अंतर्गत हर ग्रह सूरज के साथ-साथ घूम रहा है जैसे मान लो सूरज यहां पर है पता लगा बुध भी यहां पर है उसके साथ
says: Within this scheme every planet travels along with the Sun through the same fixed houses; for instance if the Sun is in a box, Mercury can be in the same box with it. So planets can share houses and signs, as in a conjunction.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction reading is house topic x sign nature x joint planet nature. Sun gives authority and self, Mercury gives intellect and speech, and the sign decides whether the combination is supported or strained.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Mercury in the 10th house in Capricorn (lagna Aries) joins an analytic, communicative mind to authority in the career house; Capricorn, a Saturn sign, adds discipline and structure.

Derived: Sun with Mercury in the 2nd house in Gemini (lagna Taurus) puts Mercury in its own sign in the house of speech and family wealth, so skill in speech and trade is emphasised, with the Sun adding authority to the voice.

Derived: Sun with Mercury in the 12th house in Virgo (lagna Libra) places Mercury exalted in the house of expenses, foreign lands and withdrawal, pointing to spending on learning and work away from home.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is a gesture; the sentence starts the answer to 'how will it be in a specific case', which is garbled in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury stays within about 28 degrees of the Sun, so it is always in the Sun's sign or an adjacent one, and the Sun-Mercury conjunction (budhaditya) is a common classical combination.

hindi: मान लेते हैं शुक्र है या हो सकता है शनि हो या राहु हो केतु हो
says: Other planets, Venus, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu, may equally be sitting in the same box as the Sun at that moment; any planet can be the one found together with the Sun.
ambiguity: Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are not in his list here; the list is an example and not complete.
classical_check: Agrees that any planet can join the Sun in a sign, except that Venus stays within about 47 degrees of the Sun, while Saturn, Rahu and Ketu can be anywhere.

hindi: केतु हो राहु तो हमेशा आमने सामने रहेंगे कुछ भी हो जाए
says: Rahu and Ketu are always face to face, directly opposite each other, whatever happens: wherever Rahu is, Ketu is in the exactly opposite box.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's house is 6 houses on from Rahu's (1 to 7, 2 to 8, 3 to 9 and so on) and Ketu's sign is 6 signs on from Rahu's. So the axis always links two opposite house topics, and the reading of each end is coloured by its own sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 1st house in Aries (lagna Aries) puts Ketu in the 7th house in Libra: restless self-focus and ambition with Rahu, detachment from partners with Ketu.

Derived: Rahu in the 10th house in Cancer (lagna Libra) puts Ketu in the 4th house in Capricorn: ambition for status outweighs domestic peace, with Ketu making the home life detached and Saturn-flavoured.
Derived: Rahu in the 3rd house in Leo (lagna Gemini) puts Ketu in the 9th house in Aquarius: bold self-effort and show with Rahu, detachment from fortune, dharma and father with Ketu.

ambiguity: The caption says only 'राहु' (and 'केतु हो' just before it); the word 'आमने सामने' (face to face) makes it clear he means the Rahu-Ketu pair. The lines after it are garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: the mean nodes are always exactly 180 degrees apart, in opposite signs, one house on the 1-7, 2-8 style axis.

gist: Garbled clause 'ऐसे रहोगे तो फिक्स है इस प्रकार आपका ग्रह' ('if you stay like this it is fixed, in this way your planet'); possibly says Rahu and Ketu are fixed like the houses, but this is not clear.

Lists what people want from a prediction: the child's studies, health, an injury, property being built or not, behaviour with family members, and a person's nature; sets up the next question, no rule.

hindi: यह कैसे डिसाइड होता है यह डिसाइड होता है आपकी राशियों का झाल मेेल देखकर
says: How these results are decided: by looking at the mix and combination of your signs, that is, which sign each planet sits in and how they combine, and not by planets alone.
cells_derived_method: Result = planet nature x sign nature (dignity and element) x house topic. The same planet gives very different results in different sign-house cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo) gives sound judgement, good learning and supportive results for children, since a strong planet sits in the intellect house.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo) refines the partnership house, giving a loving, accommodating spouse and warm relationships.

ambiguity: 'झाल मेल' is a garbled caption, most likely 'तालमेल' (coordination) or 'मेल-जोल' (mixing); he does not say which combinations matter.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical principle that a planet's result comes from its sign (dignity), house, lordship and conjunctions together, but he gives no formula.

hindi: आज 10 तारीख का दिन हो गया मान लो तो 10 तारीख को एक खास कुंडली बनी हुई है खास कुंडली मतलब ग्रह स्पेसिफिक स्पेसिफिक राशि में बैठे हुए हैं
says: On any given date, for example the 10th, a specific chart exists: it simply means that each planet is sitting in one particular sign, so a chart is a snapshot of the planets' sign positions at that moment.
ambiguity: He talks of the date only; the lagna also changes through the day (about every two hours) as he said earlier.
classical_check: Agrees: the rasi chart is a snapshot of sign positions at a moment, with the lagna added from the birth time and place.

hindi: उस स्पेसिफिक राशि में बैठे हुए ग्रह सारा दिन ऐसे ही रहेंगे
says: The planets sitting in those particular signs stay there all day, so on one date the sign positions of the planets do not change even though the lagna rotates.
ambiguity: 'All day' is approximate: the Moon changes sign about every 2.25 days and so can change within a day, and the Sun, Mercury and Venus change sign on ingress days.
classical_check: Approximately true for slow planets; the Moon and sometimes Mercury, Venus and the Sun can change sign during a particular day.

hindi: जैसे शनि महाराज है इन्होंने ढाई साल एक राशि में रहना है
says: Saturn stays two and a half years in one sign before moving to the next, so the sign-house position of Saturn holds for about 30 months.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn takes about 29.5 years for the zodiac, about 2.5 years per sign.

hindi: ढाई साल सूरज ने एक महीने रहना है तो सूरज हर महीने गोलगोल घूम रहा है
says: The Sun stays one month in a sign and so moves to a new sign every month, going round the zodiac continuously.
ambiguity: The words 'ढाई साल' ('two and a half years') at the start look like a slip carried over from the Saturn sentence; the meaning he intends is one month.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun spends about 30 days in each sidereal sign.

gist: Contrast: the Sun keeps going round while Saturn stays put for two and a half years in the same sign with nothing to do with the Sun's motion.

hindi: प्लूटो जैसा प्लेनेट तो 200 250 साल एक ही राशि में पड़ा हुआ है
says: A planet like Pluto remains in one sign for 200 to 250 years. He is using the slowest planet to show how some planets almost never change sign.
ambiguity: The figure looks like Pluto's full orbit (about 248 years) used as if it were its stay in one sign; the caption could also be mis-hearing the number.
classical_check: Differs: Pluto stays about 12 to 31 years in a sign, and about 248 years is its full journey round the zodiac; Pluto is not one of the classical nine grahas.

hindi: 84 साल तक तो इंद्र देवता वहीं पड़े हुए हैं
says: Indra (Uranus in his scheme) stays on in the same sign for 84 years, again an example of a very slow planet that holds one sign for a long time.
ambiguity: 84 years is the full orbit of Uranus, which he treats as the time in one sign; 'इंद्र देवता' is his name for Uranus.
classical_check: Differs: Uranus spends about 7 years in a sign, and 84 years is its full orbit; Uranus is not part of the classical nine grahas.

hindi: बृहस्पति 12 महीने पूरे साल ही य वही उस राशि में पड़ा है
says: Jupiter stays 12 months, a whole year, in the same sign before it moves on.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter takes about 12 to 13 months per sign (about 12 years round the zodiac).

hindi: यह बड़ा जबरदस्त कॉमिनेशन बनता है कौन सी राशि में क्या ग्रह है इसलिए हमें लंबे-लंबे इफेक्ट्स पड़ते हैं
says: Which planet sits in which sign makes a very powerful combination, and because slow planets stay in the sign for a long time, the effects on us are long-lasting.
cells_derived_method: The length of the effect comes from the planet's stay; the character of the effect comes from the planet-sign combination and the house it falls on for the person. A slow planet in a friendly or own sign gives a long supportive phase, in a debilitated sign a long difficult one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius in the 10th house (lagna Taurus) for about two and a half years brings a long, steady, disciplined career phase that tends to reward patient work.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 8th house (lagna Virgo) gives a long stretch of obstacles and delays in hidden, shared and inherited matters before it moves on.

ambiguity: The sentence does not say which planets or signs; the sign-planet combination is stated only as a general principle.
classical_check: Agrees with gochara theory that slow planets give long-lasting effects according to their sign and house; no formula is cited.

hindi: जो लंबे-लंबे कोर्ट केस चलते हैं 1010 साल चल रहे हैं
says: Court cases that drag on for ten years or more are cited as an example of the long effect of a slow planet sitting in one sign: the matter stays stuck as long as the planet stays there.
cells_derived_method: Litigation is classically the 6th house (with the 7th for the opponent and the 12th for losses), so a slow planet influencing those houses stretches a legal matter. The sign and planet decide whether the delay ends in victory or erosion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo) makes a legal matter drag on for years, but Saturn is strong there, so the person usually outlasts opponents.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio) gives hidden delays and heavy legal expenses, while the exalted Saturn helps endure the process.

ambiguity: '1010 साल' means '10, 10 years'; he gives no planet or house for the case.
classical_check: Classically litigation is the 6th house and delay is associated with Saturn; he names neither.

hindi: हम मकान बना रहे हैं किसी ऐसे ग्रह के इन्फ्लुएंस में बनाने लग गए भाई अगले 5 साल तक राशि नहीं बदल रहा तो पता लगा यार 5 साल हो गए
says: Example: if you start building a house while a slow planet's influence stays in one sign for the next five years, the project can stretch to five years; he adds that you may have paid a builder and the builder keeps troubling you (the sentence is cut at the end of the slice). This is an illustration of delay, not purchase or investment advice.
cells_derived_method: Property is classically the 4th house (Mars is its karaka), and delays are linked to Saturn and Rahu influencing it. The sign shows how: an earth sign gives slow but solid work, a shadow-planet in a secretive sign gives deceit or disputes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra) makes construction slow and delayed, but the finished property is solid and lasting.
Derived: Rahu in the 4th house in Scorpio (lagna Leo) points to hidden dealings, builder disputes and delays around property.

ambiguity: The example breaks off at 'अब बिल्डर' at the end of the slice; the planet and the 5-year duration are illustrative and no specific planet is named. It ties a payment to a builder to a planetary period, which is an example only.
classical_check: Classically property is the 4th house with Mars as karaka, and delays are linked to Saturn and Rahu; he names none here.

gist: Continues the builder example: the builder himself is unlucky and his project will take 10 years to finish when it should take one.

hindi: अब किस्मत ऊपर अंतरिक्ष में ढूंढती है कौन से ऐसे 50 बंदे हैं जो मेंबर बनेंगे जिनकी किस्मत फूटी है जिनको मकान नहीं देना 10 साल तक और 10 साल पहले आग लगी हुई है उन्हे
says: Destiny, working from space, searches out about 50 people who are equally unlucky and puts them into the same project as its members, people who are destined not to receive their house for 10 years. Matching bad luck gathers people into one delayed project.
ambiguity: The clause 'और 10 साल पहले आग लगी हुई है उन्हे' (and ten years earlier a fire is lit for them) is garbled and its meaning is not clear.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on destiny assembling people into a group; the nearest idea is shared collective karma, used in mundane astrology for groups and nations.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं ब्रेन की स्पीड तेज मत करो क्योंकि आप फस जाओगे
says: Advice that follows from the builder example: do not speed up your thinking and rush into a decision, because the hurry can land you in a trap during a bad planetary phase. It is a do-not about haste.
ambiguity: 'ब्रेन की स्पीड तेज मत करो' (do not speed up the brain) means do not be hasty; he does not say how long to wait.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical advice to avoid new, important undertakings in a difficult dasha or transit period; no text is cited.

hindi: आपका ब्रेन ऐसे बिल्डर के पास ले जाता है जिसका 10 साल में प्रोजेक्ट चेंज नहीं होना क्यों पता लगा किसी भारी भरकम ग्रह के अंडर है वो 10 साल तक ग्रह राशि नहीं बदल रहा
says: Your own mind is steered to a builder whose project will not move for 10 years; the reason is that the builder is under some heavy planet that will not change sign for 10 years, so everything linked to it stays stuck.
ambiguity: No planet is named; 'भारी भरकम ग्रह' (a heavy planet) most likely means a slow planet such as Saturn or an outer planet, and the ten-year stay is illustrative.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; it is his extension of the idea that slow planets give long delays, and a 10-year stay in one sign does not match any classical planet.

hindi: इसीलिए छोटे-छोटे चीज छोटे छोटे सारे काम हमारे चंद्रमा से हो जाते हैं
says: Small things and small tasks get done through our Moon; quick, everyday results are the Moon's department, while big long projects belong to slow planets.
classical_check: Agrees with the use of the Moon's quick transit (chandra gochara) for short-term results; the 'small tasks' wording is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा एक राशि में ढाई दिन रहता है
says: The Moon stays about two and a half days in one sign before moving to the next.
ambiguity: The true average is about 2.25 days (27.3 days divided by 12), so 2.5 days is a round figure.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon spends about 2 to 2.5 days in a sign.

gist: Says he spoke about the Moon's 2.5 days in the 'Dreams Part 2' class, a pointer to an earlier lecture.

hindi: तो कभी-कभी चंद्रमा आपके ऐसे किसी खास स्न पर स्थान पर होगा ऐसी राशि से इंटरेक्ट करेगा कि उन ढाई दिनों में आप छोटी सी कोई चीज मांग लेते हो ना यूं पूरी होती है
says: At times the Moon will sit at a special place for you and interact with a particular sign so that, during those two and a half days, a small thing you wish for gets fulfilled almost at once. A favourable Moon window turns small wishes into results.
cells_derived_method: Whether the window is favourable depends on the house the Moon transits for the person and the sign it is in. A Moon in a gain or comfort house in a friendly or exalted sign supports quick fulfilment, while a Moon in a hard house or a debilitated sign blocks or spoils the same wish. The wish that works follows the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon passing through the 11th house in its exalted sign Taurus (lagna Cancer) favours quick fulfilment of small wishes about gains, friends and pleasures during its 2.5 days there.
Derived: the Moon passing through the 8th house in its debilitated sign Scorpio (lagna Aries) is a poor window, where small wishes tend to be delayed and moods are turbulent.

ambiguity: 'खास स्न पर स्थान पर' is garbled ('a special place'); he does not say which place or which sign gives the result.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with chandra gochara, where the Moon's transit house (counted from the natal Moon) decides the day's results; the 'wish fulfilled' wording is his own.

gist: Everyday examples: you say you want golgappe today and golgappe arrive at home, or someone turns up with a gift.
Another example: you feel like visiting Mussoorie and meanwhile a friend phones from Mussoorie with tickets already booked.

hindi: जो चालाक लोग हैं जिन्होंने इस शास्त्र को समझा है या इस शास्त्र को समझने वाले किसी गुरु या जानकार के साथ जुड़े होते हैं वो उससे पूछ लेते हैं
says: Clever people either understand this science themselves or stay connected to a guru or knowledgeable person, and they ask that person about timing, so they use these windows deliberately instead of by luck.
ambiguity: It is practical advice to consult an expert; no method or fee is mentioned.
classical_check: Consulting a learned astrologer for muhurta and timing is long-standing practice; classical texts also advise it.

gist: Example of a man with a learned friend who tells him his house will be built in the next six months.

hindi: अब मकान बनेगा की संज्ञा को समझिए कौन से ग्रह कैसे मकान बनाते हैं आप मकान बनेगा मकान बनाना है
says: Understand what 'a house will be built' really means: different planets build different kinds of houses, so the kind of house a person gets (a hut, a flat, a bungalow) depends on which planets are doing the building.
cells_derived_method: Property is the 4th house. Which planet and sign occupy or rule it decides the type: Mars gives land and construction, Venus a comfortable decorated home, Rahu an unusual, modern or foreign-style dwelling, Saturn an old or slowly built one. The sign adds the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) favours owning land and building actively, giving a strong, self-built property.
Derived: Venus in its own sign Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) points to a comfortable, well-furnished and beautiful home.
Derived: Rahu in the 4th house in Gemini (lagna Pisces) suggests a modern, urban or unconventional dwelling such as a flat in a crowded busy area, and frequent change of home.

ambiguity: He does not name the 4th house or any planet in this sentence; the 4th house link is classical and added here as derived.
classical_check: Agrees that property is read from the 4th house with Mars as karaka; the planet-to-house-type scheme in the examples is derived.

gist: A rickshaw-puller's mindset: he would say 'Modi ji, just give me a small flat, even a jhuggi is enough', asking for very little.

hindi: अगले छ महीने में किसी खास दिन कुछ ग्रहों का कॉमिनेशन और चंद्रमा के वो ढाई दिन क्लिक किए खड़ा मकान बन गया उसका
says: On a particular day within the six months a certain combination of planets and the Moon's 2.5-day window click together and his house stands built: events happen when a slow planetary combination and the Moon's short window coincide.
cells_derived_method: The slow planets set the period when the result is possible, and the Moon's 2.5-day stay in a supportive house and sign pulls the exact date inside that period. For property, a Moon passing through the 4th house, or a sign linked to the 4th lord, is the natural trigger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries the Moon passing through the 4th house in its own sign Cancer is a natural trigger for a house or home matter to fall into place within a supportive period.
Derived: for lagna Leo the Moon passing through the 4th house in Scorpio, where it is debilitated, is a poor trigger, so a home or property matter is likely to slip to the next supportive window.

ambiguity: The 'combination of some planets' is not specified; the claim is a pattern, not a rule with named planets.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical practice of pairing the dasha with the transit trigger (gochara) for timing; the Moon as the exact-day trigger is also classical.

gist: The man phones his village saying he now has a vehicle and has put up a jhuggi house, and the villagers marvel at what he did in the city.

hindi: अब कृपा किसी ग्रह की है और वह कहते साला यहां तो बड़ा आलसी था वहां बड़ी मेहनत करी नहीं कुछ सराउंडिंग कुछ आस पड़ोस का फर्क पड़ गया
says: The man's rise is really the grace of some planet, while the villagers explain it by saying he was lazy here and must have worked hard there; he says it was not hard work but a change of surroundings and neighbourhood, so place also matters.
ambiguity: The villagers' comment is partly garbled; he attributes the change to planetary grace plus a change of place, but names no planet or house.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical role of the 4th and 12th houses and the lagna in how place changes results; no specific yoga is named.

gist: A Delhi man keeps muttering 'Canada, Canada, Canada' and 'I will build a bungalow', and the narrator jokes that he would only end up washing dishes at Pizza Hut.

hindi: अब किसी ने कह दिया बेटा अगले दो साल में तो कनेडा जाएगा जब विदेश की यात्रा होनी है बस उसकी धुन हो गई किसी समय अचानक ऐसा कुछ क्लिक हुआ
says: Someone tells the young man he will go to Canada within two years, meaning foreign travel is due; he becomes obsessed with it, and at some moment something suddenly clicks and it happens. A predicted foreign journey materialises when the mind is fixed and the timing triggers.
cells_derived_method: Foreign travel is classically read from the 12th, 9th and 3rd houses and from Rahu. The cell shows which of these carries the promise and how the sign colours it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 12th house in Aries (lagna Taurus) is a classical pull toward foreign lands and settling away from the birth place, with an urgent and ambitious flavour.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries) favours long journeys, travel for higher education or pilgrimage and gains through distant places.

ambiguity: The prediction (two years) is an example; the planet or house behind it is not named. It is a story but carries the rule that predicted travel needs a trigger.
classical_check: Classical texts read foreign travel from the 12th and 9th houses, Rahu and the dasha of their lords; he names none.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं वन पॉइंटेड रिटेंशन एक तरफा विचार फिक्स डाल के रखो
says: Advice: keep one-pointed retention, hold one single fixed thought about what you want, and do not scatter your attention until the timing opens.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish remedy; it matches the sankalpa and single-pointed focus idea in yoga and japa traditions.

hindi: वो तो जानता है किन दिनों में होगा वो तो डेट बता देगा ज्योतिष ऐसी कमाल की विद्या है इसमें डेट बताई जा सकती है
says: A real expert knows in which days the event will happen and can give the date, and he claims Jyotish is such a remarkable science that exact dates can be named for events.
ambiguity: He does not say how precise the date is or which technique is used to get it; the claim is about the science as a whole.
classical_check: Classical timing through dasha and gochara can narrow events to windows; day-exact dating is a strong claim that the texts do not guarantee.

hindi: अब वो व्यक्ति नहीं जानता लेकिन वो ऐसा किसी ढाई दिन में क्लिक करेगा कि काम हो गया जिस के अंदर पेशेंस है उसका हो गया
says: The person himself does not know the date, but the work will click in one of the Moon's 2.5-day windows and get done; the one who has patience gets it done.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next slice line ('जो ये कहेगा...' describes the impatient person).
classical_check: Consistent with Moon-based short-term timing; patience as a condition for results is his own addition.

hindi: जो ये कहेगा गोली दे रखी है छ महीने से साले कह रखा होगा होगा हो तो रहा नहीं है अब नहीं होगा गया उसकी तंद्रा टूट गई
says: The impatient person who says 'he has been fooling me for six months, it was to happen and nothing is happening, now it will not happen' loses it: his trance (tandra) is broken, so doubt and complaint before the date can ruin the result.
ambiguity: 'तंद्रा' is used for the settled, patient state of mind in which the work matures; it is not a planetary term.
classical_check: Silent in the classical texts; it is a faith and patience teaching, not a chart rule.

gist: Analogy: the body repairs itself in deep sleep, and when deep sleep is broken you start crying and beating your chest, as the impatient person does.

hindi: इसीलिए कहते हैं पूर्ण विश्वास रखो ईश्वर पे गुरुजी
says: For this reason keep complete faith in God and the guru while waiting for the timing to arrive; faith is given as the stabilising practice.
ambiguity: 'गुरुजी' is probably a form of address, though it may also mean the faith is to be placed in the guru.
classical_check: Faith in the ishta devata and guru is a standard devotional teaching; it is not a Parashari remedy.

hindi: चंद्रमा और भाव कट जैसे सोच और हमारी विचार और भाव कट होते हैं तब ये पूरी होती है चीज
says: The wish is fulfilled when the Moon and the bhava click, matching the way our thinking, ideas and feelings click; a result needs the Moon's position to match the inner thought and feeling.
ambiguity: 'भाव' can mean emotion or house, and 'कट' is probably 'क्लिक' (click); he plays on both meanings so the sentence is hard to read exactly.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; the matching of the Moon's house with the wish is his reading of chandra gochara.

hindi: सारे ही है सारे ग्रहों के 12 12 ग्रहो का कॉमिनेशन चलेगा
says: All the planets, all 12 of them, work together, so the result in a life comes from the combination of the 12 planets and not from one planet alone.
ambiguity: The caption '12 12' is doubled; the count of 12 matches his scheme of 12 planets (the nine classical ones plus Uranus, Neptune and Pluto).
classical_check: Differs from the classical nine-graha scheme; Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are modern additions he treats as full planets.

hindi: यूजुअली ज्योतिष में हर्शल नेप्चून इंद्र वरुण और यम को यूं ही छोड़ दिया जाता है क्यों वो इतना लंबा टाइम चलते हैं
says: Usually Jyotish leaves out Herschel (Uranus), Neptune and the planets he calls Indra, Varuna and Yama, because they take so long to move that astrologers ignore them; in his scheme these names are the three outer planets.
ambiguity: He gives five names for three planets: Herschel and Indra are both Uranus, Neptune is Varuna, and Yama is Pluto (as mapped in the rest of this series).
classical_check: Agrees that classical Jyotish uses only nine grahas and ignores the outer planets; the reason he gives (slow motion) is his own.

gist: Astrologers say 'leave it, what is there to discuss about them', repeating the reason for neglecting the outer planets.

hindi: लेकिन वो बड़े लंबे इंपैक्ट देते हैं
says: Despite being ignored, the outer planets give very long impacts, effects that last years or a lifetime.
ambiguity: The 'वो' (they) refers to the outer planets named in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts do not cover these planets at all, so the claim is outside them.

hindi: मान लो किसी की शादी है पूरे जन्म ही ठीक नहीं हो रही वो किसी ना किसी इन तीनों शैतान ग्रहों में से वैसे देवता है लेकिन ऐसे शैतान स्थिति में कि उसका पूरा जन्म बीत गया
says: If someone's marriage does not work out for a whole lifetime, it is due to one of these three outer planets, which are gods by name but sit in a devilish position; their long stay keeps a marriage problem stuck for life.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house. The cell tells which outer planet sits there and in which sign: Uranus gives sudden breaks or unusual unions, Neptune confusion, idealisation and deceit, Pluto intensity, control and transformation. He does not give the house number, so the 7th is the classical link added here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 7th house in Scorpio, a sign his scheme links to Uranus (lagna Taurus), suggests sudden and intense changes, breaks or an unconventional pattern in the marriage.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th house in Libra, a sign his scheme links to Neptune (lagna Aries), points to idealising the partner, blurred boundaries and disillusionment in marriage.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th house in Aquarius, a sign his scheme links to Pluto (lagna Leo), suggests control, power struggles and a marriage that goes through repeated deep change.

ambiguity: 'तीनों शैतान ग्रहों' means the three outer planets; marriage is not tied to the 7th house in his words.
classical_check: Classically a lifelong marriage problem is read from the 7th house, Venus, Jupiter and Saturn or Rahu, not from planets beyond Saturn.

hindi: साले का बिजनेस ही नहीं चला 40 साल तक उसने धक्के खाता रहा बिजनेस नहीं चला
says: A man whose business never ran for 40 years and who kept getting knocked about is given as another example of the long effect of these outer planets; the unsuccessful career is implied to be their doing.
cells_derived_method: Business and career are the 10th house (with the 7th for partnership). The outer planet's nature and the sign decide the failure pattern, whether confusion and dissolving plans, repeated destruction and rebuilding, or sudden breaks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 10th house in Pisces (lagna Gemini) gives vague goals, confusion about direction and plans that dissolve before they take shape.
Derived: Pluto in the 10th house in Scorpio (lagna Aquarius) gives repeated destruction and rebuilding of the career, power struggles and secrecy in business.

ambiguity: The sentence does not say that the outer planets caused the business failure; it follows from the marriage example and is inferred.
classical_check: Classically career failure is read from the 10th house and its lord, Saturn and the dasha; outer planets are not used.

hindi: एक ऐसी प्रॉपर्टी के डिस्प्यूट है उसका 50 साल हो गए दादाजी जी भी छोड़ गए वो अभी तक डिस्प्यूट में ही है
says: A property dispute has gone on for 50 years; even the grandfather has passed on and the matter is still in dispute, as an illustration of how slow planets can freeze a legal matter across generations.
cells_derived_method: Property is the 4th house and disputes, litigation and inheritance link to the 6th and 8th. An outer planet in the 4th pulls in family conflict that resurfaces, and the sign shows whether the problem is a clash of titles, hidden claims or confusion in documents.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 4th house in Scorpio (lagna Leo) suggests generational conflict over property with hidden claims and power fights that resurface again and again.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th house in Pisces (lagna Sagittarius) suggests unclear titles, confused papers or misplaced trust that keep ancestral property tied up.

ambiguity: The grandfather's passing is a narrative detail, not a prediction; the sentence continues into the next slice line and the planet is not named.
classical_check: Classically property disputes are read from the 4th, 6th and 8th houses; outer planets are not used.

hindi: 70-80 साल बाद कोई ग्रह राशि बदलता है तब वो डिस्प्यूट पड़ पोते लेते हैं उसका मजा तब कहीं सेटल होता है
says: After 70 to 80 years some planet finally changes sign, and only then does the dispute settle, for the great-grandsons to enjoy; the settlement waits for that slow planet's sign change.
ambiguity: No planet is named; '70-80 साल' follows his earlier figures for outer planets, which are really their full orbits; 'पड़ पोते' means great-grandsons.
classical_check: Differs: no outer planet stays 70 to 80 years in a sign (Uranus about 7 years, Neptune about 14, Pluto about 12 to 31 years), though some take that long for part of the zodiac.

hindi: यह ग्रह ऐसे दूरगामी और शीघ्र काम करने वाले फल देते हैं
says: The planets give two kinds of results: far-reaching, long-term ones from the slow planets and quick-acting, short-term ones from the fast planets.
ambiguity: The sentence is short and its two halves are not tied to named planets; the next lines tie quick results to the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that result timing follows the planet's speed: Moon and Sun for short spans, Jupiter and Saturn for long ones.

gist: Says the Moon is the foremost planet for your quick, urgent tasks, repeating the earlier point that small quick works come from the Moon.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा सबसे बड़ा शैतान ग्रह है एक महीने में ही सारी राशि बदल लेता है सारी की सारी
says: The Moon is the most mischievous planet because it changes through every sign within about one month, whereas the Sun takes a month for a single sign and a year for the full round.
ambiguity: 'शैतान' here means restless or mischievous, not evil; the comparison with the Sun is partly garbled in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon goes round the zodiac in about 27.3 days.

hindi: चंद्रमा चु च घूमता है कहते हैं ना मन कितना चंचल है
says: The Moon keeps whirling restlessly and this is why the mind is called so fickle; he links the Moon's speed to the changeable nature of the mind.
cells_derived_method: The mind's steadiness follows the Moon's sign and house: a Moon in an airy, dual sign is more restless, while a Moon in a fixed or earthy sign is steadier, and a Moon in the lagna or 4th shows the mind more openly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in the 1st house in Gemini (lagna Gemini) gives a quick, curious, talkative and restless mind that changes its focus often.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) gives a calm, steady, comfort-seeking mind that is slow to be unsettled.

ambiguity: 'चु च' is a garbled sound word, most likely meaning 'whirling'.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the karaka of mind (manas) and the restless character of the mind is classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा स्त्री ग्रह है माता के रूप में होता है इसलिए कहते हैं स्त्री बहुत चंचल है लक्ष्मी बहुत चलायमान है चंचल है
says: The Moon is a feminine planet and stands for the mother; for this reason women are traditionally called very fickle and Lakshmi (wealth) is called restless and ever-moving. This is his traditional generalisation about women and wealth, tied to the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Mother and the female side of a life are read from the Moon's house and sign: a strong Moon in its own sign or in the 4th is a settled mother-bond and steadier wealth, a weak Moon gives instability.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) gives a strong mother-bond and a settled domestic base, with steadier wealth from home matters.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries) gives emotional turbulence and a more unsettled relationship with the mother and with money.

ambiguity: The remark that women are fickle is a traditional saying he repeats; it is not a chart rule and is a stereotype.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is a feminine planet and karaka of the mother; 'Lakshmi chanchala' is a traditional saying, not a text rule, and the generalisation about women is only a saying.

hindi: शनि का नाम शनि इसलिए पढ़ा है क्योंकि उसके नाम का पूरा तत्व अर्थ है शनिचर शने शचर शन शन धीरे धीरे चलने वाला चर होता है चलने वाला शनि चर
says: Saturn gets its name from 'shanaishchara', shane-shane (slowly) plus chara (mover), meaning the slow walker; the name itself tells that Saturn is the slowly moving planet.
classical_check: Agrees: Shani comes from shanaih (slowly) and chara (moving), the traditional etymology.

gist: Colloquial teasing: 'you are a shanichar, you understand nothing' and 'are you a tubelight that lights up slowly', used to make the point about slowness.

hindi: शने शने चलने वाला तो सबसे शने चलने वाला शनि माना गया है क्योंकि वह धरती के पास है बनस्पति इसके के इंद्र वरुण यम की बात करें इसलिए शनि को ज्यादा महत्व दिया गया
says: Saturn is taken as the slowest mover among the planets close to the earth, while Indra, Varuna and Yama are farther and even slower, so Saturn was given more importance in Jyotish.
ambiguity: The word 'बनस्पति' is garbled; the argument is that Saturn is the slowest of the planets near the earth, so it was emphasised over the outer planets.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the slowest of the seven classical planets; the claim that nearness to earth is the reason is his own.

hindi: फिर वो मुन्ना को कंट्रोल करता मूल आधार को इसलिए शनि बहुत प्रमुख सारे प्रमुख हैं
says: Saturn also controls the muladhara, the root base of the body, and the 'munna', the child-like mind, which is another reason Saturn is so prominent; all the planets are prominent in their own way.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' (little boy) was used earlier for the old habitual mind; 'मूल आधार' is the muladhara chakra; the caption is rough so this reading is uncertain.
classical_check: The Saturn-muladhara link is a modern chakra-planet mapping and not in the classical Parashari texts.

hindi: आपके इस ढाई दिन के अंतर्गत जिस राशि में चंद्रमा है वैसा फल वो ढाई दिन देता है
says: For those 2.5 days the Moon gives results according to the sign it occupies: whatever the nature of that sign, that is the flavour of the Moon's results for the period.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's result in its 2.5-day stay follows the sign's nature (exaltation, debilitation, element) and is directed to the house it is in for the person. An exalted or own sign gives smooth comfort, a debilitated sign gives disturbed moods, and the house topic shows where it is felt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon in the 2nd house in its exalted sign Taurus (lagna Aries) gives 2.5 days of comfort, steady speech, good food and money matters.
Derived: the Moon in the 6th house in its debilitated sign Scorpio (lagna Gemini) gives 2.5 days of unsettled moods and irritation around work, service and daily obstacles.
Derived: the Moon in the 9th house in Pisces (lagna Cancer) gives 2.5 days with a spiritual, compassionate mood and a leaning toward prayer, advice and travel.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the house is counted from the lagna or from the natal Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the principle of reading the Moon's transit by sign and house (chandra gochara); he gives no sign-wise table.

hindi: सूर्य एक महीना जिस राशि में है वैसा फल सूर्य देता है
says: The Sun gives results for one month according to the sign it is in; the sign's nature colours the Sun's effect over the month.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's month-long effect follows the sign's relation to the Sun (own, exalted, friendly, enemy, debilitated) and the house topic it lands on for the person.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Sun in the 10th house in its exalted sign Aries (lagna Cancer) gives a month favourable to career, authority and recognition.
Derived: the Sun in the 6th house in Capricorn, Saturn's sign (lagna Leo), gives a month of controlled effort against rivals and work pressure, with discipline replacing ego.

ambiguity: As with the Moon, the house reference point (lagna or natal Moon) is not given.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical monthly reading of the Sun's transit through the signs; he gives no table.

hindi: इसी प्रकार से शनि जिस राशि में वैसे ही फल वो ढाई साल तक देता रहेगा ऑटोमेटिक
says: In the same way Saturn automatically keeps giving results according to the sign it is in for the whole two and a half years it stays there.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's 30-month result follows its dignity in the sign (own or exalted in Capricorn, Aquarius, Libra; debilitated in Aries) and the house topic it presses on, with Saturn's delays and discipline visible there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) for 30 months gives a stable, mature phase for partnerships and agreements.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) for 30 months gives a heavy phase of low energy, delay and weighty personal responsibility.

ambiguity: The sentence compares to the Moon and Sun rules above, which it uses as the pattern.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical reading of Saturn's 2.5-year transit by sign and house, which also includes the Sade Sati overlay he does not mention here.

hindi: अब आपके जीवन के इस चक्र में काल चक्र को दर्शाने वाला यह चक्र ये आपका ब्लड रिपोर्ट और एक्सरे है
says: The chart is a wheel of time (kaal chakra) for your life, and he compares it to your blood report and X-ray: a diagnostic picture of how your life's time-cycle stands, not the cause itself.
ambiguity: The comparison to a blood report and X-ray is an analogy; it does not itself make a medical claim.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view of the horoscope as a map of karma and time; the medical analogy is his own.

hindi: इस चक्र के अंतर्गत जैसे 12 भाव है वैसे ही 12 ही राशियां है जैसे 12 ग्रह हैं 12 भाव है ऐसे ही 12 राशियां यानी कि हर एक को एक-एक खाना दे दिया गया है
says: Within the chart there are 12 houses, 12 signs and 12 planets, and each has been given its own box; the three sets of 12 are laid on the same twelve boxes and each item has a place of its own.
ambiguity: 'हर एक को एक-एक खाना' (one box each) is ambiguous: several planets can share a box, and which of the three sets (house, sign, planet) fixes the box is not spelled out; the count of 12 planets follows his scheme.
classical_check: Agrees that there are 12 houses and 12 signs; the 12 planets match his scheme of the nine classical planets plus Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, which differs from the classical nine.

gist: Garbled stretch 'क्या भैया सबके पास एक एक पल्ले पड़ेगा कि शरीर में हमारे विभिन्न चक्रों के हिसाब से' ('will everyone get one each... in the body according to our various chakras'); the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: ज्योतिष कई प्रकार से काम करता है जो न्यूमोल जीी है
says: Jyotish works in many ways, and one of them is numerology; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice, so which other ways he lists is not known.
