Derived, not said by him: the Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn) is the same house with a weak sign, so authority is shaky and recognition is strained.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in its own sign Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) is comfortable, giving pride in home and a strong heart-centre, though heat in domestic life.

ambiguity: 'sthan' (place) is read as house; it could also be read as the sign's position.
classical_check: Agrees: planetary results depend on sign dignity and house placement in all classical texts.

hindi: सूर्य जो है इसकी अपनी राशि पांच नंबर है जिस राशि में यह अपना घर कहा जाता है कि सूर्य महाराज का अपना घर है
says: The Sun's own sign is number five, which is Leo, the sign called the Sun's own home.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's own-sign strength shows differently in each house, since the house gives the area of life where the Sun is strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) is strong and confident, with vitality and a commanding self-image.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius) is strong in dharma, father and fortune matters.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Leo in the 12th house (lagna Virgo) is strong but sits in the house of expense and distance, so ego tends to dissolve into foreign or hidden settings.

ambiguity: 'Paanch number' is read as sign number 5 = Leo using the series numbering Aries=1; it could in theory be read as house 5.
classical_check: Agrees: Leo is the Sun's own sign.

gist: Forward reference: Moon and Mars will be taken up briefly, a little each, next.

hindi: यह हमारे प्रमुख ग्रह है एक दो तीन चर पा 6 सा 89 10 11 12
says: He calls these our principal planets and counts one to twelve, which fits the twelve planets of his scheme.
ambiguity: The count is garbled ('char', 'paa 6', 'saa 89'); it could be a count of the twelve planets, the twelve signs or the twelve houses, and no planet is named in the sentence.
classical_check: Differs from the classical set of seven visible planets plus the two nodes; twelve planets is the series scheme.

hindi: सूरज और चंद्रमा मुक्त है यानी सूरज और चंद्रमा य ग्रह जो उल्टे नहीं चलेंगे सीधे ही चलेंगे बाकी सब उल्टे चल सकते हैं यह वक्री है जिस पर वक्री क्लास हमने की है
says: The Sun and Moon are 'free' (mukt) in the sense that they never move backward and always run direct, while all the other planets can turn retrograde (vakri); he points to an earlier class on retrograde planets.
ambiguity: 'mukt' is read as free from retrogression; the caption may have misheard the word.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Moon are never retrograde and the other grahas can be; Rahu and Ketu (mean nodes) are always retrograde, so 'can' is loose for them.

hindi: अब मंगल महाराज के पास यह दो राशि है बुध के पास यह सब यानी कि आगे के पांच ग्रहों के पास
says: Mars holds two signs and Mercury holds two signs, and he says the same holds for the five planets after the Sun and Moon (Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn): each of them rules a pair of signs.
cells_derived_method: The caption does not name the signs. By the usual pairs they are Mars Aries and Scorpio, Mercury Gemini and Virgo, Jupiter Sagittarius and Pisces, Venus Taurus and Libra, Saturn Capricorn and Aquarius; the same planet reads differently in its first and its second sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in Aries, its first sign, in the 1st house (lagna Aries) is direct, bold and in its own home, with plain, forceful fire.

Derived, not said by him: Mars in Scorpio, its second sign, in the 5th house (lagna Cancer) is also in its own home but the fire is concealed and intense, working through intellect, children or romance.

ambiguity: He names only Mars and Mercury; 'the next five planets' is read as Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn, the five after the Sun and Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical sign lordships (each of the five planets owns two signs).

hindi: इन पांच ग्रहों की राशि का आधिपत्य सांझा व्यापार पार्टनरशिप
says: The lordship of the signs of these five planets is shared, like a business partnership, so each of the five does not hold both its signs entirely alone.
ambiguity: It is not said here which of the two signs of each planet is shared; the next sentence gives the partners.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish gives sole lordship of each sign to one planet; shared lordship with Rahu and Ketu is a minority view and with Uranus, Neptune and Pluto it is a modern extension.

hindi: तो यहां पर इंद्र के पास यह वाली राशि है यह राहु के पास है यह केतु के पास है यह आपकी वरुण के पास है और यह यमराज के पास है यह आपकी 12 राशि
says: Pointing at the chart, he gives one sign each to Indra (Uranus), Rahu, Ketu, Varuna (Neptune) and Yamraj (Pluto) as the partners in the shared lordship, and with these all twelve signs are accounted for.
cells_derived_method: The caption does not name the signs. In the series scheme the shared signs are Uranus with Scorpio (Mars), Rahu with Virgo (Mercury), Ketu with Pisces (Jupiter), Neptune with Libra (Venus) and Pluto with Aquarius (Saturn); such a planet is read in its shared sign as at home, with the house giving the area of life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo, a sign it shares with Mercury, in the 6th house (lagna Aries); by his logic Rahu is at home here, giving strong, unconventional skill in service, health routines and rivals.
Derived, not said by him: Pluto in Aquarius, a sign it shares with Saturn, in the 3rd house (lagna Sagittarius); by his logic Pluto is at home, giving intense, hidden-force communication and courage.

ambiguity: He only points ('yeh wali rashi'), so which sign goes with which planet is not in the caption; the signs listed come from the series scheme and not from this sentence.
classical_check: Differs from classical Jyotish, which has no Uranus, Neptune or Pluto; Rahu with Virgo or Aquarius and Ketu with Scorpio or Pisces appear only in some traditions.

hindi: यानी अगर आपकी कुंडली में भाव में यह राशियों में ये ये ग्रह बैठे हैं तो आपकी कुंडली में वह फैंटास्टिक रिजल्ट दे रहे हैं बेस्ट इफेक्ट दे रहे हैं
says: If these planets sit in their own signs in the houses of your chart, they give fantastic results, their very best effect.
cells_derived_method: The own-sign cells are Sun in Leo, Moon in Cancer, Mars in Aries and Scorpio, Mercury in Gemini and Virgo, Jupiter in Sagittarius and Pisces, Venus in Taurus and Libra, Saturn in Capricorn and Aquarius, plus the shared signs of his five outer planets. The house then decides which area of life gets the best effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo); best effect shows as wisdom, learning and good children.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius in the 10th house (lagna Taurus); best effect shows as steady, disciplined career success.
Derived, not said by him: Venus in its own sign Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer); best effect shows as comfort, a pleasant home and vehicles.

ambiguity: 'ye ye graha' leaves open which planets he means; it is read as every planet that sits in its own sign. He also says the effect is best in any house, without mentioning house-lord problems.
classical_check: Agrees that a planet in its own sign (swakshetra) gives good results; classical texts add that the house it rules and the house it sits in still modify the result, so 'best in every case' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: यानी यहां तो वो आके कह रहे हैं मेरा घर है बहुत अच्छे से रहूंगा अपने घर को मैं कभी गंदा नहीं करूंगा
says: In its own sign a planet is like an owner living in his own house: it says 'this is my home, I will live well and never dirty it', so it will not spoil the cell it sits in and its results come out clean.
ambiguity: The planet's speech is his own illustration; the 'owner' is any planet in its own sign.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical swakshetra strength; the 'never spoils its own house' wording is his.

gist: Analogy: nobody hits his own house with a hammer or goes to the toilet in his own kitchen; people keep their homes clean, and where dirt arises a dustbin is kept for it.

hindi: अब कुछ ऐसे इसमें शैतान है आपस में शत्रुता हर जगह है
says: Among the planets some are mischievous, and mutual enmity runs through the whole set, so not every planet gets along with every other.
ambiguity: 'kuchh aise isme shaitan hain' is loosely captioned; it may mean some planets are troublemakers, or that there is a devil in the details of this set.
classical_check: Agrees that planets have natural friends and enemies (naisargika maitri) and that some are natural malefics.

gist: Food analogy: every food element has a plus and a minus, and it is said not to drink milk with fish or to take hot and cold together because it harms; used to show why some planets cannot sit well together.

hindi: ऐसे कुछ ग्रह भी आपस में दुश्मन है क्योंकि कोई देवता ग्रह है कोई देवता की पत्नी है कोई उसका सेनापति है कोई बेटी है कोई गुरु है अब इनके शत्रु भी साथ में लगा रखे हैं
says: Some planets are mutual enemies, and he casts the planets as a family court: one is the god-planet, one the god's wife, one his commander, one a daughter, one the guru; the enemies of each are then attached alongside, so enmity follows roles and relationships.
ambiguity: The roles are not mapped to named planets here; the commander is likely Mars and the guru Jupiter, but the god, wife and daughter are not identified.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give a planetary council (Sun king, Moon queen, Mars commander, Mercury prince, Jupiter and Venus ministers, Saturn servant), though the wife and daughter roles are his own.

hindi: शनि जो है बेटा माना जाता है सूर्य का बेटा होता नहीं है ऐसे लेकिन माना जाता है छाया के द्वारा पुत्र हुआ
says: Saturn is regarded as the Sun's son; he is not a son in the ordinary way but is accepted as one, born through Chhaya, the Sun's shadow.
ambiguity: 'Aise' is read as 'in the ordinary way'; Chhaya is the shadow-wife of the Sun in the Puranic story.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is Chhaya-putra, the son of Surya and Chhaya, in the Puranic and classical tradition.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि मींस पैदा तो सब सूर्य से ही हुए
says: The reason he gives for Saturn counting as the Sun's son is that every planet, Saturn included, was born from the Sun.
ambiguity: 'Saturn means' is a filler; he is saying all planets, not Saturn alone, came from the Sun.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish rule; as astronomy, the planets formed from the same cloud as the Sun and were not born out of it.

gist: Cosmology digression: once there was a huge Mahasurya in the galaxy, much bigger than ours; bodies and big planets crashed into it, and the collisions threw huge lava balls out of the Sun, which flew off, began circling it and by scattering formed our solar system.

hindi: तो हम सूर्य के बच्चे हैं एक्चुअली सब सूरज से ही बना है
says: From the origin story he concludes that we ourselves are the Sun's children and that everything is made from the Sun, which makes the Sun the common parent of all the planets and of us.
ambiguity: 'hum' (we) means humans and the planets together.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the Sun as atma karaka and source of life; the 'made from the Sun' origin is a cosmology claim, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: जहां जहां जितनी दूरी पर जाकर जो अटक गया सूर्य ने वही बांध लिया
says: Each ejected body came to rest at whatever distance it got stuck, and the Sun fixed it right there, which is why the planets sit at different distances from the Sun.
ambiguity: 'Jo atak gaya' (whatever got stuck) is the planets in orbit by context.
classical_check: Silent as a Jyotish rule; orbital distances are set by formation and the Sun's gravity, not by bodies 'sticking'.

gist: Analogy begins: a father and a mother have four children, and he asks how they keep them tied to the family.
Analogy continues: one child is kept tied in America, one is found working in the iron market, another is sent down to the lower floor, yet all stay bound to the family.

hindi: लेकिन बांध रखे हैं ऐसे सूरज ने सब ग्रह बांधे हुए हैं
says: Just as parents keep scattered children tied to the family, the Sun keeps every planet tied to itself however far each has gone, so all planets stay under the Sun's hold.
ambiguity: It is a physical picture; whether it implies the Sun's influence over the other planets in a chart is not said.
classical_check: Silent as a Jyotish rule; in astronomy the Sun's gravity does hold the planets in orbit, which fits the picture.

hindi: सूरज में आ गया और मंगल में भी आ ग सूरज से ही निकला है सब मंगल में सुखी आग है पर आग है
says: Fire is in the Sun, and Mars carries fire as well since everything came out of the Sun; Mars's fire is a 'dry' fire, but it is fire all the same.
ambiguity: The first words ('suraj mein aa gaya aur mangal mein bhi aa ga') are garbled and read as 'fire is in the Sun and in Mars'; 'sukhi aag' may be 'sookhi aag' (dry fire).
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is a fire planet; the 'dry fire inherited from the Sun' picture is his own.

hindi: अब इंद्र देवता जो है यह किसी से शत्रुता करते हैं चंद्रमा किसी और से शत्रुता करता है सूर्य किसी से शत्रुता करता है
says: Indra (Uranus), the Moon and the Sun each have some planet as an enemy; he does not name the targets here, only that enmity is built into every planet.
ambiguity: The enemies of Indra and the Moon are not named in the sentence.
classical_check: Partly differs: in the Parashari natural relations the Moon has no natural enemy, and the Sun's enemies are Saturn and Venus; Uranus has no classical relations.

hindi: शनि सूर्य से शत्रुता करता है
says: Saturn is the Sun's enemy, although he is also the Sun's son, so the father and son are natural foes.
ambiguity: 'Shatruta karta hai' is read as Saturn being hostile to the Sun, which is the enemy relation in the natural-friendship table.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun-Saturn natural enmity is classical.

gist: Analogy: when you go to an enemy's house you leave his fridge open so the power burns it out, put all his mobile phones in the microwave, and soil his drawing-room carpet; this is what a guest enemy would do.

hindi: यानी जब जब ऐसा ही कोई अपने शत्रु ग्रह के राशि में बैठा होता है तो यानी कि उसके घर में बैठा है
says: Whenever a planet sits in the sign of its enemy planet it is a guest in an enemy's house, and like the vandal guest it wrecks that house; in that cell the planet gives spoiled results.
cells_derived_method: The damage depends on which sign is the enemy's (by the usual relations, Sun's enemies are Venus and Saturn, so Taurus, Libra, Capricorn and Aquarius), and the house shows which area of life is wrecked.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in the Sun's sign Leo in the 7th house (lagna Aquarius); a guest enemy in the partnership house, so the marriage or business partner area is damaged by cold friction and ego clash.

Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Venus's sign Taurus in the 8th house (lagna Libra); an enemy-sign guest in the house of the hidden, so wisdom and protection turn unreliable on shared money and sudden events.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Mercury's sign Virgo in the 11th house (lagna Scorpio); drive wrecks the gains and friend circle with petty conflict and criticism.

ambiguity: The sentence ends mid-thought; the effect (spoiled results) is taken from the vandal-guest analogy, and he does not list the enemy signs here.
classical_check: Agrees: a planet in an enemy sign is weakened in classical texts, though the strength of the damage depends on other factors too, such as aspects and the lord of that sign.

hindi: एक तो भाव है हमारे य भाव सेट है यह लगन है यह लगन ही रहेगा यह छाती के ग्रह चार द ऐसे ही रहेंगे
says: He separates house from sign: the houses (bhava) are fixed in place, the lagna stays the lagna and the chest house (read as the 4th) stays where it is, and the sign a planet sits in is a separate matter.
ambiguity: 'chaar d' is garbled: it may be house 4 alone or 4 and another house (such as 10); 'chhaati ke graha' is read as the chest house. The last clause is partly my reading of how the next lines use it.
classical_check: Agrees that houses are fixed positions and signs vary by lagna; Kalapurusha gives the 4th house the chest.

hindi: अब मान लो यहां पर छाती पर सूर्य बैठा है गलत राशि में तुला राशि में बैठा है तो नीच का फल देता है वृष में है तो नीच के जैसा फल देता है
says: Suppose the Sun sits on the chest (4th house) in a wrong sign: in Libra it gives the result of debilitation, and in Taurus it gives results like debilitation.
cells_derived_method: The Sun is debilitated in Libra, and Taurus is the sign of Venus, the Sun's enemy, so he treats both as bad signs. The same bad-sign Sun reads differently by house: in the 10th it hits career and authority, in the 7th partnership, in the 1st the body and self-image.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn); authority, career standing and the father's support are weak.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in the enemy sign Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio); ego friction with the partner and a struggle for equal standing.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun debilitated in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra); low vitality and a weak sense of self until the debilitation is relieved.

ambiguity: 'Chhaati' is read as the 4th house; he does not say the number here. 'Nich ke jaisa' for Taurus means debilitation-like, though Taurus is only an enemy sign.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun is debilitated in Libra; Taurus is an enemy sign, not debilitation, so 'like debilitated' is stronger than the Parashari rating of an enemy sign.

hindi: यानी अब छाती पर सूर्य आ कर के कह रहा मैं तो आग लगा दूंगा मेरे को नहीं पता मेरे को बहुत गुस्सा है
says: He personifies the Sun sitting in a hostile sign on the chest: it announces 'I will set fire to it, I do not know, I am very angry', meaning a Sun in an enemy sign acts out with heat and anger in the house where it sits.
ambiguity: The 4th house is read from the 'chest'; the sign is the hostile one from the previous sentence, which is not repeated here.
classical_check: Silent; the angry-guest picture is his own, though an afflicted Sun is classically linked with heat, anger and ego.

hindi: तो छाती पर क्या ग्रह है मर्म स्थान छाती पर हड्डियां है फेफड़े हैं हार्ट है
says: The chest is a vital spot (marm sthan) that holds bones, lungs and the heart, so a planet sitting there acts on those organs. A body-part mapping, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The house number is not said; the chest is taken as the 4th from the earlier lines and the Kalapurusha body map.
classical_check: Agrees: Kalapurusha gives the 4th house the chest, heart and lungs.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य इतना पावरफुल है वो फेफड़े फेफड़े तो यही उड़ा देगा हड्डियां तो शनि के पास है वो देर से गलाए हार्ट को पकड़ लेता है
says: Of the chest organs, the Sun is so powerful it would blow away the lungs; the bones belong to Saturn, which dissolves them only slowly; so the Sun seizes the heart instead. An organ-karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Phephde yahin uda dega' is loosely worded; it reads as the Sun's force being enough to damage the lungs at once, but he turns to the heart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is the heart karaka and Saturn the bone karaka; lungs are usually given to Mercury or the Moon, so 'Sun blows the lungs' is his own.

hindi: हार्ट अटैक दे देगा तो यानी कि उसका यह खराब शत्रु ग्रह की राशि में य बैठा होना आपके हार्ट को अटैक दे देगा
says: A Sun sitting in a bad enemy-planet's sign on the chest will give the heart an attack, so the Sun in a hostile sign in the 4th is read as a heart-attack indicator. A health prediction recorded as said, not a diagnosis rule.
cells_derived_method: The other enemy signs of the Sun are Saturn's signs Capricorn and Aquarius, so the same reading would extend to the Sun in those signs in the 4th; the sign sets how hard the strike is, and it is milder if Jupiter or Mars aspects the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Saturn's sign Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra); an enemy-sign Sun on the heart-house, so the heart indicator applies in his logic.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Saturn's sign Aquarius in the 4th house (lagna Scorpio); the same enemy-sign Sun in the heart house, with Saturn's cold making it a slower build-up.

ambiguity: 'Y baitha hona' is garbled; it is read as 'sitting there'. The cells are the Libra and Taurus he named a few lines earlier.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted Sun and an afflicted 4th house are classical indicators of heart trouble, but they give a tendency, never a certain attack.

hindi: ऐसे ही यदि पत्नी स्थान या पति स्थान में कोई नेगेटिव ग्रह बैठ गया तलाक दे देगा आपको
says: In the same way, if a negative planet sits in the spouse's house, the wife's or husband's place, it will give you a divorce.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the harm depends on how negative the planet is and on the sign it holds: a debilitated or enemy-sign malefic in the 7th is worse than one in its own sign. The same planet in other houses would not hit the marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra); a cold, weak malefic in the marriage house, the heaviest strain on the partnership.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 7th house (lagna Taurus); a negative planet but at home, so conflict and heat in marriage without the full breakdown.

Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 7th house (lagna Gemini); a negative planet in the marriage house with mixed moral and foreign flavour, with Jupiter's sign softening it somewhat.

ambiguity: He does not number the house; 'patni sthan / pati sthan' is the 7th. 'Negative graha' is not defined, though it is read as natural malefics.
classical_check: Partly agrees: malefics in the 7th house harm marriage in classical texts, but a divorce is not certain from one planet; texts weigh the 7th lord, Venus and aspects as well.

hindi: प्रेम के स्थान में बैठ गया प्रेम ही नहीं मिलेगा आप सारी जिंदगी रोते रहोगे यार प्यार नहीं मिल रहा हम तो कर्म कर कर के मर गए और आपका कर्म भी सही है
says: If a negative planet sits in the house of love, you will not get love at all and will spend your life crying that no love comes, even though your own conduct is right.
cells_derived_method: The kind of love denied depends on the sign: a pride-sign malefic gives love blocked by ego, a cold-sign malefic gives love that is slow and distant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the Sun's sign Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries); romance is blocked by pride and a hunger for admiration that never feels answered.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer); love comes slowly, with suspicion and an emotional chill.

ambiguity: 'Prem ka sthan' is not numbered; it is read as the 5th house (romance), though it could also be read as the 7th. The words before 'baith gaya' are missing, and the planet is understood to be a negative one from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: malefics in the 5th, or an afflicted 5th lord, damage romance in classical texts; 'no love at all' is stronger than any rule.

hindi: देखो उस मांगेराम को साला कुत्तों की तरह गालियां बकता है बकवास भकता है चिल्लाता है फिर भी उसे प्रेम मिला हुआ है क्योंकि उसके प्रेम का जो खाना है उसमें बड़ा शुभ ग्रह कोई बैठा है
says: You will say look at that man who abuses like a dog and rants and shouts, yet he is loved; the reason is that a big benefic planet sits in his love house, so a benefic there gives love even to a person of poor conduct.
cells_derived_method: A benefic's strength to protect love depends on its sign dignity: a benefic in its own or exalted sign gives love freely, one in an enemy sign gives it with strings attached.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo); a strong benefic, so love and affection come to him easily despite rough behaviour.
Derived, not said by him: Venus in its own sign Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn); a charming, steady benefic that draws affection to him whatever his manner.

ambiguity: 'Mangeram' is a made-up person; 'prem ka khana' (the love box) is read as the 5th house. The words 'shubh graha' are not defined further.
classical_check: Agrees in form that benefics in the 5th protect romance and children; the 'bad conduct yet loved' framing is his own.

hindi: अब ये शुभ ग्रह क्यों बैठा है पूर्व जन्म के कर्म है किस्मत उठी हुई है
says: Why is that benefic planet sitting in the love house? Because of past-life karma: the person's fortune is raised, so a good planet in a good place is read as the result of earlier merit.
ambiguity: 'Ye shubh graha' refers back to the benefic in the love house from the 'Mangeram' example; no planet is named.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical view is that the chart shows past-life karma (prarabdha), and well-placed benefics reflect earlier merit.

hindi: क्यों नहीं मिल रहा साला किस्मत फूटी हुई है
says: When a person does not get what he expects, his explanation is that the fortune is broken (kismat phooti), meaning the past karma behind the chart is poor and the placements are bad.
ambiguity: 'Kya nahin mil raha' is the thing missing in the example (love); he does not say what the weak placement is.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical bhagya (fortune) and karma reading; the 9th house and its lord are the classical fortune indicators, which he does not name here.

gist: He says he often has to say the bitter words 'your fortune is broken' to people, and they cry.

Analogy: if a doctor tells a patient his kidney has failed, the patient begs him not to say it, but the doctor must be firm or treatment cannot start; the patient's heart would break anyway in a few days; so the truth is very bitter, yet it has to be spoken.

hindi: यह सत्य बोलने की सत्य बोलने की शक्ति सूर्य से मिलती है राम जी है सूर सूर्यवंशी ये वहां से मिलेगी
says: The power to speak the truth comes from the Sun; he points to Ram ji, who is Suryavanshi (of the solar dynasty), as the source of this strength.
ambiguity: 'Satya bolne ki shakti' is read as the courage and authority to say hard truths, not truthfulness alone.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is the karaka of the soul, authority and honesty in many texts; no classical line names the courage to speak truth specifically.

gist: Recaps the guest-enemy picture (if some enemy planets sit in a house, the home is theirs to spoil) and adds that each of these signs is a planet's own home.
He starts a walk through the twelve signs one by one, beginning with the sign called Simha (Leo), to be understood briefly, taking it as the starting point.
Defers what the lagna means for each sign: 'we will talk about all of that shortly'.

hindi: ये सिंह राशि है अब सिंह की राशि का मालिक कौन है सूरज ही हो सकता है
says: The lord of the Leo (Simha) sign can only be the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the lord of Leo.

hindi: शेर का दिल सबसे बड़ा शेर जैसा कोई है ही नहीं राजा है किंग है
says: Leo's symbol is the lion: it has the biggest heart, there is nobody like the lion, it is the king; so the Leo sign stands for royalty, a big heart and pride.
cells_derived_method: A planet placed in Leo takes on a regal, big-hearted, proud tone, and the house decides where this shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) gives a bold, commanding, courageous personality, with royal pride in the self.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Leo in the 2nd house (lagna Cancer) gives speech that is regal, authoritative and generous, though prone to pride.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Leo in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio) gives a public image of warmth and dignity, a leadership style that draws people with big-heartedness.

ambiguity: The Sun is not named in this sentence; it is the lord of Leo from the sentence before.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts describe Leo as the lion sign, royal, proud and generous.

hindi: चंद्रमा की राशि है कर्क कर्क चार नंबर को कहते हैं यह केकड़ा
says: Cancer (Kark) is the Moon's sign, it is called number four, and its symbol is the crab.
cells_derived_method: The Moon in its own sign Cancer is at home and strongest in feeling; the house shows which area gets the nurturing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer); the self is caring, emotional and protective.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 7th house (lagna Capricorn); the partner or public dealings carry a nurturing, moody quality.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra); career in care, food, home or public emotion-handling is favoured.

classical_check: Agrees: Cancer is the Moon's sign, the fourth sign, and the crab is its symbol.

hindi: केकड़ा सबसे ज्यादा केयर टेकर होता है केकड़े के परिवार का एनिमल किंगडम में स्टडी किया गया कि अपने परिवार को संभालने के लिए मरने को तैयार हो जाता है
says: The crab is the greatest caretaker of its family; he says animal-kingdom studies found it ready to die in order to look after its family, which is why Cancer is read as a fiercely protective, family-minded sign.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Cancer takes on a protective, family-guarding tone and the house decides which family area gets guarded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries); the ego is tied to home and mother, with fierce protective pride over the family.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Cancer in the 7th house (lagna Capricorn); a duty-bound, anxious caretaker in marriage who sacrifices for the partner but worries and holds back warmth.
Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th house (lagna Pisces); the protective instinct over children turns anxious and aggressive.

ambiguity: The 'study' is not named, and the claim about crabs dying for their family is a popular saying, not a verified result.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts describe Cancer natives as nurturing and home-loving; the crab claim is a popular image.

hindi: तो चंद्रमा मां के समान मानी जाती है मां ऐसी होती है यानी मां अगर चार नंबर के उसम है तो केकड़े की तरह मार देगी लड़ जाएगी खुद मर जाएगी के करना नहीं छोड़ेगी
says: The Moon is taken as the mother, and a mother in the number-four sign acts like a crab: she will hit, fight and even die, but will not stop looking after her family.
cells_derived_method: The mother's fierce caring shows where the Moon sits: in the 4th house (the mother's house) it concerns the mother herself, in the 7th the wife acting as a mother.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries); a strong, fiercely protective mother figure and deep attachment to home.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 7th house (lagna Capricorn); the spouse takes on the mother-like, self-sacrificing role.

ambiguity: 'Chaar number ke usam' is garbled; 'number four' can be the sign Cancer or the 4th house (the mother's house), and the earlier lines point to the sign. The sentence is also cut at 'karna nahin chhodegi'.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the Moon is the mother karaka and Cancer is a nurturing sign; the fighter-mother image is his own.

gist: Comic domestic skit: a wife quarrels with her husband, hits him with a rolling pin, still insists on getting the child to school, slaps the child, then cries herself and nurses the child; used to illustrate the crab-mother's fierce duty.

hindi: ये मंगल महाराज है ये है मेष राशि मेष क्या है मेढ़ा
says: This is Mars, and his sign is Aries (Mesh), whose symbol is the ram.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is Mars's sign and the ram is its symbol.

hindi: मेढ़ा आपने देखा होगा टक्कर मारी टच अपना सिर मतलब वो किसी सांड से भी टकरा जाएगा छोटा सा मेड़ा उसके सिर में इतनी जान है यह मंगल ग्रह की राशि है
says: The ram butts with its head and will clash even with a bull; a small ram has that much strength in its head, and this is Mars's sign, so Aries stands for fearless head-on force concentrated in the head.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Aries takes on a bold, head-on, impulsive tone, and the house shows which area gets the headlong push.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius); sharp, argumentative speech and writing, quick to charge at an opponent.
Derived, not said by him: Venus in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra); impulsive, passionate partnership, quick to start and quick to clash.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer); the head-on drive is blocked by Saturn's caution, so career effort meets friction and delay.

ambiguity: 'Ek tach apna sir' is garbled; it is read as 'strikes with his head'.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is the sign of the head and of rash courage in classical texts and the Kalapurusha.

hindi: बुध तीन नंबर राशि मिथुन
says: Mercury's sign is number three, Gemini (Mithun).
ambiguity: 'Litty' after Mithun is a caption artefact and is ignored.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini is Mercury's sign and the third sign.

hindi: मिथुन देखा होगा आपने जेमिना राशि को कहते हैं इंग्लिश में दो होते हैं तो दो चलते हैं
says: Gemini is the twin sign: in English it is called Gemini, which means two, so two walk together; the sign stands for duality and pairs.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Gemini takes on a dual, paired quality, such as two options, two roles or two sources, and the house shows where the doubling happens.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in its own sign Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries); two-handed skill, communication and trade, often with a sibling or partner in the work.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo); a double or shifting career with advisory and teaching strands.
Derived, not said by him: Venus in Gemini in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius); two interests or two romances at once, with playfulness and wit in love.

ambiguity: 'Jemina' is the caption's spelling of Gemini; 'do chalte hain' is read as 'two move together'.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini is the dual (dwiswabhava) twin sign in classical texts.

gist: Navigation remark that the signs will be finished this way one by one, with a garbled bit before he moves on to Dhanu (Sagittarius).
Notes that the figure drawn for Sagittarius is called Sagittarius in English and Dhanu in Hindi, that the two names differ in meaning, and asks to be reminded to explain the difference later.

hindi: तो धनु राशि क्या है एक घोड़ा दौड़ रहा है तीर चला रहा है हवा में आकाश में यानी आप इतने शार्प हैं कि आप चलते चलते भी मम कर सकते हैं निशाना
says: Sagittarius is shown as a horse running while shooting an arrow into the sky, meaning you are so sharp that you can take aim even while on the move.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Sagittarius takes on a fast-moving, sharp-aiming quality, and the house shows where the aim is directed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun in Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo); a focused, quick intellect that hits the target of a problem while moving.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 4th house (lagna Virgo); a fast learner at home, restless in the household, with sharp, far-aimed thinking.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Sagittarius in the 12th house (lagna Capricorn); energy aimed at distant lands and hidden causes, with a hunter's accuracy in solitary work.

ambiguity: 'Chalte chalte bhi mam kar sakte hain nishana' is garbled; read as 'can aim even while moving'. Jupiter is the lord, named in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Sagittarius is the archer sign (a centaur drawing a bow); the pure horse image is his own simplification.

hindi: और आप घोड़े जैसी चाल है आपकी फ्लाई कर रहे हैं एक तरह से आप कितना शार्प है ये गुरु इसका मालिक गुरु है
says: Sagittarius has the pace of a horse, almost flying, and its owner is the guru, Jupiter; the sharpness and speed of this sign belong to Jupiter's nature.
ambiguity: 'Fly kar rahe hain' is figurative for speed.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the lord of Sagittarius.

hindi: यानी गुरु ऐसा होता है चलते चलते भी कूट के फेंक के मार के सेट कर देता है उसका निशाना गजब का है
says: Jupiter is like that archer: even on the move he can pound, throw, strike and set a matter right, and his aim is remarkable; Jupiter solves problems fast and accurately.
ambiguity: 'Koot ke phenk ke maar ke set kar deta hai' is rough speech; read as 'sets things in order by force when needed'.
classical_check: Silent; classically Jupiter is the gentle teacher and counsellor, so the pounding and striking image is his own.

hindi: इसके पश्चात आपका हो गया शुक्र शुक्र दो नंबर राशि है वृष राशि
says: Next comes Venus, whose sign is number two, Taurus (Vrish).
ambiguity: Venus also owns Libra; he gives only Taurus here.
classical_check: Agrees: Taurus is Venus's sign and the second sign.

hindi: थांबा जहां अटक गए वहां अटक गए जो करना है वो करना है जो बांधना है वो बांधना है
says: Taurus is a stop-and-stay sign: where it gets stuck it stays stuck, what has to be done is done, and what has to be tied down is tied down; the sign stands for stubborn fixity.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Taurus takes on a fixed, stubborn, settling quality, and the house shows what gets locked in place.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 3rd house (lagna Pisces); steady, stubborn courage and a settled, determined way of communicating.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Taurus in the 9th house (lagna Virgo); rigid, fixed beliefs and a slow, stubborn hold on tradition and fortune.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Taurus in the 6th house (lagna Sagittarius); a dogged, stubborn fighter against enemies and debts who does not let go.

ambiguity: 'Thamba' is a Marathi 'stop' and the subject is not named; the lines before are about the Sun binding the planets, but the lines after are about the bull of Taurus, so it is read as Taurus. 'Jo bandhna hai' could also mean tying a relationship.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Taurus is a fixed, stubborn, stable sign.

hindi: मृत संजी संजीवनी का देवता है शुक्र
says: Venus is the deity of the Mrit-Sanjeevani, the life-reviving knowledge; Venus carries the power to bring back what seems dead.
ambiguity: 'Mrit sanji sanjeevani' is garbled but is the known Mritasanjeevani vidya of Shukracharya.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukra (Shukracharya) is the master of Mritasanjeevani vidya in the Puranic tradition and Venus is the planet of Shukracharya.

hindi: ये वैभव का आनंद का आपने बुल देखा होगा नंदी भगवान शिव का जो वाहन है नंदी
says: Venus's Taurus is the sign of luxury and joy, and its symbol is the bull, Nandi, the vehicle of Lord Shiva.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Taurus takes on the comfort-loving, pleasure-seeking tone, and the house shows the area enjoyed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Venus in its own sign Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries); wealth, food, voice and family comfort flourish with a luxury taste.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Taurus in the 11th house (lagna Cancer); gains come through trade in comfort goods and a pleasure-loving friend circle.

classical_check: Agrees: Taurus is the bull sign ruled by Venus, the planet of luxury; the Nandi link is his own illustration.

hindi: उसका एक पैर तैयार है ऐसे और एक पैर अंदर मुड़ा हुआ है वो वेट कर रहा है शिव जी कब आओगे कब चलो वेट चलने को तैयार है और पक्का फिक्स है जहां है सो है
says: Nandi has one leg ready to move and one leg folded under, waiting for Shiva to say go; he is ready to move yet firmly fixed where he is; Taurus therefore combines readiness with immovable steadiness.
ambiguity: Nandi's posture is his own picture of Taurus's patient, waiting, fixed nature; Venus is implied as the lord.
classical_check: Silent on the Nandi posture; the fixed, patient nature of Taurus is classical.

hindi: शनि महाराज की मकर राशि है मकर राशि बहुत सोशल बनाती है सोशल मकर राशि कैप्रीकॉर्न
says: Saturn's sign is Capricorn (Makar), and he says Capricorn makes a person very social.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Capricorn takes on an organised, status-aware, social-minded tone, and the house shows where the social side works.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Capricorn in the 11th house (lagna Pisces); a wide, practical social network and gains through contacts in organisations.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in Capricorn in the 7th house (lagna Cancer); formal, status-conscious dealings with partners and the public, with some stiffness.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 3rd house (lagna Scorpio); a wide circle of acquaintances with little real depth, effort without lasting fruit.

ambiguity: 'Social' may mean friendly or may mean concerned with society and standing; the caption repeats the word.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: classical texts describe Capricorn as ambitious, disciplined and reserved; 'very social' is his reading, though the natural 10th-house link to public life gives it some basis.

hindi: ये आठ नंबर स्कॉर्पियो इंद्र स्कॉर्पियन राशि देखी होगी अपने बिच्छू बना हुआ है
says: Number eight is Scorpio, which he pairs with Indra (Uranus), and its symbol is the scorpion.
ambiguity: 'Indra Scorpion rashi' is read as Indra holding Scorpio in his shared-lordship scheme, since the sign's classical lord Mars is not named here.
classical_check: Differs: Scorpio is classically Mars's sign and Uranus is not part of the classical scheme; the scorpion symbol and sign number eight agree.

hindi: बिच्छू डंक भी मार देता है सबसे सीक्रेट होता है बिच्छू कहां रहता है सीक्रेट भयंकर सीक्रेट होते हैं
says: The scorpion stings and is the most secretive creature, living in hiding; Scorpio stands for secrecy, hidden deep matters and a sting.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Scorpio takes on a hidden, secretive, stinging tone, and the house shows what is kept secret.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer); deep, hidden feelings in romance and about children, with moods that turn sharp.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra); secretive about money and family, with a cutting, guarded way of speaking.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Scorpio in the 11th house (lagna Capricorn); gains and friendships kept hidden, with sharp, probing conversation.

ambiguity: Uranus is carried from the sentence before, where Indra goes with Scorpio.
classical_check: Agrees: Scorpio is the sign of secrets, hidden matters and sting in classical texts.

hindi: ये हमारी कुंडली में आठवें खाने को भी आठ नंबर राशि से जोड़ा गया है
says: In our chart the 8th house box is also tied to the number-eight sign, Scorpio, so the 8th house and the eighth sign share the same theme of secrecy and the hidden.
cells_derived_method: This is the natural-zodiac pairing (house 8 with sign 8, true when the lagna is Aries). In other charts the 8th house holds a different sign, and the sign colours how the secrecy theme of the 8th house is expressed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the 8th house falling on Capricorn (lagna Gemini); the hidden and secret matters show through Saturn's sign as slow, sober, long-hidden matters kept with discipline.
Derived, not said by him: the 8th house falling on Pisces (lagna Leo); the hidden matters take a spiritual, dreamy and boundary-dissolving colour, a Jupiter and Ketu flavour.

ambiguity: 'Aathven khane' (8th box) and 'aath number rashi' (8th sign) are read as the natural pairing of house 8 with Scorpio; he does not say that a chart's 8th house can hold another sign.
classical_check: Agrees: the Kalapurusha pairs the 8th house with the 8th sign; classical texts also read the 8th as the house of secrets and the hidden.

hindi: इसके पास हमारा गुदा स्थान है मल त्यागने का स्थान यह सीक्रेट है
says: Near this (the 8th house and Scorpio) lies our anal region, the place of excretion, which is a secret part of the body, so the body map for this house and sign is the excretory and anal area.
cells_derived_method: The same body part is mapped wherever the 8th house is, whichever sign holds it; the sign adds only its own quality to the area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the 8th house on Capricorn (lagna Gemini); the anal and hidden-body area has a Saturn colour, with chronic or slow-moving trouble as the theme.
Derived, not said by him: the 8th house on Pisces (lagna Leo); the same region with a Jupiter and Ketu colour, linked to discharge and hidden, hard-to-trace trouble.

ambiguity: 'Iske paas' (near this) is read as the 8th house or Scorpio. Recorded as a body-part mapping, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts and the Kalapurusha give the 8th house and Scorpio the genitals and anal region.

hindi: बहुत मजे की बात है आठवा ही घर हमारा ससुराल का होता है
says: The 8th house is also the house of the in-laws (sasural), the wife's or husband's family home, in addition to its secrecy meaning.
cells_derived_method: The in-laws' theme in the 8th house takes its colour from the sign on it: Scorpio hides their matters, Capricorn makes them formal and cold, Pisces makes them vague or spiritual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the 8th house on Scorpio (lagna Aries); the in-laws' affairs are deeply private and intense.
Derived, not said by him: the 8th house on Capricorn (lagna Gemini); the in-laws are formal, reserved and duty-minded.

ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next minute ('sasural ka hota hai'); it is read as in-laws in general, either spouse's family.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the spouse's family is read from the 8th house (the 2nd from the 7th, bhavat bhavam), though classical texts mainly call the 8th the house of longevity and obstacles.

hindi: ससुराल की बात हमेशा सीक्रेट रखो
says: Always keep the matters of the in-laws' house secret; a do-and-don't tied to the 8th house, the house of secrecy and the in-laws.
ambiguity: It is a general piece of advice; he does not say whether it applies only to the wife or to both spouses.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it is a practical conduct tip based on the 8th house meaning of secrecy.

hindi: जिस लड़की ने ससुराल की रा बातें सीक्रेट रखी और अपने घर यानी पति का ससुराल जो हो गया उसका अपना घर वहां की बातें यहां नहीं लिखी उसके घर का आठवा घर नष्ट नहीं होता
says: A woman who keeps her in-laws' affairs secret, and does not carry into her own house the matters of the house that is her husband's in-laws, keeps the 8th house of her own home from being destroyed. A conduct remedy recorded as his tradition claim.
ambiguity: 'Ra baaten' is garbled, 'likhi' may be 'layi' (brought), and 'ashtam ghar nasht nahin hota' is not defined; it may mean the 8th house is protected from ruin. He gives no timing.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives this conduct rule for protecting the 8th house.

hindi: मृत्यु का स्थान होता है आठवा
says: The 8th house is the place of death, the house of the end of life and of transformation; recorded as the house's meaning, not as a prediction for anyone.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the house of death, longevity (ayu) and transformation in classical texts.

gist: Forward reference: the 8th house will link up with a great deal of detail later and is very interesting and absorbing.

hindi: ये छह नंबर यह राहु यह कन्या राशि है
says: Number six is Virgo (Kanya), which he pairs with Rahu in his shared-lordship scheme.
ambiguity: 'Yeh Rahu' is read as Rahu holding Virgo alongside Mercury; he does not name Mercury here.
classical_check: Differs: Virgo is classically Mercury's sign; Rahu with Virgo is a shared or minority assignment.

hindi: कन्या के समान इसी से सारा काम कर देते हो सारे महाभारत यहीं से करा दी द्रौपदी ने
says: Like a maiden (Kanya), you get all the work done through this sign; the whole Mahabharata was brought about from here by Draupadi, so Virgo and Rahu work through a woman's intellect and words.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Virgo takes on a head-led, clever, get-it-done-by-words tone, and the house shows where the cleverness is used.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo in the 7th house (lagna Pisces); the partner works through intellect and persuasion and can steer the whole household or business by words.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo in the 10th house (lagna Sagittarius); a career built by clever planning and sharp analysis, with influence gained through cunning.

ambiguity: 'Isi se sara kaam kar dete ho' is read as 'you get everything done through this'; the Mahabharata line is an illustration, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical Virgo is the maiden sign of analysis and service, and the Draupadi story is his own illustration.

hindi: इसी में रूप रंग सौंदर्य बुद्धि ज्ञान वैभव सब खोपड़ी चलती है
says: Under this Rahu-and-Virgo heading come looks, colour, beauty, intellect, knowledge and grandeur: all of it is the skull working, the head being the seat of all these.
ambiguity: 'Isi mein' (in this) is read as Rahu and Virgo; 'khopdi chalti hai' means the head or mind does the work.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts give beauty to Venus, intellect to Mercury and knowledge to Jupiter; collecting them all under Rahu's head-only nature is his own view.

hindi: हम जो कर रहे हैं राहु का ही काम कर रहे हैं इस समय बैठ के शरीर के कुछ नहीं कर रहे मुंडी मुंडी से सुन रहे हैं देख रहे हैं बोल रहे हैं कर रहे हैं
says: What we are doing right now is Rahu's work: sitting without using the body, we listen, watch, speak and act only through the head; Rahu is the planet of the head, hearing, seeing and speaking.
ambiguity: 'Mundi' (head) refers to the head of the demon, which is the myth behind Rahu being a head with no body.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic Rahu as a severed head; its association with senses of hearing and speech is partly classical (Rahu as speech and cunning), the rest is his own.

hindi: इसीलिए स्त्री कहती है मैं बेबस हूं मैं बेबस हूं उस बहन को नेचुरली राहु का यही कृपा है कि तो बुद्धि से ही जीवन में सब कुछ जीत जाएगी
says: That is why a woman says 'I am helpless'; he claims that for her Rahu's grace is by nature that she will win everything in life through intelligence alone. A broad statement about women recorded as his claim.
ambiguity: 'Stree' is any woman, and it is not clear whether he means the woman's own chart or women generally; 'behas' is read as 'helpless' because her body does nothing.
classical_check: Silent and not classical: the female karakas are Venus and the Moon, and Rahu is not described as the planet of women; this is a generalisation of his.

hindi: इसलिए बुद्धिमान होना बहुत जरूरी है स्त्री का अच्छी लड़की नहीं चाहिए समझदार चाहिए
says: For this reason intelligence is essential in a woman: one should look not for a merely 'good girl' but for a sensible, intelligent one. Advice recorded as his tradition view.
ambiguity: Rahu is not named in this sentence; it follows from the Rahu lines before. It is not said whether the advice is for choosing a bride or for upbringing.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it is a social opinion, not a Jyotish line.

hindi: क्योंकि उसके शरीर में केतु का नहीं है वास वो राहु है मुंडी अकेली
says: The reason given is that Ketu has no home in her body: she is Rahu, the head alone, so the female nature is the head without the trunk; Ketu, the body, is absent.
ambiguity: It is read as women being Rahu-natured and men Ketu-natured; the sentence stops short of saying men are Ketu, which comes next.
classical_check: Not classical; the Rahu-head and Ketu-body myth is Puranic, but mapping it onto women and men is his own idea.

hindi: तो वो कहती है अक्सर मैं सुन सकती हूं मैं देख सकती हूं मैं बोल सकती हूं मैं कह सकती हूं मैं कर कुछ नहीं सकती कैसा विचित्र हिसाब किताब है
says: As a result she often says 'I can hear, see, speak and say, but I can do nothing'; the Rahu pattern is full of senses and speech but no power to act, and he calls it a strange accounting.
ambiguity: The sentence runs on into the man, 'Ketu's accounting', in the next lines.
classical_check: Silent; this is his character sketch of the Rahu type.

hindi: आदमी केतु का हिसाब मुंडी नहीं ना मैं कुछ देखूंगा ना मैं सुनूंगा ना मैं बोलूंगा मुझे कुछ नहीं पता मुझे छोड़ दो
says: The man is Ketu's accounting: there is no head, so he says 'I will not see, hear or speak, I know nothing, leave me alone'; Ketu is the body without a head, acting but not perceiving or speaking.
ambiguity: The first word 'aadmi' belongs to the line before the minute mark; it is read as the man, in contrast to the woman as Rahu.
classical_check: Not classical; the headless-body image of Ketu is Puranic, but mapping it onto men is his own idea, and classical Ketu is the planet of detachment and the occult.

gist: Comic skit: someone says 'I suspect you', and the answer is 'yes, I am worth suspecting, I am the god of suspicion'; it is not clear whether Rahu or Ketu is meant.

hindi: ये राहु और केतु है ये दोनों के दोनों को एजिस्ट करते हैं साथ ये बड़ी विचित्र सुंदरता है
says: Rahu and Ketu always exist together, as head and body of one being, and he calls this pairing a strange and beautiful design.
ambiguity: 'Exist karte hain saath' is read as being always together, 180 degrees apart in the chart; he does not state the angle.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu and Ketu are always exactly opposite each other in the sky and always sit in opposite houses.

gist: He marvels at how the ancient scholars worked all this out and turned it into lists and laws scientifically and mathematically, and says there should be school books so children learn this knowledge.

hindi: फिर केतु 12 नंबर यह मीन राशि है
says: Then comes Ketu, with sign number twelve, Pisces (Meen), which he pairs with Ketu in his shared-lordship scheme.
ambiguity: He does not name Jupiter, the classical lord of Pisces, in this sentence.
classical_check: Differs: Pisces is classically Jupiter's sign; Ketu with Pisces is a minority or shared assignment. Pisces as sign number twelve agrees.

hindi: केतु क्या है भोग का देवता सेक्स का देवता
says: Ketu is the deity of enjoyment (bhoga) and of sex, the planet of pleasure of the body.
ambiguity: This sits oddly with his next lines, where Ketu leads to spirituality; he may mean that Ketu's pleasure leads past itself to another plane.
classical_check: Differs: classically Ketu is the planet of detachment, moksha and the occult, while pleasure and sex belong to Venus; this also stands against his own later line on Ketu and spirituality.

hindi: केतु आपको जीवन के दूसरे आयाम में लेकर चला जाता है दूसरे ज्ञान देता है
says: Ketu takes you into another dimension of life and gives a different kind of knowledge, beyond ordinary experience.
ambiguity: 'Doosre aayam' (another dimension) is not defined and may mean spiritual, occult or simply other-worldly.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical karaka of occult knowledge, past-life impressions and other planes.

hindi: केतु में देखा होगा पायस दो मछलियां घूम रही है यन और यंग है बेसिकली ये मछलियां प्लस में माइनस है माइनस में प्लस
says: The Pisces sign shows two fishes swimming around, which he reads as yin and yang: basically the fishes are minus inside plus and plus inside minus; Pisces stands for a pair of opposites folded into each other.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Pisces takes on a dual, dissolving, opposites-in-each-other tone, and the house shows where the blending happens.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius); deep, dreamlike emotions at home, with feelings that flow into their opposite.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 10th house (lagna Gemini); blurred, dual communication in career, with confusing messages.
Derived, not said by him: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo); the partner is the other half of a yin-yang pair, with a merging, devoted love.

ambiguity: 'Pyas' is the caption's spelling of Pisces; he ties the symbol to Ketu in his scheme.
classical_check: Agrees that Pisces is the sign of two fishes and of dissolving boundaries; the yin-yang reading is his own.

hindi: तो अध्यात्म की ओर लेकर जाता है केतु
says: Ketu leads a person toward spirituality; the end of Ketu's road is the spiritual.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha and spiritual-seeking karaka, though it conflicts with his own Ketu-as-pleasure line a few lines earlier.

hindi: इसीलिए कहते हैं कुत्ता कुत्ता दरवेश है कुत्ता वो है जो यमराज के साथ ऊपर तक
says: That is why they say the dog is a dervish, a wandering ascetic; the dog is the one who goes with Yamraj all the way up, to the other world; the sentence is cut off before it ends.
ambiguity: Ketu is not named; the dog is taken as Ketu's animal from the 'that is why' link to the spirituality line. The sentence continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the dog is associated with Ketu in tradition, and the dog accompanying Yama is Vedic; the dervish image is his own.

gist: Mythology that Dharmraj's gate to heaven is led by a dog; he says he does not know if these added stories are true but finds them beautiful.
Dog-faced guardians outside Egyptian pyramids and the Dogon tribe in Africa; says it is a different story already covered in the aliens class.

hindi: ये वरुण है सात नंबर तुला तराजू देखा है आपने तुला राशि लिब्रा बोलते हैं इसको इंग्लिश में तराजू
says: He assigns Varuna (Neptune in his 12-planet scheme) to sign number 7, Libra, and explains Libra as the weighing scale, so Neptune is read through the symbol of a balance.
ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is the sign number (Libra = 7) here, not a house.
classical_check: Classical texts give Libra to Venus only; Neptune as co-lord of Libra is Gautam's own scheme.

hindi: ये वरुण है सबसे शक्तिशाली यानी तराजू प्लस भी उतना ही होएगा माइनस भी उतना होएगा इसलिए आप जन्म कुंडली में जितने मर्जी उपाय कर लो प्लस होएगा तो माइनस जरूर होएगा
says: Varuna is the most powerful and works like a scale, so every plus it gives is matched by an equal minus; however many remedies are done, a gain in the chart will be balanced by a loss and the reverse.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the plus-minus balance applies to Neptune's own results only or to the whole chart.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Neptune and no rule that gains are offset equally.

hindi: हर पिटाई के बाद जिस व्यक्ति ने ज्ञान कर लिया इसमें कोई शिक्षा यार अच्छे के लिए हो रहा है कोई कीमत देनी पड़ेगी उसने वरुण जेता की कृपा ले ली
says: A person who takes a lesson after every setback, accepts that a price must be paid for good things and treats the blow as meant for his good, has won Varuna's grace.
ambiguity: The caption 'वरुण जेता' is garbled, probably just Varuna; the middle clause is jumbled.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not in classical texts.

hindi: आपको कृपा मिलेगी जीवन भर अगर आप तराजू में तोल के चल रहे हैं
says: Grace of Varuna lasts a whole lifetime for the person who goes through life weighing everything fairly like a scale, giving and taking in balance.
classical_check: Silent: a behavioural remedy of Gautam's, not a classical one.

gist: Langar anecdote: a man who got no roti tells another diner the dal-paratha tastes stale and ruins that man's enjoyment, with the dialogue acted out.

hindi: लेकर तुम भी जाओगे लेकिन उसे बिगाड़ के जा रहे हो तुम्हें कृपा नहीं मिलेगी तुम हमेशा दरिद्री रहोगे कभी उठ नहीं सकते
says: Someone who spoils another person's contentment, even while taking his own share, will not receive Varuna's grace and will stay poor and unable to rise; this is the penalty of upsetting the balance.
ambiguity: It is a moral warning; he gives no chart placement that triggers it.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give this behaviour-to-poverty rule.

hindi: इसलिए सोचो अरे जो मिला बढ़िया मिला मेरे दोस्तों को इतना मिल गया मुझे नहीं मिला भाई उनको देख जो यह गाना तेरे लिए गा रहे हैं
says: Attitude advice: be content with what you got and do not compare yourself with friends who got more, because envy of what others received is the opposite of the balanced attitude Varuna rewards.
ambiguity: The song reference at the end is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह चक्र है पूरा यह गोला घूम रहा है सबके साथ यही है
says: Life is a complete wheel that keeps turning for everyone, so what one person gets now will come around to others too; this is the justification for not envying.
ambiguity: Could mean the zodiac wheel or the general wheel of fortune.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए वरुण के साथ कृपा लेनी है तो तुला तराजू तराजू में तोल के चलो बस बना के रखो दादागिरी नहीं करते
says: Remedy for Varuna's grace: act like a Libra scale, weigh your dealings, keep relations balanced and do not bully or dominate others.
classical_check: Silent: behavioural remedy, no classical counterpart for Neptune.

hindi: वरुण को मानने वाले हमेशा कहते तू भी खा ले मैं भी खा लूं तू मुझे माफ कर और मेरी जिंदगी से दफा हो जा
says: Followers of Varuna are live-and-let-live types who say you eat too and I eat too, and who settle differences by mutual forgiveness, even when asking the other person to leave their life.
ambiguity: The sentence continues across the 53:01 caption break.
classical_check: Silent; closest classical idea is Libra's fair-dealing nature under Venus.

hindi: यानी कि दफा होने के लिए भी माफी मांग लेते हैं वो बैलेंस करके चलते हैं ना सहेंगे हम कष्ट भी नहीं सहेंगे
says: Varuna-type people even apologise while parting ways; they keep a balance in every transaction and aim to neither suffer pain nor inflict it.
ambiguity: The last clause about not bearing pain is garbled and could also read as 'we will not cause pain'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह आपका हो गया कुंभ यमराज कुंभ देवता कुंभ क्या आप देखा होगा कुंभ क्या होता है एक घड़ा
says: Aquarius (Kumbh) is given to Yamraj, i.e. Pluto (Yama) in his scheme, and he explains the sign's symbol as a pitcher.
ambiguity: He does not say here whether Saturn also keeps Aquarius.
classical_check: Classical texts give Aquarius to Saturn; Pluto as lord is Gautam's scheme.

hindi: घड़ा लेकर के पानी पिला रहा है सबको खूब सोशलाइज करता है सब कुछ बता रहा है समझा रहा है प्रेम दे रहा है के ले लो मृत्यु पूरा जीवन दे रही है
says: Aquarius's pitcher-bearer pours water for all: the sign is highly social, shares knowledge, explains things and gives love; he reads death (Yama) as the force that hands over a full life.
cells_derived_method: Sociability, sharing and giving play out through the topic of the house where Aquarius or Pluto sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aquarius on the 3rd house gives a talkative, sharing style of communication and many acquaintances (lagna Sagittarius).
Derived, not said by him: Aquarius on the 11th gives wide social networks and gains through groups (lagna Aries).

ambiguity: Whether the giving nature belongs to the sign or to Pluto as its lord is not distinguished.
classical_check: Classical Aquarius (water-pot bearer, Saturn) is also social and humanitarian, so partly agrees; the Yama link is not classical.

hindi: अब ऐसे ऐसे बिहेवियर के साथ ये राशियां हमारे कुंडली में एक्टिवेट होती हैं और इन्हीं राशियों के फल अलग हो जाते हैं जब यह गलत स्थान पर बैठे होते हैं
says: Each sign carries its own behaviour and gets activated in the chart, but the results of these signs change when the planet is seated in the wrong place; sign nature alone does not fix the result.
ambiguity: 'गलत स्थान' could mean wrong sign or wrong house; the next sentence points to wrong sign.
classical_check: Agrees with classical dignity logic (planet's result depends on the sign it occupies).

hindi: अगर ग्रह अपने अपने राशि से विपरीत राशि में बैठ जाए गड़बड़ इसमें
says: If a planet sits in the sign directly opposite its own sign (the 7th from it), there is trouble and the results go wrong.
cells_derived_method: Take the planet's own sign and move 6 signs on. Sun Leo gives Aquarius, Moon Cancer gives Capricorn, Venus Taurus gives Scorpio, Saturn Capricorn gives Cancer. The house decides which life topic carries the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aquarius, opposite its own Leo, in the 7th (lagna Leo) damages partnership and public standing.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn, opposite its own Cancer, in the 8th (lagna Gemini) disturbs mind and emotional security.
Derived: Venus in Scorpio, opposite its own Taurus, in the 6th (lagna Gemini) strains relationship and comfort matters.
Derived: Saturn in Cancer, opposite its own Capricorn, in the 10th (lagna Libra) weakens discipline and career standing.

ambiguity: 'विपरीत' is read as the opposite sign (7th from the own sign); he does not say whether he means debilitation.
classical_check: Differs: classical debilitation is a different sign for most planets (Sun Libra, Moon Scorpio), though Mars Libra, Venus Scorpio and Jupiter Gemini are enemy signs, so it partly overlaps.

hindi: जब आपकी कुंडली में यह 12 भाव तो फिक्स हो गए 12 राशियां कहीं ना कहीं तो प्लेस होएगी चाहे एक नंबर शुरू यहां से हो चाहे यहां से कहीं से भी हो पर वो घूमेगा
says: The 12 houses are fixed positions in the chart and the 12 signs are placed into them; sign number 1 can start at any house, which makes the lagna sign vary, but the wheel then runs in its fixed order.
classical_check: Agrees: fixed bhavas with the sign wheel rotated by lagna.

hindi: इसलिए नहीं घूमता क्योंकि धरती जो है वो एंटी क्लॉक वाइज घूमती है इसलिए उल्टा बना हुआ है
says: He explains the chart's anticlockwise sign order by saying the earth rotates anticlockwise, so houses and signs are drawn running in the reverse (anticlockwise) direction.
ambiguity: The opening 'इसलिए नहीं घूमता' is garbled; the clear part is the anticlockwise explanation.
classical_check: Classical texts only give the order of signs; the earth-rotation reason is Gautam's own.

gist: He draws a chart and reads out sign numbers 1, 4, 10, 11, 12, 2, 3 but the caption is garbled.
Analogy of a newborn's first medical report (blood group, eosinophil count, haemoglobin) as the starting snapshot at birth.

hindi: ये ऐसे आपकी राशियां जन्म के टाइम अरेंज है यह आपकी हो गई मास्टर कुंडली जन्म कुंडली
says: The arrangement of signs at the moment of birth, like a snapshot, is the master chart (janma kundali); it is the base from which everything else is read.
classical_check: Agrees: the birth chart is the root chart in all classical systems.

hindi: जन्म के टाइम आप पैदा हुए तो क्या था आपकी कुंडली में आपका लगन 10 नंबर था
says: For his worked example he takes a person whose lagna at birth is sign number 10, Capricorn, so Capricorn rises as the 1st house.
ambiguity: '10 नंबर' is the sign number (Capricorn); in the later sentence '10 नंबर में सूरज' it may be sign or house.
classical_check: Silent: example set-up.

hindi: अभी जो राशियों की मूवमेंट होती है उसकी बात हम नहीं करेंगे क्योंकि बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है वो कि अभी 10 नंबर लगन वाली कुंडली भी काम कर रही है 11 वाली भी कर रही है या नौ वाली भी
says: He postpones the movement of signs because it is complicated, but says that at the same time the chart with lagna 10 is working, the chart with lagna 11 is working and the one with lagna 9 is also working, i.e. neighbouring lagnas act together.
ambiguity: Could mean the moving or transiting lagna, or that a house is touched by neighbouring signs. Both readings give the same cells.
classical_check: Partly agrees: bhava chalit and Sripati views let a house span two signs; running three lagnas together is not a classical rule.

gist: An astrologer's mind should be as fast as a housewife who cooks, talks on the phone, writes and drives at once; the sentence ends in the next caption.
After thousands of cases the brain gets polished, and one glance at a photo of a chart makes you remember it.

hindi: यह वरुण करके देगा आपको कृपा सारी कृपा उसी के पास है टोटल
says: Varuna is the planet through whom grace comes; he holds all the grace in total, so he is treated as the karaka of divine favour.
ambiguity: The first words are garbled; the meaning is that all grace is with Varuna.
classical_check: Silent: classically grace is linked to Jupiter, not to Neptune.

hindi: फिर आपका ईष्ट होगा ईष्ट का स्थान यहां से है ये पूर्व जन्म के देवता का स्थान है ऐसे ऐसे कुंडली के स्थान फिक्स वाले हैं
says: Pointing to a particular place in the chart he says it is the seat of the ishta (personal deity) and the place of the deity of a previous life; chart places have fixed meanings.
cells_derived_method: The house he points to is not named in the caption; if it is the 5th, the deity reading comes from the 5th house topic across all signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the place is the 5th, then Leo on the 5th (lagna Aries) shows a deity worshipped with solar, authority-linked devotion.
Derived: if the place is the 5th, then Scorpio on the 5th (lagna Cancer) shows intense, secretive or tantric-style devotion.

ambiguity: He points at the diagram and never names the house; 5th is the usual classical guess but is not confirmed.
classical_check: Classically the 5th (purva punya) and 9th indicate ishta devata; Jaimini uses Karakamsa. Not confirmed from this caption.

hindi: ये लगन हो गया आपका अब यहां यहां पर से सूरज देवता मान लो यहां है सूरज आपका 10 नंबर में है
says: He marks the first slot as the lagna and then places the Sun in number 10 for the example, putting the Sun in the 10-numbered sign Capricorn.
ambiguity: '10 नंबर' is read as sign number 10; it could be the 10th house. He then ties it to Saturn's sign, so it is Capricorn.
classical_check: Silent: example set-up.

hindi: तो सूरज आपका किसकी राशि में आ गया ये यह शनि की राशि में है तो सूरज शनि का 10 नंबर में क्या करेगा अपना तेज छूट जाएगा उसका तेज खत्म हो जाता है
says: The Sun in Capricorn is in Saturn's sign; there it loses its brilliance and the light of the Sun is finished.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's lost brightness shows on the topic of the house holding Capricorn: self in the 1st, home in the 4th, partner in the 7th, status in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) gives a dull self-image and low vitality of personality.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) lowers prestige of the partner or the public image.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) weakens comfort and respect in the home.

ambiguity: Whether Aquarius, also Saturn's sign, gives the same loss is not said.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Sun in Capricorn is in an enemy sign and weakened but is not debilitated.

hindi: जान नहीं है इसमें तो सूरज बड़ा नॉर्मल सा चलेगा यानी बहुत जानदार बहुत लाजवाब लगन नहीं है
says: With the Sun in that condition there is no life in it, so the Sun runs as an ordinary planet and this is not a vibrant, outstanding lagna.
cells_derived_method: Reading holds for the Sun-in-Saturn's-sign pattern in the 1st; in other houses the lack of brilliance moves to that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives an average career profile and little authority.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) mutes the personality in public and gives a lack of visibility.

ambiguity: 'लगन' here refers to the example chart with Capricorn lagna and Sun in the lagna.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts say Sun in Capricorn lagna is weak in vitality, but they do not call the person ordinary.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति लाइफ के अंदर कोई बहुत भयंकर ऊंची पर्सनालिटी नहीं बन रहा
says: A person with this weak Sun does not grow into a towering, very high personality in life.
ambiguity: The outcome is stated for the whole chart, not for a specific house.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the weak Sun in an enemy sign.

hindi: लेकिन ये बहुत ऊंची पर्सनालिटी कैसे बन सकता है अगर मान लो मंगल होता मंगल 10 नंबर में सर्वश्रेष्ठ सबसे ताकतवर है
says: The same person could become a very high personality if Mars were in sign number 10, Capricorn, where Mars is at its best and strongest, i.e. exalted.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Mars gives most strength in kendra and trikona houses, where the topic of that house gets the force.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives command, career power and a leadership name.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 4th (lagna Libra) gives strong land, property and home authority.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 5th (lagna Virgo) gives a bold, strategic mind and children with courage.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 8th (lagna Gemini) gives resilience in crisis, but the strength is turned to hidden or risky areas.

ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next caption block; 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ' is read as 'exalted'.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, and in a kendra it makes Ruchaka yoga.

hindi: ये राजा शनि के घर पर आया है बिल्कुल नौकर चाकर गरीब भिखारी कंगाल जैसा नौकर है उसका काम करता उसकी झुग्गी में आ गया राजा ने अपना ही तेज खो दिया
says: Saturn is treated as a poor servant-like figure whose house is a slum; when the Sun, the king, enters Saturn's house the king loses his own brilliance.
ambiguity: He calls it Saturn's house without naming the sign; both Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's.
classical_check: Agrees on Sun and Saturn being enemies; the servant and beggar portrait of Saturn is his own colour.

hindi: राजा ही चला गया बाहर निकल के उसके झोपड़ी से तो लोगों ने पहचानने से इंकार कर दिया क मैला को चला दबाओ यहां से साले तू क्या है
says: When the king steps out of the hut, people refuse to recognise him and drive him away as dirty; so a Sun in Saturn's sign is not recognised or respected by society.
ambiguity: A story used to carry the point; the effect (no public recognition) is inferred.
classical_check: Silent: classical Sun-Saturn enmity does not state this.

hindi: अब मंगल महाराज भी आ गए आग रोशनी लेकर सब साफ कर दिया रोशनी आते सारी कीचड़ साफ खतम गायब राजा उसकी जगमगाहट में कमाल निकल के आएगा
says: If Mars arrives, he brings fire and light that cleans all the mud away, and then the Sun comes out of Saturn's hut shining brilliantly; Mars is the remedy for a spoiled Sun.
ambiguity: How Mars arrives (conjunction, aspect or placement) is not said.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no such cancellation rule; Mars friendly to the Sun is the nearest idea.

hindi: तो राजा काम कब करेगा मान लो मंगल का यह सपोर्ट है तब जाकर के यहां काम करेगा यह इस प्रकार से इसका फलित बनता है
says: The Sun in Saturn's sign will deliver results only when Mars supports it; this is how the result of this combination is built.
ambiguity: 'सपोर्ट' is vague: it may mean conjunction, aspect, or Mars in a good sign.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Announces that next he will first learn the game of exalted and debilitated signs.

hindi: सूरज अपनी राशि में बैठा है तो यह उसकी यहां पर अच्छी राशि हो गई यह बहुत बढ़िया फल हो गया
says: The Sun seated in its own sign is in a good sign and gives a very good result.
cells_derived_method: The good result lands on the topic of the house where Leo falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo) gives a confident, commanding personality.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) gives respect for father, fortune and dharma.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius) gives a dignified partner but a dominating style in marriage.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 12th (lagna Virgo) is strong in itself but its power goes to expenses and foreign matters.

classical_check: Agrees: Leo is the Sun's own sign.

gist: Pointing at the diagram he starts naming planets (Moon very good here, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Neptune 'basically Indra') but the caption is garbled and conflicts with Varuna=Neptune.

hindi: अपनी अपनी राशि के अंदर ग्रह बैठे हुए हैं य इनकी अपनी अपनी राशिया है अब यह ग्रह अपने अपने घर में तो है ही बढ़िया
says: Each planet seated in a sign that belongs to it, its own house, is already in a good position; this is the base level of strength before he moves on to even better signs.
cells_derived_method: The good result of an own-sign planet reaches the topic of the house where that sign falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in its own Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries) gives a settled home and emotional comfort.
Derived: Jupiter in its own Sagittarius in the 11th (lagna Aquarius) supports gains and wise friends.
Derived: Mars in its own Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio) gives strength against rivals and in service.

classical_check: Agrees: a planet in its own sign (swakshetra) is classically strong.

gist: In-laws analogy: a son-in-law is pampered at his wife's house, and a girl says she came from a poor home and now has servants and a car at her in-laws', so she is queen there.

hindi: यानी कोई एक और घर ऐसा है जहां पर आप अपने घर से भी ज्यादा खुश है आप कहते यार यहां तो मेरे लॉटरी लगी हुई है तो ऐसा घर और का किसकिस का कहां कहा पर हुआ
says: Principle behind exaltation: there is another planet's house where a planet is even happier than in its own, like hitting a lottery, and he sets out to name which planet gets this in which sign.
ambiguity: He does not call it exaltation here; the list that follows shows it is the exaltation sign.
classical_check: Agrees: classically exaltation is the sign where a planet is strongest, usually stronger than own sign.

hindi: सूर्य आपका जब एक नंबर में आता है ना तो पांच से भी ज्यादा ताकतवर फल देता है
says: The Sun in sign number 1, Aries, gives more powerful results than in sign number 5, Leo, which is its own sign.
cells_derived_method: The extra strength lands on the topic of the house where Aries falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) gives a very strong and commanding personality.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) gives high career status and authority.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) gives strong intelligence and a leadership flair in creative work.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) is strong, but the strength goes into foreign matters, retreat and expenses.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर' is read as the sign Aries (sign number 1), not the 1st house.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is exalted in Aries.

hindi: यह सेनापति के घर आया मंगल इसका बेटा समझो ज्यादा बढ़िया फल देता है
says: Aries is the house of the commander Mars, and he treats Mars as the Sun's son-like figure, which is why the Sun feels at home and gives the better result there.
ambiguity: The caption gives no word for 'Aries'; it is inferred from the 'commander's house' and the previous sentence.
classical_check: Classically the Sun and Mars are friends; calling Mars the Sun's son is Gautam's colour.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा जो है ये अपने घर में तो है ही है लेकिन जब दो नंबर शुक्र के घर आती है चंद्रमा बहुत बढ़िया
says: The Moon is good in its own Cancer, but when it comes to sign number 2, Taurus, the house of Venus, it is very much better.
cells_derived_method: The better Moon helps the topics of the house where Taurus falls: mind, comfort, mother and public.
