derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 1st (lagna Taurus) gives a calm, attractive and well-liked personality.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) gives deep peace at home and a good bond with the mother.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives a gentle, comfort-loving partner.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' is the sign Taurus.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is exalted in Taurus.

gist: Analogy that the Moon coming to Venus's house is like a samdhan visiting her in-laws, who welcome her and press her feet; the sentence runs into the next block.
In old times the daughter-in-law's feet were touched; here they are not touched but pressed and the calves rubbed, shown with a gesture.

hindi: यहां पर हार्ट का हमारा एक पंप भी लगा हुआ है बूढ़े लोगों को कहते हैं चलो चलो हार्ट हमारी यहां है नेपच्यून भी यहां पर है वरुण देवता भी यहां है दिल का मामला ठीक रखना कृपा चाहिए
says: He claims the calves hold a second pump of the heart, which is why old people are told to keep walking, and that Neptune (Varuna) also sits in this region, so keeping the heart in order needs Varuna's grace.
ambiguity: He points to the calves on the body and does not name the sign; Aquarius rules calves in classical body mapping but he does not say so. Health remark, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent: classical body mapping puts the calves under Aquarius and Neptune is not classical.

hindi: बोले यार कितने पूछ करता है बंदा पिंडलियों की मालिश करते हैं पिंडलियों ये ऐसे चलते हैं बच्चे उचक उचक के बच्चे तो एड़ी टिका नहीं उचक उचक के इसलिए दिल खुश रहता है
says: Children walk bouncing on their toes without letting the heel rest, which works the calves, and therefore the heart stays happy; massaging the calves is likewise linked to a happy heart.
ambiguity: The first half of the sentence is garbled; the toe-walking observation is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खुशी में आप कैसे कूदते हैं ये उछलता है ये उछलना का मतलब क्या है आपका वरुण पंप अप है
says: When happy you jump up, and that jumping means your Varuna is pumped up; so joy and the lift of the body are signs of Neptune being active.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not classical.

gist: Doctors tell elderly people to walk when they are heart patients; the sentence continues that you have become old, and 'old' means the heart is old.

hindi: उम्र आपकी 20 साल की है लेकिन आप बुड्ढे हो सकते हैं उम्र आपकी 60 साल की हो सकती है लेकिन आप जवान हो सकते हैं कैसे हो सकते हैं अगर वरुण यानी कृपा लेना नहीं छोड़ी
says: Being old is about the heart, not years: a 20-year-old can be old and a 60-year-old can stay young, if he does not stop receiving Varuna's grace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बड़े हो के हम अहंकार करना शुरू कर देते हैं समझदार होना चाहिए लेकिन और गधे हो जाते हैं और हल्का होना चाहिए छोड़ देना सीखना चाहिए छोड़ते नहीं हम
says: As we grow up we become egoistic and stubborn instead of wise; the cure is to become light and learn to let go, which is what keeps Varuna's grace flowing.
ambiguity: The word before 'होना चाहिए' is garbled; read as 'हल्का' (light).
classical_check: Silent: a behaviour remedy.

hindi: ये चंद्रमा और भी लाजवाब फल देता है दो नंबर में यार कमाल का फल देगा यहां तो और भयंकर अगर किसी की कुंडली में दो नंबर का चंद्रमा कहीं भी बैठा है आग लगा दी
says: The Moon in sign 2, Taurus, in any house gives an outstanding result; whoever has this Moon placed anywhere in the chart gets a blazing, top-class outcome.
cells_derived_method: House changes the area that benefits, while the strength of the Moon stays high.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra) gives emotional resilience and gains from hidden or inherited sources.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo) gives public popularity and a steady, well-liked career.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) gives strong mother support and a peaceful home.

ambiguity: 'कहीं भी बैठा' is read as any house.
classical_check: Agrees on exalted Moon in Taurus being strong; classical texts still reduce the result in dusthana houses and by afflictions.

hindi: राम जी का चंद्रमा चार नंबर का था कृष्ण जी का दो नंबर का था और टॉप टॉप इससे टॉप है ही नहीं
says: He cites Rama's Moon in sign 4 (Cancer) and Krishna's Moon in sign 2 (Taurus), and says there is nothing higher than this top class of Moon.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether he ranks the Taurus Moon above the Cancer Moon; he treats both as top.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual traditional charts: Rama's Moon in Cancer and Krishna's in Taurus.

hindi: अब बैठे बिठाए ही कृपा मिल रही है बंदे को कुछ नहीं करके राजी है वो
says: With this top Moon the person receives grace without effort; he is content and happy while doing nothing in particular.
classical_check: Silent: exalted Moon is classically comfortable but effortless grace is not stated.

hindi: उसको क्या करना है चंद्रमा अपने मन को संभालना है या साक्षी भाव करना
says: What the Moon person must do is keep his mind steady, or practise the witness attitude, watching thoughts without being swept away.
classical_check: Silent: classical Moon remedies are rituals, not witness practice.

hindi: यह मम्मी के पांव दबाने सोचो मम्मी के पांव दबाने से काम हो जाएगा लेकिन मम्मी के पांव दबाना बड़ा भारी काम होता है लोगों का
says: Remedy for the Moon: serve the mother and press her feet, which would do the work, though he adds that many people find this a heavy task.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: serving the mother is a classical Moon upaya.

hindi: मम्मी ना तो फिर मम्मी गोद लो
says: If one's own mother is not there, adopt a mother figure to serve in her place, so the Moon remedy can still be done.
ambiguity: 'मम्मी ना तो फर' is garbled; read as 'if there is no mother, then adopt one'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts name the mother or an elder woman, not adoption.

hindi: बच्चे की मम्मी तो शुक्र हो गई बच्चे की मम्मी शुक्र हो गई ये और लफड़ा है फायदा उसका नहीं होगा आप उसका नुकसान कर देंगे उल्टा यह गड़बड़ हो जाएगी
says: Warning on the mother remedy: your child's mother, i.e. your wife, is Venus and not the Moon, so doing the feet-pressing remedy for her does not give the Moon's benefit and can backfire.
ambiguity: The sentence is jumbled; the child's mother being Venus is clear, the harm clause is less so.
classical_check: Agrees that the wife is Venus; the warning is his own.

gist: A run of garbled words about medicine, Mars and 'now do not press' follows; no usable claim.

hindi: मंगल मंगल शनि के घर में सर्वोत्तम फल देता है अग्नि पेट्रोल में जाती है अग्नि सबसे अपने घर से भी ज्यादा अच्छा फल देता है मंगल यहां
says: Mars gives its best result in Saturn's house, Capricorn, even better than in its own, because fire meeting petrol blazes up.
cells_derived_method: The force of the exalted Mars goes to the topic of the house where Capricorn falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives drive, command and rise in the career.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) gives strong property and a powerful home base.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) gives energy for foreign work and secret efforts, with expenses.

ambiguity: Saturn also owns Aquarius; he means Capricorn since the sign is the exaltation sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn.

hindi: बुध जो है राहु के घर में बेस्ट फल देता है बुध वाणी है
says: Mercury gives its best result in Rahu's house, which in his scheme is Virgo, and Mercury stands for speech.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's best result falls on the topic of the house where Virgo sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a career built on speech, analysis and trade.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) gives sharp intelligence and skill in writing.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces) gives a clever, talkative partner and good business partnerships.

ambiguity: He says 'Rahu's house' without naming the sign; Virgo is inferred from Rahu's sign in his scheme and Mercury's exaltation.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; Rahu as lord of Virgo is Gautam's scheme.

hindi: आपकी वाणी अगर इसके एक्सप्रेशन पर आ जाए राहु के तो आप जबान से ही दुनिया जीत सकते हो पूरी दुनिया जीत सकते हो
says: If speech reaches the full expression that Rahu's house gives it, a person can conquer the whole world with his tongue alone.
ambiguity: Whether the world conquest is meant literally or as influence is open.
classical_check: Silent: a rhetorical claim, not a classical rule.

hindi: बृहस्पति महाराज चंद्रमा के घर में सबसे बढ़िया यानी ज्ञान अगर मन में ज्ञान आ जाए तो रॉकेट है चार नंबर का
says: Jupiter does best in the Moon's house, sign number 4, Cancer, because knowledge entering the mind makes it a rocket.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's rocket-like force acts on the topic of the house where Cancer falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer) gives wisdom, good judgement and a respected personality.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives a wise, caring partner and gains through partnership.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) gives strong fortune, teachers and dharma.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 6th (lagna Aquarius) is exalted but sits in a dusthana, so its strength goes to service, debts and healing work.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is the sign Cancer.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: बृहस्पति रॉकेट की तरह काम करता है इससे ज्यादा ताकतवर कहीं है ही नहीं
says: Jupiter in Cancer works like a rocket and he says there is no place where Jupiter is stronger than this.
classical_check: Agrees that Cancer is Jupiter's strongest sign.

hindi: शुक्र 12 नंबर केतु के घर केतु क्या है छाया वो बादल शुक्र क्या है पर्दा मिल जाए ना अगर शुक्र को
says: Venus in sign number 12, Pisces, Ketu's house: Ketu is a shadow or cloud that acts like a screen for Venus, and he sees that as the setting where Venus works best.
cells_derived_method: Venus's luxury gets cover and depth in the topic of the house where Pisces falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries) gives luxury and pleasure in bed, foreign lands and retreat.
Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo) gives a loving, refined partner and a rich married life.
Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a luxurious home and vehicles.

ambiguity: The caption 'शश' for the word before 'पर्दा' is garbled; the curtain image is read as Ketu's cover for Venus.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is exalted in Pisces; Ketu as lord of Pisces is his own scheme.

hindi: तो धरती की सबसे बड़ी ऐश खोर है अयाशी का देवता ऐश करा सकता है अयाशी का देवता वैसे इंद्र है
says: Venus is the biggest pleasure-seeker on earth and can give a life of indulgence, though he adds that the real god of debauchery is Indra (Uranus).
ambiguity: It is unclear whether Indra is meant as a rival of Venus for this role or just a side remark.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus rules luxury; assigning debauchery to Indra (Uranus) is his own scheme.

hindi: इतनी ऐश कराएगा कि आप बैठे बिठाए इतना पैसा आपके पास बोरों में नोट नोटों में बोरे बोरे में नोट ऐसा कुछ आएगा अपने आप
says: Venus in this sign brings so much comfort that money arrives by itself in sackfuls without effort; this is a claim of windfall wealth, not a financial forecast.
ambiguity: A rhetorical exaggeration; no house is given.
classical_check: Silent: exalted Venus is classically a wealth giver but the sack-of-notes picture is his own.

gist: An aside asking someone to fix something for him ('please put it right').

hindi: वरुण क्या है समुद्र देवता है समुद्र वरुण देव और समुद्र के नीचे क्या है पूरी धरती है सारा का सारा खजाना जो समुद्र में वो आपका अपना है मान के चलो
says: Varuna is the sea god and the whole treasure of the earth lies beneath the sea; he asks us to take that entire treasure as our own, so Varuna stands for hidden wealth and depth.
ambiguity: The lead-in 'शनि जब इतना बड़ा होगा' is jumbled.
classical_check: Silent: Varuna as sea god is Vedic, but Neptune's rulership is modern.

hindi: तो शनि जब ये वरुण देव के घर आता है सबसे ज्यादा ताकतवर फल है इसका
says: Saturn gives its most powerful result when it comes to Varuna's house, Libra, which in his scheme is Neptune's sign.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's top strength acts on the topic of the house where Libra falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) gives a disciplined, lasting career and authority.

says: What genuine letting go sounds like: 'from today it is over, I dropped the relation, I will not cry over it', and with that even the quarrel itself ends.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये बातें कौन कर रहा है ये राहु और गुरु कर रहे हैं राहु कर रहा है और गुरु ज्ञान आ रहा है बोल कौन रहा है बुध बोल रहा है एक्सप्रेशन किसका है चंद्रमा कहां से बह रहा है सूर्य
says: Using the lecture itself as an example: the idea comes from Rahu, the knowledge from Jupiter, the speech from Mercury, the expression from the Moon and the source or flow from the Sun, all working together as he speaks.
ambiguity: The mapping of Moon to expression and Sun to source is loose in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury as speech and Jupiter as knowledge; Rahu as idea-maker and Moon as expression are his own.

hindi: यह किसने राज खोल के दिया यह वरुण ने खोल के दिया राज हमें क्या पता है ना हमने पढ़ाई करी ना लिखाई करी ना किसी किताब में ये परमात्मा अपने आप दे रहा है ये कौन दे रहा है गुरु
says: The secret was opened by Varuna (Neptune): he says he has not studied this from any book, it is the Paramatma giving it directly, so Neptune stands for revealed knowledge and the guru's grace.
ambiguity: A claim about his own source of knowledge; it cannot be checked.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not classical and intuitive knowledge is classically Jupiter or Ketu.

hindi: कौन सा गुरु परमात्मा कहां कृपा वरुण कैसे सब मेरे गुरु हो सबको प्रणाम है हो गया वरुण सेट तूने मुझे गाली बकी मैंने तुझे दफा किया जिंदगी से तू भी मेरा गुरु है लेकिन तेरे से सीखा कृपा तुझसे भी लूंगा
says: Treat everyone as a guru, even one who abused you: remove him from your life but acknowledge what you learned and take grace from him too; this attitude sets Varuna right.
ambiguity: The start of the sentence runs in from the previous block and is jumbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बच्चे से भी कृपा ले ली वो भी हमने जान लिया ये 6 पर गुरु पे छोड़ दिया इस भेद को समझो 12 पर होता है चार या छह तीन रास्ते से हम 72 को चेंज कर सकते हैं यही मेनिफेस्टेशन है
says: He sums up three routes to change the 72 level: the mind at 12 (6 times), the guru at 6 (12 times) and the Self at 4 (18 times); using any of them is what he calls manifestation.
ambiguity: The caption gives '12, four or six, three ways'; the 3 routes are read as 12, 6 and 4 from the surrounding numbers.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Choose whichever route you like; he jokes that his own brain gets spoiled often.
Introduces the next topic: a big misconception in Jyotish about the question 'what is my rashi'.

hindi: राशि शब्द का हिंदी का अर्थ हो गया चंद्रमा चंद्रमा मेष वृष मिथुन कर्क इत्यादि एक दो तीन चार पांच नंबर कहां है कुंडली में बैठा हो वो आपके जन्म की राशि है
says: In Hindi the word rashi means the Moon's sign: whichever sign number the Moon occupies in the kundali is the person's birth rashi.
classical_check: Agrees: janma rashi is the Moon sign in Vedic astrology.

hindi: लोग बोलते हैं कि नहीं अगर चंद्रमा मान लो सिंह राशि का है यानी पांच नंबर का है कुंडली में तो कुछ लोग बोलते हैं क्या लियो है लियो
says: If the Moon is in Simha, sign number 5, the Hindi rashi is Simha, but some people say 'Leo' for it, which brings in the English name and a different system.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the 1:16:08 block.
classical_check: Agrees on Simha being Leo and sign number 5.

hindi: क्योंकि इंग्लिश में सिंह को लियो बोलते हैं तो जब इंग्लिश शब्द बोल दिया गया लियो तो राशि तो पांच है लेकिन एक्चुअली वो बात कर रहे हैं सूर्य की कि कुंडली में सूर्य कितने नंबर राशि में बैठा है
says: When someone uses the English word Leo, they are actually talking about the Sun's sign and not the Moon's: in the English or Western way the zodiac sign is the sign number where the Sun sits.
classical_check: Agrees: Western sun sign versus Vedic Moon sign; note Western signs are tropical, not Lahiri sidereal.

hindi: यह मेष है एरीज राशि दो नंबर है वृष टोरस तीन नंबर हो गया मिथुन जेमिनी चार कैंसर ऐसे कर्क राशि
says: He recites the numbering with Hindi and English names: Mesh Aries 1, Vrish Taurus 2, Mithun Gemini 3, Kark Cancer 4, confirming Aries as number 1.
ambiguity: The numbers in the caption are shifted by one in places (he says Taurus is 'two number' and Gemini 'three') but the order is clear.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard zodiac order.

hindi: जब चंद्रमा पांच नंबर का है तो राशि हुई सिंह और जोडियक है जहां सूर्य बैठा है सूर्य पता लगा आपका छह नंबर में बैठा है तो वर्गो हो गई
says: Worked example: with the Moon in sign 5 the rashi is Simha, and if the Sun sits in sign 6 then the zodiac (Western) sign is Virgo.
ambiguity: The numbers are an illustration, not a real person's chart.
classical_check: Agrees as a description of Moon sign versus Sun sign; classical tradition uses the Moon sign for the rashi.

hindi: चंद्रमा की राशि अब ये चंद्रमा की राशि है यहां पर सूर्य की राशि क्या है एक नंबर शुक्र की राशि क्या है दो तो जोडियक आपका क्या है एरीज
says: Another example: the Moon sign is read from where the Moon is, the Sun sign from where the Sun is (sign 1) and the Venus sign from sign 2, so in this example the zodiac sign is Aries.
ambiguity: It is an illustration; the pointer words are unclear in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees as a counting method.

hindi: शुक्र का भी एक जोडियक है जिसकी बात कोई नहीं करता बुध का भी जोडियक है बृहस्पति का भी जोडियक है यूरेनस नेपच्यून प्लूटो सबका एक एक जोडियक है हम सिर्फ चंद्रमा की और सूर्य की बात करते हैं
says: Every planet, from Venus and Mercury to Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, has its own zodiac sign position in the chart, but people only ever talk about the Sun's and the Moon's.
classical_check: Agrees that each planet occupies a sign; the 'Venus sign' idea is also used in classical analysis.

hindi: चंद्रमा इसलिए क्योंकि हम हिंदू सिस्टम की बात कर रहे लूनर सिस्टम और वेस्टर्न सिस्टम पर जाते हैं तो सूर्य
says: The Moon is used because we are in the Hindu lunar system, while in the Western system people switch to the Sun.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in 'तो सूर्य' and is continued in the next clause; the caption has a garbled stretch.
classical_check: Agrees: Vedic astrology is Moon-sign based and Western is Sun-sign based.

hindi: सूर्य तो दो की राशि का हर कोई सिंह राशि वाला लियो देखता रहता है लियो राशि वाला जो है वो सिंह देखता रहता है जबकि अलग अलग है सन का साइन
says: People keep mixing up the Simha (Moon) person and the Leo (Sun) person by reading the wrong sign for themselves, though Sun sign and Moon sign are two different things.
ambiguity: The first half of the sentence is garbled ('दो की राशि का इपा पड़ा रहता है').
classical_check: Agrees that Sun sign and Moon sign are distinct.

hindi: जो देखते जोडियक बर्थडे मंथ से होगा और उस पूरे महीने में जोडियक एक ही राशि होगी सूर्य की और उस पूरे महीने में 12 की 12 राशियां चंद्रमा की आ सकती हैं वो उसके साथ चलेगा ही चलेगा यह हिसाब फिक्स है
says: The Western zodiac is fixed by the birth month so the Sun sign stays the same for the whole month, but within that month the Moon can pass through all 12 signs, so Moon signs vary among people with the same Sun sign.
ambiguity: The Sun changes sign around the middle of the month and not on the first, so 'whole month' is approximate; Moon takes about 27 days to cover 12 signs.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Sun sign changes about monthly, Moon sign about every 2.25 days.

hindi: यहां हम हर ग्रह अपने से सामने वाले घर के ऊपर नेगेटिव इफेक्ट डालेगा ही डालेगा यानी कि प्रकृति का नियम यह है कि प्लस होने के साथ जिंदगी में माइनस तो होएगा ही और जैसे
says: Every planet casts a negative effect on the house directly opposite it (7th from itself); nature's law is that wherever there is a plus in life there is a minus too, and the sentence ends unfinished.
cells_derived_method: Count 7 houses from the planet to find the house that takes the negative; its sign depends on the lagna and the topic of that house is the target.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) throws its negative on the 4th house, Libra: home peace and mother suffer.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) throws its negative on the 10th house, Aries: career gets hurdles.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn) throws its negative on the 11th house, Scorpio: the child's spouse or gains suffer.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer) throws its negative on the 7th, Capricorn: partnership meets friction despite wisdom.

ambiguity: 'सामने वाला घर' is read as the 7th from the planet; the ending 'और जैसे' is cut.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 7th aspect of a planet is a full aspect that can be benefic or harmful by nature, not always negative.

hindi: ही कुछ माइनस होगा अब प्लस होना ही है यह फर्क आता कि माइनस और प्लस कम और ज्यादा कैसे हो जाता है
says: A planet's result is never purely one sign of the ledger: there is always some minus and some plus together, and what changes from sign to sign is only how large each part becomes.
cells_derived_method: Size of the plus or minus is set by the sign's relation to the planet (exalted, friendly, enemy, debilitated); the house then decides which life topic receives it.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer): plus is large, career and status results are strong with only a small minus.
Sun in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): minus is large, home and mother matters are heavily dimmed, with a small plus left.
Sun in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): plus and minus are near equal, children and study matters are neither lifted nor harmed much.

ambiguity: Caption begins mid-sentence; what 'minus' refers to is in the earlier batch.
classical_check: Classically silent on a plus/minus ledger; it matches the general idea that dignity changes the strength and quality of a result, not whether the planet has any result.

hindi: बाकी राशिया आप समझ ही ले इसके अंदर कि आपके उच्च नीच अच्छी बुरी राशियां उस हिसाब से फल है
says: He tells the audience to work out the remaining signs for themselves: results follow whether the sign is a high or low, good or bad sign for that planet.
cells_derived_method: For each non-extreme sign, grade it between the exalted and debilitated ends by the lord's friendship with the planet.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in own sign Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo): high-grade sign, strong self and vitality.
Sun in enemy Saturn's Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo): low-grade sign, enemies and illness matters get a harder result.
Sun in friend Jupiter's Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): good sign, luck and father matters supported.

classical_check: Consistent with Parashari dignity scale (exalted, own, friend, neutral, enemy, debilitated); the lecture only gives the idea, not a table.

hindi: अब ऐसा ही ग्रह जब कुंडली में कहीं बैठा है तो वो कहीं बुरा असर दे रहा है कहीं अच्छा
says: The same planet, wherever it sits in the chart, gives a bad effect at some placements and a good effect at others; one planet does not have one fixed verdict.
cells_derived_method: Verdict flips with the (house, sign) cell: topic of the house x nature of the sign for that planet.

derived_examples.reading: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): good, strong body and confidence.
Sun in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra): same dignity but the 7th is partnership, so the ego-heavy fire strains marriage and partners.
Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th (lagna Scorpio): bad on dignity but losses and expenses house partly absorbs it.

classical_check: Agrees with classical practice, where a planet's verdict depends on sign, house and lordship.

hindi: जब ऐसा ही ग्रह दूसरे ग्रह की किसी ऐसी राशि में जो मित्र है तो वहां भी फायदा देगा शत्रु है तो वहां भी नुकसान
says: When the planet sits in another planet's sign, the result depends on friendship: if the sign's lord is a friend it still gives benefit, if the lord is an enemy it gives loss.
cells_derived_method: Look up the sign lord, then friend or enemy to the planet; then the house topic receives the benefit or the loss.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in friend Jupiter's Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): benefit to fortune and dharma.
Sun in enemy Saturn's Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): loss to home, mother and peace of mind.
Sun in friend Moon's Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo): gain through foreign or private spending channels.

classical_check: Agrees with Parashari naisargika friend/enemy sign placement (mitra and shatru rashi).

hindi: तो सूर्य यहां सर्वश्रेष्ठ फल दे रहा है बेस्टेस्ट और यहां सबसे वस्ट फल दे रहा है वस्ट खराब
says: On the sign ladder he is drawing, the Sun gives its very best result at one end and its very worst result at the other end.
cells_derived_method: Best cell for Sun is exaltation, worst is debilitation; the house decides which topic is lifted or damaged.

derived_examples.reading: Sun at the best end in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): very strong vitality and name.
Sun at the worst end in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): weakest home and heart results.
Sun best-end in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer): peak career authority.

ambiguity: He does not say which signs are the best and the worst here; Aries and Libra are assumed from the previous batch and classical exaltation.
classical_check: Consistent with Sun exalted in Aries and debilitated in Libra; the signs are not named in this slice.

hindi: तो बाकी राशियों में क्या करेगा तो बाकी राशियों में उसका उसी अनुसार फल मिलेगा जैसा उसका वो मित्र है या शत्रु
says: In the other ten signs the Sun gives a result between the two extremes, graded by whether that sign's lord is its friend or its enemy.
cells_derived_method: Middle signs get a graded result using the lord's friendship with the Sun and then the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in friend Moon's Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini): moderately supportive for wealth and speech.
Sun in enemy Venus's Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra): friction and slow results around the 8th topics.

classical_check: Agrees with classical friend/enemy grading of Sun in the ten non-extreme signs (Moon, Mars, Jupiter friends; Venus, Saturn enemies).

gist: Lead-in: he says he will take a rough chart and starts with 'the Sun, this Sun...' and the sentence is cut by the timestamp.

hindi: सूरज अंकल जैसा सूरज है इतना बड़ा सूरज है आसमान में आग का गोला है ठीक है
says: Describes the Sun in plain terms as a huge ball of fire in the sky, setting up the Sun as the fire planet for the friend/enemy chart.
classical_check: Classical texts call the Sun agni-tattva and soul karaka; the ball of fire description is only a teaching image.

hindi: तो सूर्य के पास क्या है रोशनी रोशनी और गर्मी सूर्य की जब हम बात कर रहे इसका मतलब हम रोशनी की बात कर रहे हैं
says: In his scheme the Sun stands for light and heat; whenever the Sun is discussed it means light first.
classical_check: Classical Sun karakatva is soul, authority, heat and light; light as the core meaning is a simplification.

hindi: यह सूर्य जो है रोशनी है चंद्रमा सारा का सारा पानी है
says: Fixes the element keys: Sun is light, Moon is entirely water.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Moon as watery and the Sun as fiery.

hindi: राहु जो है यह आपके जीवन की बेबसी है केतु जो है बादल है
says: Rahu stands for helplessness in life and Ketu stands for cloud.
classical_check: Not a classical karakatva; classics give Rahu illusion, obsession, foreigners and Ketu detachment, moksha. Helplessness and cloud are his own images.

gist: On Indra (Uranus) he says he will not make any special remark and that the matter will just carry on; the end of the sentence is garbled.

hindi: यह वरुण है यह बैलेंस है समुद्र
says: Varuna (Neptune) is balance and the sea.
classical_check: Neptune is outside classical Jyotish; the sea image is his own system.

hindi: यम वो मौत है जो सास बहु को कहती है जरा सा काम बताते तुझे यम पड़ गया यानी मौत पड़ गई यह वो वाली मौत है
says: Yama (Pluto) is death, in the everyday sense of the word, the same word a mother-in-law uses when a small chore feels like death to the daughter-in-law.
classical_check: Pluto is outside classical Jyotish; Yama as death deity is Puranic. His Pluto = Yama mapping is his own.

gist: Joke on the words 'maun' (silence) and 'maut' (death): he muses about making it all 'maut' and hopes people can tell the two apart.
Lead-in: 'now let us carry on roughly, this light' and the sentence continues in the next chunk.

hindi: अगर रोशनी के रोशनी मौत के घर जाएगी तो क्या होगा मौत हो जाएगी यानी सूरज यमराज कोई खास बढ़िया नहीं है
says: If light goes into the house of death it dies, so Sun with Yama (Pluto) is not a good match.
cells_derived_method: Yama in the Sun's own sign or Sun in Yama's own sign damages the light; the house topic is the one that gets the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Pluto's Aquarius in the 1st (lagna Aquarius): self and vitality dimmed.
Sun in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus): authority and public image damaged.

classical_check: Not in classics (no Pluto); a Sun-Pluto enmity follows from his elemental logic only.

hindi: सूरज की रोशनी नंबर थी पांच अगर पांच नंबर में यमराज आकर बैठ जाएगा तो क्या होगा मौत पड़ जाएगी इसे मार देगा
says: Sun's sign is number 5 (Leo); if Yama (Pluto) sits in sign 5 it kills the light, meaning it badly damages Leo's results.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in Leo: the house that Leo occupies in that chart is hit, so topics change with the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Pluto in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): children and education are damaged.
Pluto in Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius): marriage and partners are damaged.
Pluto in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio): career and authority are damaged.

classical_check: Classics have no Pluto; sign 5 numbering matches Aries=1 numbering (Leo=5), consistent with this series.

hindi: चंद्रमा की राशि थी चार नंबर यह अलग लिख लेते हैं हम यादाश्त के लिए सारा ये यह पांच नंबर है चार है एक है तीन न दो 10 6 12 आ सात और 11
says: He writes down each planet's sign number as a memory list: Sun 5, Moon 4, then the rest as garbled numbers that read as Mars 1, Mercury 3, Jupiter 9, Venus 2, Saturn 10, Rahu 6, Ketu 12, then 8 and 7 and 11.
cells_derived_method: Use as the lookup of which sign belongs to which of his 12 planets when judging 'planet in X's house'.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled: 'तीन न दो' is read as 3, 9, 2 and 'आ सात' as 8, 7. The mapping of the last numbers to Indra, Varuna and Yama is my reading, not stated.
classical_check: Reading Aries=1: Mars Aries, Mercury Gemini, Jupiter Sagittarius, Venus Taurus, Saturn Capricorn agree with classical rulers; Rahu 6, Ketu 12, Indra 8, Varuna 7, Pluto 11 are his scheme.

gist: Repeats that Yama sitting there will kill the light.

hindi: पांच नंबर का अगर यमराज है प्लूटो आपकी कुंडली में तो नास पीट देगा उस घर का संतान स्थान में तो संतान मार देगा
says: Pluto in sign 5 ruins whichever house it occupies; in the children's house it ruins the matters of children, said in his strong style.
cells_derived_method: Same sign, other houses: the house topic that Leo falls on takes the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Pluto in Leo in the 2nd (lagna Cancer): wealth and family speech are ruined.
Pluto in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius): fortune and father matters are ruined.
Pluto in Leo in the 11th (lagna Libra): gains and friends are ruined.

ambiguity: 'संतान मार देगा' is figurative harm to the house of progeny; not a prediction of a child's death.
classical_check: No classical Pluto; Sun-sign affliction in the 5th is classically a putra-sthana concern.

hindi: पढ़ाई के स्थान में पढ़ाई मार देगा पत्नी स्थान में नास पीट देगा
