says: Venus is the planet of our enjoyment.
classical_check: Matches the classical Venus karakatva of pleasure and comforts.

hindi: सूर्य इसको धीरे-धीरे दूर से सुखा सुखा के नष्ट कर देता है
says: The Sun dries Venus slowly from a distance and finally destroys it.
classical_check: Classical combustion of Venus near the Sun agrees in spirit.

hindi: यानी सूरज अगर दो नंबर का पड़ा है कुंडली में तो बर्बाद ये तबाही है बिल्कुल नष्ट ही है खत्म ही है मामला खत्म कर देगा धीरे-धीरे
says: Sun in sign 2 (Taurus, Venus's sign) is a ruinous placement: it finishes the matter slowly, like drying out ghee.
cells_derived_method: Damage lands on whichever house topic sits in Taurus in that chart; marriage if Taurus is the 7th, children if the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): family wealth and speech dry out slowly.
Sun in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): children and creativity are damaged.
Sun in Taurus in the 9th (lagna Virgo): fortune and father are dampened.

classical_check: Classics call Sun in Taurus only mildly unfavorable (neutral to enemy sign), not ruinous, so he is far harsher than the texts.

hindi: दो नंबर का सूर्य तलाक दे देगा नाश कर देगा बच्चे की खराबी कर देगा
says: Sun in sign 2 can bring divorce and ruin and harm to a child.
cells_derived_method: Divorce shows when Taurus is the 7th, child harm when Taurus is the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio): marriage breaks.
Sun in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): child's welfare is harmed.
Sun in Taurus in the 1st (lagna Taurus): personal relationships dry out.

classical_check: Classical Sun in the 7th or with Venus does give marital friction, but divorce is his stronger wording.

hindi: एक्सीडेंट दे देगा आपके पैसे को उड़ा देगा जहां बैठा है कुंडली में वहां सत्यानाश कर ही देगा ये लगभग नीच फल देगा
says: Sun in sign 2 can give accidents, blow your money away, and ruin the house it sits in; its effect is close to a debilitation result.
cells_derived_method: The ruined topic follows the house; money loss is strongest in the 2nd and 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): savings blown away.
Sun in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer): income and gains leak.
Sun in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra): sudden mishaps are the main concern.

ambiguity: 'एक्सीडेंट' and money loss are claims in his words, no timing is given.
classical_check: Debilitation is Libra, not Taurus; so 'near-debilitated' is his own grading, not classical.

hindi: ये शनि का 10 नंबर का यहां पर अंधकार में सूरज है तो काफी धुंधला होएगा लेकिन खत्म नहीं होता
says: Sun in Saturn's sign 10 (Capricorn) is the Sun in darkness: quite dim, but not finished off.
cells_derived_method: Topics of the house in Capricorn run dim and low-profile, not destroyed.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn): dim self-confidence, serious look.
Sun in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer): partner relations cold and dutiful.
Sun in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): authority works through grind, not glamour.

classical_check: Classics treat Capricorn as an enemy sign for the Sun, a weak but not debilitated place; agrees.

hindi: सूर्य प्रकाश खत्म तो होगा नहीं अंधकार के आने पर या अंधकार खत्म होता नहीं प्रकाश के जाने पर ये दोनों एक साथ रह नहीं सकते तो ये अंधेरे में सूरज है ऐसा हो नहीं सकता प्रैक्टिकली
says: Light does not end when darkness comes and darkness does not end when light goes, but they cannot coexist; a Sun in darkness is practically impossible as a literal picture.
ambiguity: He first says neither is destroyed and then that they cannot stay together; the point is that the picture is only an analogy.
classical_check: Not a classical statement; it is his teaching logic for Sun-Saturn.

hindi: लेकिन अंधेरे में सूरज गया हुआ तो क्या हो रहा है कम प्रकाश है उसका
says: If the Sun has gone into the dark, the result is less light.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that Sun in an enemy's sign loses brightness.

hindi: अब मध्यम हो गया रोशनी दब गई है तो ये बहुत दबा हुआ सूर्य है
says: Sun in sign 10 ends up at a medium level; the light is pressed down, so it is a heavily suppressed Sun.
cells_derived_method: The suppressed light reduces pride, authority and father matters according to the house.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus): father or fortune is suppressed.
Sun in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo): intelligence is held back, children delayed.
Sun in Capricorn in the 3rd (lagna Scorpio): effort is slow but dogged.

classical_check: Classically a weak, enemy-sign Sun; matches.

hindi: छह नंबर का सूरज राहु के साथ अब यह बड़ा अच्छा मान के चलते हैं बुध की राशि में बड़ा बेबस हो जाता है भयंकर बेबसी स्टार्ट होती है इसकी
says: Sun in sign 6 (Virgo), the sign tied to Rahu in his scheme, goes helpless: a severe helplessness starts for the Sun in Mercury's sign.
cells_derived_method: The house in Virgo shows where the person feels powerless and unable to command.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Virgo in the 1st (lagna Virgo): helpless self-image, serving others.
Sun in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): career authority without freedom.
Sun in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries): helpless against illness and debts.

ambiguity: 'बड़ा अच्छा मान के चलते हैं' is unclear; Rahu with the Sun could mean conjunction rather than sign 6.
classical_check: Classics call Sun in Virgo neutral to mildly weak (Mercury is a friend); not 'fearsome helplessness'.

gist: Reads a question from the audience: Sun is a big planet and Saturn is small, so Sun should not be hurt in Saturn's sign.
Repeats the same question: whether the big Sun would suffer in the sign of the small Saturn.

hindi: शनि सारा अंधकार है पूरे ब्रह्मांड का सारा अंधकार ही शनि है यानी जहां सूरज नहीं होगा वहा शनि है ही
says: Saturn is all darkness, the whole darkness of the universe; wherever the Sun is absent, Saturn is.
classical_check: Classical Saturn is dark, cold and slow; an elemental darkness is his image.

hindi: तो शनि तो सूर्य से भी बड़ा है प्रैक्टिकली स्पीकिंग लेकिन सूर्य के आते ही शनि फुर यानी कि शनि की औकात ही कुछ नहीं
says: In practice the darkness of Saturn is bigger than the Sun, yet the moment the Sun comes, Saturn vanishes, so Saturn's standing before the Sun is nil.
classical_check: Not classical; also seems to contradict his next line that Saturn is never destroyed.

hindi: लेकिन इतने बड़े ब्रह्मांड में सूरज यहां रोशनी दे रहा है वहां तक नहीं देगा एक लिमिट के बाद वो भी नहीं दे पाएगा
says: The Sun lights up only up to a limit; in the vast universe, beyond that range it cannot give light.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish rule.

hindi: तो शनि नष्ट नहीं होता कभी वो बहुत कम कर देगा अपनी ताकत लेकिन सूर्य के रहते नष्ट नहीं होगा
says: Saturn is never destroyed; in the Sun's presence it greatly lowers its power, but it does not perish.
classical_check: Classical Sun-Saturn conjunction keeps both alive and mutually hostile; combustion of Saturn is recognised but not 'destroyed'.

hindi: शनि बेटा है सूर्य बाप है
says: Saturn is the son and the Sun is the father.
classical_check: Agrees with Puranic Shani as the son of Surya and with the classical Sun=father karaka.

gist: Lead-in 'in someone's...' cut by the timestamp; the sentence about Sun and Saturn sitting together continues in the next chunk.

hindi: का सूर्य और शनि कुंडली में साथ बैठा है अगर सूर्य पावरफुल है डिग्री होती है इसमें डिग्रियों पर भी जाना है
says: When Sun and Saturn sit together in a chart, the outcome depends on which is more powerful, and that means degrees must be studied as well.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction in any cell: the stronger by degree dominates the house topics.

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Saturn in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): Sun exalted so the self wins, Saturn debilitated, so the personal self dominates.
Sun and Saturn in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): Saturn exalted, Sun debilitated, the Sun's father-figure is weak at home and the cold Saturn style rules.
Sun and Saturn in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): Saturn's own sign, career by hard slow work.

classical_check: Classical conjunction judgment also uses degrees (strength, avastha); agrees.

hindi: आ अपने क्लासेस के अंदर और कॉम्प्लिकेटेड करते हुए क्लास को आगे बढ़ाते हैं इनकी डिग्रियां भी होती है
says: The planets' degrees will be added to the classes later as one more layer of complexity.
classical_check: Matches classical practice of using degrees in strength.

gist: Says the student will cry thinking how far and how deep this goes, and that degrees will be learned too.

hindi: अगर सूर्य की डिग्री पावरफुल है सूर्य यवन अवस्था में और शनि वृद्ध अवस्था में है तो उस घर का बाप घर में घुसते ही दारू पीके बेटे को पीट रहा होगा
says: If the Sun's degree is strong, in youth avastha, and Saturn's degree is old-age, the father of that house is the bully who comes home drunk and beats the son.
ambiguity: 'यवन' read as 'यौवन'.
classical_check: Classical Baladi avastha: youth is strong, old age is weak; the father-beats-son result is his own.

hindi: सूर्य शुद्ध राशि में शुद्ध डिग्री का है शनि नास पीटा हुआ डिग्री का है इतना पावरफुल है तो बेटा पैदा क्या कर दिया बाप ने शत्रु पैदा कर दिया वह बेटा बाप को रोज मारेगा पीटेगा
says: If one of the two is in a pure sign and pure degree and the other is badly degreed, the strong one dominates; here the outcome described is the son becoming an enemy and beating the father daily, which is the reverse of the previous case.
ambiguity: The caption names the Sun as strong but the result (son beating father) fits a strong Saturn; likely garbled or reversed.
classical_check: Classically a strong Saturn over a weak Sun is a known father-son strain.

hindi: अब उसको ज्ञान की बात कही जाएगी महाराज के द्वारा बेटा कुंडली में सूर्य सुंदर करना है पिता का आदर करो
says: A guru would advise this son: make the Sun in the chart good by respecting the father; honouring the father is the remedy for the Sun.
classical_check: Classical remedies for a weak Sun include serving the father; agrees.

gist: Son's reaction in the joke: he hits the father on the head with a hammer saying 'you beat me'.

hindi: फिर बाप कहेगा बेटा बहुत मारता है उसको पितृ दोष लगे होंगे उसने भी अपने बाप का यही किया होगा यह फैमिली ट्री है
says: The father then complains, but he himself must carry pitru dosha: he did the same to his own father, so the pattern repeats down the family tree.
classical_check: Classical pitru dosha: ancestral debts show as father and son strife; consistent.

hindi: इसलिए सत्संग का क्या करें तेल लेने ग सत्संग हमारे ग्रहों को पहले करेक्ट करो फिर हम जीवन में वैसा कार्य करेंगे
says: He says satsang alone is useless for such people; first correct the planets, then we will act well in life: planets drive conduct, so remedies come before sermons.
classical_check: Classical texts see conduct as shaped by karma and planets; but dismissing satsang is his own view.

hindi: जीवन में वैसा कार्य करेंगे यह सूर्य शनि के दोष के कारण होता है
says: This father-son conflict pattern is caused by the Sun-Saturn dosha.
classical_check: Classical Sun-Saturn conjunction or mutual aspect gives father troubles; agrees.

hindi: सूर्य और बृहस्पति मुख्य आता है इसमें शनि लिंक होता है ये बातें होंगी बताने के लिए
says: In this male-relative topic, Sun and Jupiter are the main planets and Saturn links in; details will be given later.
classical_check: Sun and Jupiter as male karakas (father, husband for women, sons) agree with classics.

hindi: कई स्त्रियों की कुंडली में ऐसा दोष होता है बृहस्पति सूर्य का मिक्सिंग में और शनि का दोष उनको भाई पिता पति और पुत्र का सुखी नहीं होता
says: In many women's charts a mix of Jupiter and Sun with Saturn's affliction means no happiness from brother, father, husband and son.
cells_derived_method: The unhappiness shows in the houses of those relatives, which depend on the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter, Sun and Saturn mixed in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer): husband side is the pain point.
Mixed in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn): the home with father and brother is troubled.
Mixed in Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini): sons are the pain.

classical_check: Classics give Jupiter as husband karaka for women and Sun for father; a combined affliction is plausible, not a textual rule.

gist: Illustration: the woman laments no father's happiness, her father's house is gone, brother does not ask, husband absent, no son.
Illustration: son-in-law is the last male, and even the man got through the daughter gives sorrow; life is hell for her.

hindi: उसकी मैस्क निटी का प्लेनेट डेड है अगर उसके प्रॉपर उपाय नहीं है वह जिंदगी भर सुख नहीं पाएगी पुरुष शब्द का उसे बॉयफ्रेंड भी नहीं मिलेगा
says: Her masculinity planet is dead; without a proper remedy she will not find happiness from any male relation for life, not even a boyfriend.
ambiguity: He does not name the masculinity planet here; Sun or Jupiter are my guess from the prior lines.
classical_check: Classical texts allow remedies for afflicted karakas; 'dead' planet is his word.

gist: 'बढ़िया काम चला मिलेगा' is garbled, probably about what kind of partner she will get.

hindi: ऐसे पुरुषों का होता है उनको ग्रह खराब है शुक्र और चंद्रमा के दोष से होता है उनको मां का सुख नहीं है बहन का सुख नहीं
says: The same pattern for men on the female side: with Venus and Moon afflicted, a man gets no happiness from mother and sister, and the following lines extend it to wife and daughter.
classical_check: Moon as mother and Venus as wife and female karaka agree with classics.

gist: Illustration: the sister sits far away, there is quarrelling with the mother, the wife has sucked his blood.

hindi: बेटी पैदा हुई वो हॉस्पिटल ही रहती है सारे टाइम बीमारी रहती है
says: For such a man a daughter is born who is always ill and always in hospital; the sentence is a health claim and not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical outcome recorded as spoken, not endorsed.
classical_check: Daughter's health is not a classical Venus-Moon rule.

hindi: यह हमारे भयंकर ग्रहों का दोष है इनको भयंकर रूप से आइडेंटिफिकेशन हो पाती है अदर वाइज संभव नहीं
says: These troubles are the fault of severely afflicted planets and can only be identified by careful chart analysis; otherwise it is not possible to find the cause.
classical_check: Consistent with astrologers' view that chart study shows the source of karmic patterns.

hindi: लोग मानते भी तो नहीं है कई लोग जो मानते नहीं है उन सबके बृहस्पति और बुध में दोष है या उनका नाइंथ घर वना डिस्ट्रॉयड और डिस्टर्ब भी
says: Many people do not believe in astrology, and all of them will have a flaw in Jupiter and Mercury or a damaged and disturbed 9th house.
cells_derived_method: Affliction of the 9th house in any sign changes the flavour but not the loss of faith.

derived_examples.reading: 9th house in Gemini (lagna Libra) afflicted: doubts and argument over belief.
9th house in Pisces (lagna Cancer) afflicted: faith is confused rather than denied.
9th house in Virgo (lagna Capricorn) afflicted: rational critique replaces belief.

classical_check: 9th house and Jupiter govern faith and dharma classically; the disbelief link is plausible.

gist: Class plan: he says we will speak about each house one by one sooner or later and that it may get boring.
Class plan: it will be house by house, what sits in each house; with the audience's blessing there is endless material.
Says even he does not know where the class started and where it will go, but it will go somewhere.

hindi: उस व्यक्ति को मानता ही नहीं है वो यही तो मजा है कुंडली देखो उसकी कुंडली में दोष है यह मानेगा तो है नहीं
says: Look at the chart of a non-believer: it will carry the dosha, yet he will never accept it; the disbelief itself is the chart's sign.
classical_check: No classical text states it; it follows from the Jupiter-9th link above.

gist: Promise: how Jupiter's faults arise and how Mars's faults arise will be covered later.
'वो व्यक्ति दूसरे के बाप की मानता ही नहीं... नहीं आया किसलिए' is garbled; probably advice on dealing with a stubborn person.
Audience remark: 'you talk of male happiness; we have one such person, he was told two or three times' and the sentence goes on.
Continues the audience case: despite repeated telling, the person is not coming.

hindi: हां अब उनको देखना पड़ेगा कि उनकी कुंडली में वो किसका कहना मानेंगे भाई का चाचा का मामा का अपने पोते का
says: One must read the chart to see whose word that person will accept: a brother, paternal uncle, maternal uncle or his own grandson.
cells_derived_method: Look at the relevant house and its lord for each relative to see who has influence.

derived_examples.reading: Brother's influence strong with a strong 3rd in Gemini (lagna Aries).
Maternal uncle's advice carries weight when the 4th is strong in Cancer (lagna Aries).
Grandson's influence through 5th-from-5th, the 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries).

classical_check: Classical relatives are read via their houses (3rd brother, 4th mother's side, 5th children); this specific list is his.

hindi: ऐसे योग होते हैं कुंडली में बेटा दुश्मन है पोता देवता के बच्चे से नहीं बच्चे के बच्चे से सुख मिलता है और वो बच्चा अपने बाप को गाली बकता है दादा को पूजता है
says: There are yogas where the son is an enemy and happiness comes from the grandchild, who abuses his own father but worships the grandfather like a god.
cells_derived_method: Affliction of the 5th and strength of the 9th or the 5th from 5th.

derived_examples.reading: 5th house in Scorpio afflicted (lagna Cancer): son is hostile.
9th in Pisces strong (lagna Cancer): grandchild is the source of joy.

classical_check: The 5th from the 5th (9th house) is classically the house of grandchildren; he describes a pattern not given as a text rule.

gist: Says that chart must be seen to know it.

hindi: लड़की का विवाह मासी कराएगी चाचा कराएगा अखबार कराएगी कहां से होगी
says: Who arranges a girl's marriage depends on the chart: maternal aunt, paternal uncle or a newspaper advertisement.
ambiguity: Stated as a question; the answer lies in the chart.
classical_check: Marriage channel is not a classical rule; related houses are 7th and 11th and the relatives' houses.

gist: Story: a boy searches for a girl himself, is no yogi, will not accept a non-choice match, so remains unmarried; this is the usual story.

hindi: बृहस्पति बिगड़ा और ईगो जबान बिगड़ी हुई किसी की बात नहीं मानता बोलता रहता है जैसे मैं बोल रहा हूं
says: A spoiled Jupiter gives ego and an unbridled tongue: the person heeds no one and keeps talking, as he is himself doing.
ambiguity: 'इसी में ज्यादा हो तो कौन सा' is a garbled lead-in.
classical_check: Jupiter afflicted gives pride and pedantry classically; his tongue-and-ego framing is a vivid version.

hindi: बुध का दोष है जो गालियां देते हैं बात बात में दूसरे की बुध का दोष है बोलने वाणी में
says: People who abuse others at every turn have a Mercury dosha, a defect in speech.
ambiguity: The sentence ends cut at 'यदि आप' which opens the next batch.
classical_check: Mercury governs speech; afflicted Mercury gives harsh or fault-finding speech; agrees.

hindi: गंदगी बोल रहे त्रुटी रख रहे हैं बुध का भयंकर दोष है
says: A person who keeps speaking filth and making errors in speech has a severe Mercury dosha.
classical_check: Matches classical afflicted Mercury giving faulty or coarse speech.

hindi: वाणी स्पष्ट नहीं होगी अगड़म बगड़म शब्द बोलेंगे बहुत जल्दी जल्दी बोलेंगे
says: Mercury dosha shows as unclear speech, jumbled nonsense words and talking very fast.
classical_check: Classics give stammering and unclear speech for a weak or afflicted Mercury; fast talk is his addition.

hindi: अब बहुत जल्दी बोल रहे लेकिन क्लेरिटी है वह राहु की कृपा है क्योंकि राहु बाप है सबका
says: If someone speaks very fast but still with clarity, that is Rahu's grace, because Rahu is the father of everyone.
classical_check: Rahu giving a sharp, quick tongue is a modern view; calling Rahu the father of all is his own image.

gist: 'सारे बाप एक दूसरे के देखेंगे ग्रह' is garbled; possibly about the planets that are fathers looking at one another.

hindi: उसकी वजह से मन डूबा रहता है सारे टाइम यूं ही बात करते हैं यूं ही परेशान है नीचे देखते हैं चंद्रमा का दोष है
says: A mind always sunk in worry, idly talking, always troubled and looking downward is a Moon dosha.
classical_check: Classical afflicted Moon gives low mood and worry; matches.

hindi: बुध को ठीक करना राहु को ठीक करना ये कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है ऐसे नहीं होता
says: Fixing Mercury and Rahu for such speech and mind problems is a complicated, case-by-case job and cannot be done by a simple standard remedy.
classical_check: Classical remedies exist for both planets; he stresses that it is not mechanical.

gist: Joke: 'we want dakshina, we will fix them' and 'let me tell you the Mercury and Rahu fix'.

hindi: कई डॉक्टर्स जैसे अभी बताया कि आपके हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम है लिवर ठीक करो हार्ट को मत करो लिवर ही हार्ट को ठीक कर देगा कोलेस्ट्रॉल लीवर में बनता है
says: Analogy: a doctor who says fix the liver, not the heart, because cholesterol is made in the liver; likewise one should treat the root planet and not the planet that shows the symptom. Medical content is his, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The medical statement is an analogy and is recorded as said, not as health advice.
classical_check: Classical remedial practice also treats the causal planet or the lord of the affected house, not just the visible one.

gist: Joking medical aside about drinking, hangover and phosphorus; he ends 'what have I told'.
Laughter and 'where were we, where have we reached'; he returns to the Sun.
Repeats that the Sun is near Rahu in sign 6, a state of helplessness.

hindi: सूरज 12 नंबर का है केतु बादल बड़ा दबा दबा मन रहेगा उसको रोशनी नहीं मिलेगी व्यक्ति को समझ नहीं
says: Sun in sign 12 (Ketu's cloud sign) leaves the person with a pressed-down mind, no light and no understanding.
cells_derived_method: The house at Pisces shows where understanding and clarity are lacking.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Pisces in the 1st (lagna Pisces): dim self-confidence and vague identity.
Sun in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio): poor intelligence clarity, study muddled.
Sun in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini): career direction foggy.

classical_check: Pisces is Jupiter's friend sign for the Sun, which classics rate as fairly good; his reading is harsher, tied to Ketu.

hindi: सूरज आठ नंबर का इंद्र के साथ लाजवाब राजा राजा से मिलेगा हालांकि थोड़ा अय्याशी का राजा है लेकिन है तो राजा ही बहुत सुंदर फल देगा
says: Sun in sign 8, Indra's sign, is superb: king meets king; he is a somewhat pleasure-loving king but still a king, so the result is very good.
cells_derived_method: Royal results, with a pleasure-seeking colouring, in the house that Scorpio occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Scorpio in the 1st (lagna Scorpio): commanding, intense personality.
Sun in Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius): authority and a high post.
Sun in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): powerful, indulgent partner.

classical_check: Sun in Scorpio (Mars's sign, Mars a friend) is classically moderately good; agrees in direction.

hindi: बड़े मस्त मलंग होते हैं आठ नंबर सूरज वाले लोग भुलक्कड़ पता वता को चलता नहीं कुछ
says: People with the Sun in sign 8 are carefree and happy-go-lucky, forgetful and unaware of what is going on.
classical_check: Not classical; Scorpio Sun is usually described as intense.

gist: Says the next class will cover this too, and asks when the class is held.

hindi: सूर्य सात नंबर वरुण समुद्र नष्ट कर देता है आप सोच के चले धरती का पूरा समुद्र जो है यही धरती के बैलेंसिंग कर रहा है
says: Sun in sign 7, Varuna's sea sign, destroys the sea; think of the earth's whole ocean as what balances the earth.
cells_derived_method: Loss of balance in the house topics at Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): partnership balance lost to ego.
Sun in Libra in the 1st (lagna Libra): self-image unstable.
Sun in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn): career authority is compromised.

classical_check: Sun is debilitated in Libra, so the harmful verdict agrees with classics.

hindi: धरती पर समुद्र ही है सारा जल है वही खींच रहा है काम कर रहा है उसी में सब कुछ पड़ा है जो भी सब समुद्र से रहा है वन भी समुद्र से रहा है
says: On earth the sea is nearly everything: all water, the pull, and even the forests depend on it, so Varuna is the base that sustains life.
ambiguity: Caption verbs 'खींच रहा' and 'रहा है' are garbled.
classical_check: Neptune is outside classics; the sea-as-source idea is his image.

hindi: अब सूरज तो धरती से भी कितना ज्यादा विशाल है यहां आके समुद्र आग लगाए तो वरुण को सुखा
says: The Sun is vastly bigger than the earth, so if it sets fire to the sea it dries Varuna out.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk boundary and continues with 'देगा कृपा खत्म'.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: अगर सूर्य नाराज है राजा नाराज है पिता नाराज है तो वरुण कृपा मिलने बंद हो जाएगी
says: If the Sun, meaning the king and the father, is displeased, Varuna's grace stops arriving; the flow of blessings ends.
classical_check: Sun = father and king agrees with classics; the Varuna link is his.

hindi: इसलिए हम कहते हैं बच्चों को मां-बाप से नफरत कर लो पैर छू लो उनसे खूब नफरत करो गाली बकते हुए पैर छू लो उनकी ऊर्जा का सम्मान करो
says: Remedy: even a child who hates the parents should still touch their feet and honour their energy, even while they abuse him; respect for parents is kept regardless of how they behave.
ambiguity: 'नफरत कर लो' is rhetorical: hate if you must, but still touch the feet.
classical_check: Classical Sun remedy of honouring the father agrees; the hate-and-touch phrasing is rhetorical.

hindi: किसी भी हालत में पैर छूने पर तुम्हें गाली बकें मारेंगे लेकिन कृपा नहीं रुकेगी बाप के पैर छूने से कृपा औरों से बंद नहीं होगी क्योंकि कृपा बंद हो जाती है
says: By touching the father's feet, grace from others keeps coming even if the father only gives abuse; neglecting the father is what shuts grace off, and grace is the whole game.
classical_check: Classical texts tie father's blessing to Sun and fortune; this is his teaching claim.

hindi: और सूर्य 11 नंबर के अंदर रहा है तो मौत के घर में कोई खास फल नहीं है एवरेज हिसाब किताब रखेगा
says: Sun in sign 11, Yama's own home, gives no special result and keeps an average account.
cells_derived_method: Average result in the topics of the house at Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in Aquarius in the 5th (lagna Libra): average on children and study.
Sun in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus): average career standing.
Sun in Aquarius in the 1st (lagna Aquarius): ordinary vitality.

classical_check: Sun in Aquarius (Saturn's sign, enemy) is classically weak; he calls it average.

hindi: तो ऐसे ऐसे अलग-अलग राशियों में जब जब जो जो ग्रह चलेगा उसका फल उस अनुसार डाउन होगा
says: Summary: whichever planet moves into whichever sign, its result changes accordingly, so each planet needs a sign-by-sign reading.
classical_check: Agrees with classical sign-dependent judgement.

gist: Audience asks about the Sun in the 5th house together with sign 10; he says leave it, it is only average.

hindi: अभी तो बताया एवरेज होता है ऐसे नहीं होता वो वहां काम कर रहा नहीं कर रहा देखना
says: His reply to the question: an average result is just an average; judging is not that simple, you must check whether the planet is actually working in that placement.
ambiguity: Ambiguous what 'working' means; may be strength by degree or house function.
classical_check: Consistent with classical emphasis on whether a planet is functional in the placement.

gist: Tells the class this is the first KG-level class.

hindi: चंद्रमा चार नंबर है सूरज में जाएगा रोशनी पानी एवरेज फल
says: The Moon's own sign is 4; when the Moon goes into the Sun's sign, light meets water and the result is average.
cells_derived_method: Average results on the mind and emotional topics of the house at Leo.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): average on children and mind.
Moon in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus): moderate home peace.
Moon in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio): public image moderate.

classical_check: Moon in Leo is classically in a friend's sign, moderate; agrees roughly.

hindi: चंद्रमा एक नंबर आग में गया नष्ट कर देगा और खुद भी गर्म होकर भाप बनकर उड़ जाएगा तो एक नंबर का चंद्रमा बुरा है
says: Moon in sign 1, fire: the fire destroys it and it heats up and evaporates, so the Moon in sign 1 is bad.
cells_derived_method: Mind and emotional topics evaporate in the house at Aries.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): restless and hot-headed mind.
Moon in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn): home peace burns off.
Moon in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer): erratic public image.

classical_check: Moon in Aries is classically a weak, neutral to troublesome placement; he is firmer.

hindi: तीन नंबर हवा हवा में पानी रह सकता है नॉट बैड नॉट वेरी गुड क्योंकि अपना अस्तित्व खो जाएगा
says: Moon in sign 3, air: water can live in air so it is not bad and not very good, because the Moon loses its own existence.
classical_check: Moon in Gemini is classically neutral; agrees.

hindi: तीन नंबर का चंद्रमा अपना अस्तित्व खोएगा अपना हल्का हो जाएगा घिस घिस के परेशान
says: Elaborating on the Moon in sign 3: it loses its identity, becomes light and thin, and worn down, restless and troubled.
cells_derived_method: Light, restless mind in the house topics.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Gemini in the 1st (lagna Gemini): restless, scattered mind.
Moon in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius): thin emotional bond in partnership.
Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): changeable career.

classical_check: Gemini Moon is described as restless and mentally busy classically.

hindi: ज्ञान चंद्रमा नौ नंबर लाजवाब
says: Moon in sign 9, the knowledge sign of Jupiter, is superb.
cells_derived_method: Wise, settled mind in the house topics at Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): fortune and faith are strong.
Moon in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo): contented home, learned mother.
Moon in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces): respected work in teaching or guidance.

ambiguity: Caption 'ज्ञान चंद्रमा' is read as Moon in the knowledge sign.
classical_check: Moon in Sagittarius is classically neutral to good, Jupiter being a friend; he rates it more highly.

hindi: घी चंद्रमा कोई मिक्सिंग नहीं है लेकिन चंद्रमा सर्वश्रेष्ठ फल देगा आप घी मिलाकर के दूध बनाते हो
says: Moon with ghee, meaning Venus's sign, is not a harmful mixture and the Moon gives its best result there, like adding ghee to milk.
cells_derived_method: Best results for mind, family and comforts in the house at Taurus.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): wealth, family and speech are well fed.
Moon in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): peaceful home and a nurturing mother.
Moon in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): steady popular career.

ambiguity: The sign is read as Taurus (sign 2); Libra (7) is also Venus's.
classical_check: Moon exalted in Taurus agrees; the sign is not named in this line but 'two number' is confirmed later.

hindi: दूध में जो भी दूध जल भी है दूध भी यही है शुक्र दही है कई स्वरूप ऐसे निकलते चले जाएंगे दूध जब जम गया दही बन गया
says: Milk is the Moon, being water and milk both, and Venus is curd; many forms come out one after another, as milk sets into curd.
classical_check: Moon-milk and Venus-curd are classical-style correspondences (both cool, watery).

hindi: और भी बैक्टीरिया जो उसमें बॉडी के लिए इतना ज्यादा बेनिफिशियल है लाजवाब फल है इसका
says: The bacteria in curd are very beneficial for the body, which is why the Moon-Venus product gives a splendid result.
ambiguity: Health benefit is analogy, not an astrological health claim.
classical_check: Not classical; an everyday analogy.

hindi: ये शनि तेल है चंद्रमा दूध ले लो चाहे पानी ले लो तेल साथ आ गया तो इतना सा तेल ढक देगा
says: Saturn is oil; if oil comes together with the Moon, whether milk or water, even a little oil covers it, so Saturn smothers the Moon.
classical_check: Saturn-Moon conjunction (visha yoga) classically gives a depressed, covered mind; agrees.

hindi: चंद्रमा 10 नंबर का होगा नॉट गुड नेगेटिव नहीं नॉट गुड यहां नेगेटिव है यहां एवरेज है यहां गुड है यहां वेरी वेरी गुड है
says: Moon in sign 10 is 'not good', though not negative; he places it on a ladder where some signs are negative, some average, some good and some very very good.
cells_derived_method: Cold, restrained mind in the house topics.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): hard-working but emotionally dry career.
Moon in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): reserved home life.
Moon in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn): serious, guarded nature.

classical_check: Moon in Capricorn is neutral with Saturn's cold; classically not strong.

gist: Repeats 'not good, not bad, just not good' for the Moon in sign 10.

hindi: छह नंबर का हो गया राहु के साथ क्या हाल करेगा रो बैठ के मन खींचता कुढ़ता सड़ता रहेगा सारे टाइम
says: Moon in sign 6, Rahu's sign, leaves the person weeping, mind pulled and fretting, rotting inside all the time.
cells_derived_method: Worry and rumination in the house topics at Virgo.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries): constant worry over debts and illness.
Moon in Virgo in the 1st (lagna Virgo): anxious self-critical mind.
Moon in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): fretting inside the home.

classical_check: Moon in Virgo is classically neutral; the bad result comes from his Rahu mapping.

hindi: 12 नंबर का चंद्रमा बादल के साथ है चांद चांद रहेगा लेकिन बदली बदली छाई रहेगी कुछ मन ऐसे रहेगा ठगा ठगा लॉस्ट लॉस्ट से रहोगे
says: Moon in sign 12, with Ketu's cloud, remains the Moon but the sky stays overcast; the mind feels cheated and lost.
cells_derived_method: Hazy mood in the house topics at Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries): lost feeling in sleep and foreign matters.
Moon in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio): dreamy, confused mind over children and study.
Moon in Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius): uncertain speech and savings.

classical_check: Moon in Pisces is classically fine as Jupiter's friendly sign; his cloud reading is darker.

hindi: चंद्रमा आठ नंबर है मन की स्थिति कबाड़ा सिर्फ अय्याशी पार्टी और रात को बेहोश सुबह हैंगओवर सबसे ज्यादा खराब फल है यहां वर्स्ट
says: Moon in sign 8 wrecks the mind: only pleasure-seeking, parties, passing out at night and hangovers in the morning; the worst result of all.
cells_derived_method: Indulgence and mental disorder in the house topics at Scorpio.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Scorpio in the 1st (lagna Scorpio): turbulent mind and over-indulgence.
Moon in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer): intellect clouded by passion, children issues.
Moon in Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius): sleep and bed pleasures go out of control.

classical_check: Moon is debilitated in Scorpio; agrees on the worst verdict.

hindi: चंद्रमा मन की प्योरिटी होती है जल यह पानी है यहां पार्टी करनी है इसने पानी मिलाएगा दारू में पार्टी करेगा पानी का सत्यानाश
says: The Moon is the purity of the mind and is water; in the party scene it goes into liquor as the water mixer, and the water is ruined.
classical_check: Moon as mind karaka agrees; the liquor image is his.

hindi: पानी रे पानी तेरा रंग कैसा जिसमें मिला दो लगे उस जैसा तो यह पानी का अस्तित्व समाप्त कर देता है
says: Quoting the song about water taking the colour of whatever it is mixed with: the Moon takes the nature of its company and loses its own, so it ends its identity.
classical_check: Classically the Moon takes the nature of the planet it is with; agrees.

hindi: बिल्कुल बर्बाद नेगेटिव फल चंद्रमा अगर आठ नंबर का है आपको नष्ट कर देगा जहां शरीर के जिस अंग में खत्म
says: Moon in sign 8 is utterly ruinous; it damages whichever body part the house stands for.
cells_derived_method: The damaged body part follows the house at Scorpio: head for the 1st, throat for the 2nd, etc.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Scorpio in the 1st (lagna Scorpio): head and mind are affected.
Moon in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo): chest and heart region affected.
Moon in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): digestive area affected.

ambiguity: Medical consequences are claims in his words, not diagnoses.
classical_check: Debilitated Moon in Scorpio matches the negative verdict; the body-part damage is his.

hindi: मोटी सी बात चंद्रमा आठ नंबर का है पांचवें आठ नौवें घर से कोई लिंक है अपेंडिक्स का ऑपरेशन
says: Rule of thumb: Moon in sign 8 with a link to the 5th, 8th or 9th house points to an appendix operation; medical claim recorded as said.
cells_derived_method: Same logic with Moon in Scorpio placed in other houses gives other body parts rather than the appendix.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries): lower abdomen operation.
Moon in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer): abdomen concern.
Moon in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces): hip and thigh area concern instead.

ambiguity: 'लिंक' could mean placement or lordship; no medical advice is given.
classical_check: No classical rule on the appendix; the 5th and 8th are classically abdominal areas.

gist: Aside that the appendix is a vestigial organ in humans with no use, but works in cows.
Aside on the cow: its dung is used as fuel, for plastering and beds, and wheat is grown in it.

hindi: अपेंडिक्स इतना पावरफुल है और ये चंद्रमा नष्ट हो गया तो अपेंडिक्स उड़ा देता है बॉडी से
says: The appendix is linked to the Moon, and if the Moon is destroyed it removes the appendix from the body, meaning it is operated out.
ambiguity: Medical link is claimed, not established.
classical_check: Not in classical texts.

hindi: कई दफा जिनके घरों में चंद्रमा आठ नंबर का होता है सीलन रहती है घर में रहती ही है चंद्रमा में दोष है
says: Often those whose Moon is in sign 8 have dampness in their house, which is a Moon dosha showing in the home.
classical_check: No classical rule; a vastu-style link of Moon to water and damp.

hindi: आपके घर में आरो लगा है लीकेज हो रही है आपकी खोपड़ी में चंद्रमा डिस्टर्ब हो गया
says: If your home needs a water purifier and has leakage, the Moon in your head is disturbed: water problems at home are a sign of Moon trouble.
ambiguity: Tone is half-joking; recorded as the vastu-link claim.
classical_check: Vastu-style correlation, not in classical texts.

hindi: मन उदास है मन परेशान है मन दुखी है
says: A sad, troubled and unhappy mind is the mental sign of Moon dosha.
classical_check: Agrees with afflicted Moon giving low mood.

hindi: स्किन में खुजली शुरू हो जाएगी मुंह खुश्क होना शुरू हो जाएगा आंखों से आंसू सूखने शुरू हो जाएंगे ऑटोमेटिक
says: Afflicted Moon dries things: itchy skin, a dry mouth and dry eyes; health claim in his words, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health symptoms recorded as said.
classical_check: Moon governs fluids classically, so drying with its affliction is in line.

hindi: घर में सीलन आनी शुरू हो जाएगी नल के टपकने शुरू हो जाएंगे आपको पानी की प्रॉब्लम रहेगी नलका खोलोगे तो गंदा पानी आएगा पानी का पंगा शुरू
says: A polluted Moon also shows as water problems at home: damp walls, dripping taps, dirty water from the tap.
classical_check: Not in classical texts.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित है आपकी बॉडी में एलर्जी बढ़नी शुरू हो जाएगी धीरे-धीरे आपकी बॉडी के अंदर दवाइयों का असर रेट हो जाएगा इम्युनिटी
says: A contaminated Moon raises allergies slowly, drugs stop working as well and immunity falls; health claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical statement recorded only as said.
classical_check: Not a classical rule.

hindi: यहां हर प्लेनेट एक-एक शब्द कहूं तो कहूं बस चंद्रमा सबसे बड़ा चंद्रमा है अभी बात होगी इसकी
says: He could say a word about every planet here, but the Moon is the biggest of them, and he will discuss it later.
classical_check: Classics treat the Moon as the second luminary and mind karaka, very important.

hindi: चंद्रमा सात नंबर वरुण समुद्र से ही बनता है सारा पानी सर्वोत्तम फल लाजवाब जैसे दो नंबर में लाजवाब था वैसे यहां अत्यंत सुंदर बहुत ही कमाल का
says: Moon in sign 7, Varuna's sea sign, gives the best result, as water all comes from the sea; as superb as in sign 2.
cells_derived_method: Emotional fulfilment in the house topics at Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): emotionally fulfilling partnership.
Moon in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): serene home and good mother.
Moon in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn): popular, balanced public life.

classical_check: Moon in Libra is classically neutral; his rating is far higher.

hindi: यही चंद्रमा बर्फ बन गया यम के साथ तो बर्फ जम गया बिल्कुल जाम कर दिया इसने पानी को
says: The same Moon with Yama turns to ice and is frozen solid; Pluto freezes the water.
cells_derived_method: Emotional freezing in the house topics at Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio): cold home atmosphere.
Moon in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo): emotionally frozen partnership.
Moon in Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries): detached friendships.

ambiguity: 'यम के साथ' could mean conjunction with Pluto or in Yama's sign 11.
classical_check: Moon in Aquarius is classically neutral; Pluto is not classical.

hindi: पानी की तासीर क्या है सादी सिंपल प्लेन बर्फ की तासीर क्या है भयंकर गर्म
says: Plain water has a simple, plain nature but ice has an intensely hot nature (in the Ayurvedic sense of taseer), so frozen water behaves opposite to its form.
ambiguity: He says 'ऑटोमेटिक गर्म तासीर' before this; the exact meaning of hot ice is figurative.
classical_check: Taseer is Unani and Ayurvedic, not a Jyotish concept.

hindi: प्लूटो को देखा जाए तो 450 डिग्री के अंदाजा याद है जो मुझे टेंपरेचर है वो बर्फ के पूरा का पूरा बर्फ का प्लानेट है
says: Pluto is a whole planet of ice, with a temperature he recalls as about 450 degrees below zero.
ambiguity: The number and units are from memory and probably wrong.
classical_check: Astronomy, not Jyotish; the real surface temperature is near minus 230 C, so his figure is loose.

hindi: ठंडा है कोल्ड इतना ज्यादा माइनस में है यह बर्फ यमराज मौत यानी मन जम गया
says: The Moon joined with Yama is ice, extremely cold and far below zero, which is death for feeling: the mind freezes.
cells_derived_method: Emotional shutdown in the house topics at Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in Aquarius in the 1st (lagna Aquarius): numb, withdrawn nature.
Moon in Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio): cold, silent home.
Moon in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus): public image is aloof.

ambiguity: Continues the earlier 'Moon with Yama' idea; whether it means conjunction or sign 11 is not said.
classical_check: Moon-Pluto is not classical; a frozen mind is his picture for a Moon-Saturn-like depression.

hindi: एक होता है दिमाग जम गया दिमाग काम ही नहीं कर रहा यार
says: A second kind of freeze is the brain: the frozen brain stops working altogether, distinct from a frozen mind.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा जल तत्व खत्म 100% वाटर एलिमेंट है हमारी थर्ड आई 90 पर वाटर एलिमेंट ब्रेन 72 पर वाटर एलिमेंट है बॉडी
says: The Moon is purely the water element; he says the third eye is 90 per cent water, the brain 72 and the body so much more, so the Moon rules these.
ambiguity: 'पर' is read as 'per cent'; the figures are not checked.
classical_check: Moon ruling the brain and mind agrees; the percentages are his figures, not classical.

hindi: सबसे पहले थर्ड आई बंद यमराज मौत जैसे ही आप डरे सिर्फ डर कैसा भी डर आपका थर्ड आई ब्लॉक होनी शुरू हो जाती है
says: The first thing Yama does is shut the third eye: the moment you feel fear, any fear at all, your third eye starts to block.
classical_check: Not classical; third eye is a yoga idea tied here to Pluto.

hindi: और थर्ड आई बंद होने का मतलब क्या है अंतरिक्ष से कोई मैसेज ही नहीं आ रहा
says: A closed third eye means no messages arrive from space or the cosmos, so intuition and guidance stop.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: इसलिए छह पर वाले गुरु के पल्ले जाओ नहीं तो छोड़ दो परमात्मा के पर पता नहीं कैसे ठीक हो जाओगे ऑटोमेटिक
says: Remedy: go to the care of a proper guru, otherwise leave it to the Supreme, and in some way you will get right automatically.
ambiguity: '6 पर वाले' is garbled, perhaps 'सच्चे' (true); read loosely as a true guru.
classical_check: Guru and surrender as remedies are general tradition, not specific to Pluto.

gist: Transition: that finishes the Moon and Yama part, now he moves to Mars.

hindi: मंगल है आग आग पानी में मंगल चार नंबर में जाएगा क्या होगा आग है पानी में चली गई आग बुझेगी
says: Mars is fire; when Mars goes into sign 4, water, the fire goes into water and gets extinguished.
cells_derived_method: Drive and courage get put out in the house topics at Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): weak drive, moody anger.
Mars in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): heat in the home turns to damp frustration.
Mars in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra): career energy extinguished.

classical_check: Mars is debilitated in Cancer; agrees.

hindi: लेकिन मंगल ग्रह अपने आप में बहुत पावरफुल ये नष्ट नहीं होता
says: Mars on its own is very powerful and is not destroyed even in water.
ambiguity: The sentence begins with a garbled word 'दटक' and the previous line says the fire goes out.
classical_check: Classical debilitation weakens but does not delete a planet; agrees.

hindi: लेकिन समस्या क्या है यह पानी को सुखा देता है जिसका मंगल चार नंबर को टच कर गया या शत्रु राशि को टच चार नंबर का तो विशेष फल है नीचे सबसे खराब
says: The problem is that Mars dries up the water: when Mars touches sign 4 or an enemy sign, the result is special and the lowest and worst.
cells_derived_method: Worst Mars results, hitting the topics of the house at Cancer, with milder harm in enemy signs.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): home dried out of peace.
Mars in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn): partnership drained of warmth.
Mars in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): children and creativity are dried up.

ambiguity: 'टच' could mean sitting in or aspecting; the next chunk adds aspect.
classical_check: Debilitation in Cancer and enemy signs weaken Mars; agrees.

hindi: पानी में आग डालोगे आग के गरम गरम चीज को पानी में डाल दिया आपने धीरे-धीरे पानी को हीटर रॉड डालते हैं पानी का क्या हाल करता है उल्टा उसको भी उबाल के ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है
says: Analogy: a hot object or heater rod put in water does not die but boils the water and ruins it; Mars in a water sign overheats the Moon's water.
classical_check: Mars-Moon enmity in a water sign is a standard classical picture.

hindi: तो क्या करता है खुद नष्ट हुआ नहीं लेकिन खुद नष्ट हो रहा है लेकिन उसे भी गर्म कर रहा है
says: Mars itself is not finished, though it is being worn down, and it keeps heating the water as well.
ambiguity: Contradictory wording, 'not destroyed' and 'being destroyed' in the same line.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: इसलिए यह प्लेनेट इतने पावरफुल है कि यदि इनकी सही प्रकार से ट्रीटमेंट नहीं की जाए आपकी बुद्धि भ्रमित हो जाती है आप सत्यानाश पीट करके तबाह कर देते हो
says: These planets are so powerful that if they are not treated properly, the intellect is confused and you ruin and wreck everything.
classical_check: Classical teaching also recommends remedies for strongly afflicted planets.

hindi: आपके भाग्य में लिखा ही नहीं है कि आपको सेक्स और यह साथ मिले
says: Along with a heated Mars in water, it is not in your fate to get sexual union and companionship.
ambiguity: Caption 'सेक्स और यह साथ' is unclear and may refer to marital partnership.
classical_check: Mars in Cancer in the 7th or 8th troubles marital pleasure classically.

hindi: कई बार पांचवा घर भाग्य स्थान माना जाता है उसको भी और संतान के द्वारा भाग्य उठता है वहां मंगल इत्यादि का दोष होता है तो संतान होने के पश्चात प्रॉब्लम आती है
says: The 5th house is also taken as a house of fortune, since fortune rises through children; if Mars and similar planets afflict it, problems come after the children are born.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Mars in the 5th in different signs gives different kinds of post-birth trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius): fiery, hard-to-control children.
Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): emotional and health troubles for children.
Mars in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo): disciplined but strained relation with children.

classical_check: The 5th is purva-punya and putra-bhava classically; agrees.

hindi: चार नंबर के मंगल का एक विशेष दोष हो तो लड़कियों के लिए तो बड़ा भारी झंझट है
says: Mars in sign 4 carries a special dosha that is a heavy trouble for girls.
cells_derived_method: Trouble centres on reproductive and emotional topics when Cancer falls on those houses.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): childbearing trouble for a girl.
Mars in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn): marital trouble for a girl.
Mars in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): body and mood trouble for a girl.

classical_check: Mars debilitated in Cancer is an acknowledged weak placement; the gender-specific note is his.

hindi: उनको यूरिनरी डिसऑर्डर्स हो जाते हैं ओवेरियन सिस्ट केतु और मंगल देते ही हैं
says: For such girls, urinary disorders and ovarian cysts follow; Ketu and Mars both give these. Health claim in his words, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical claim recorded as said.
classical_check: Classical medical astrology links Mars and Ketu to surgery and cysts loosely.

hindi: मंगल आपका नीच का हो गया चार नंबर का
says: Mars in sign 4 is debilitated.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: अगर तीन नंबर का मंगल है चार का होने का खतरा है पांच नंबर है तो भी चार का होने का खतरा ही है क्योंकि उस राशि के पास मंडरा रहा है
says: A Mars in sign 3 or sign 5 also risks behaving like a sign 4 Mars because it hovers next to that sign.
cells_derived_method: The risk is greatest when the planet is within a few degrees of the border with Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Mars at the end of Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): may act like Cancer Mars, courage doused.
Mars at the start of Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): may act watery, children matters strained.
Mars at the end of Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): career drive dampened.

ambiguity: 'मंडरा रहा' is read as hovering; the use of degrees is not stated.
classical_check: Sign-edge planets (sandhi) are seen as weak, but classics do not treat an adjacent sign as a debilitation.

hindi: फिर मंगल की तीन दृष्टियां है अगर वो कहीं से दूर से बैठ के तीन दृष्टि में मंगल चार नंबर को देख रहा है बहुत हैवी है
says: Mars has three aspects; if from far away it casts any of them on sign 4, that is very heavy.
cells_derived_method: The aspected house at Cancer takes the heat depending on which house it is.

derived_examples.reading: Cancer is the 4th (lagna Aries) aspected by Mars: home and mother.
Cancer is the 7th (lagna Capricorn) aspected by Mars: marriage.
Cancer is the 10th (lagna Libra) aspected by Mars: career.

ambiguity: He says three aspects; classically they are the 4th, 7th and 8th from Mars.
classical_check: Mars's special aspects on the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from itself agree with classics.

hindi: तो आपको फिर ओवरी में सिस्ट दे देगा अब समस्या है बच्चे नहीं पैदा होंगे कैसे अजीब समस्या
says: A heavy Mars on sign 4 then gives an ovarian cyst, so the problem becomes difficulty in conceiving children; health claim in his words.
ambiguity: Medical outcome recorded as said.
classical_check: Not a classical rule.

hindi: फिर क्या करें आईयूआई कराओ आईवीएफ कराओ शनि का दोष हो गया तो गारंटी एक फेलियर देगा केतु का दोष हो गया तो कम से कम तीन फेलियर देगा
says: Then people go for IUI or IVF; with a Saturn dosha one failure is guaranteed and with a Ketu dosha at least three failures; he records this as a rule of thumb, not as medical advice.
ambiguity: Medical procedure outcomes are his claims.
classical_check: Not classical; the failure counts are his own claims.

hindi: फिर आईयूआई करा रहे दो बार आईवीएफ करा रहे फेल हो गए तीन बार हो गए हां हो सकता है इसलिए कृपा चाहिए
says: When IUI and IVF are tried again and again and fail, it can happen; therefore grace is needed.
classical_check: Grace as a remedy is general tradition.

hindi: फिर कृपा चाहिए ताकि ये कट डाउन हो जाए शॉर्टकट में हो जाए काम कृपा हर चीज को स्पीड से कराती है
says: Grace is wanted so that the trouble is cut down and the task gets done by a shortcut; grace speeds everything up.
classical_check: Consistent with guru-kripa as a remedy in tradition.

gist: Analogy: grace is like a car; on foot Jalandhar takes 9 days, by car 9 hours.

hindi: कृपा के लिए तेल फूंकना पड़ेगा कृपा लेने के लिए गुरु जी को मतलब थोड़ा आप समझ रहे हो पैर दबा के
says: Grace needs fuel: to get it you must put in service, such as pressing the guru's feet.
classical_check: Guru-seva as the path to grace is traditional.

gist: Mimics a person refusing: legs are fine, allergic, will not fulfil mother's dream, no fuel, he would take self-importance himself.
Repeats that Mars in sign 4 destroys.

hindi: मंगल हवा वायु तीन नंबर हवा को गर्म कर देगा यानी तीन नंबर में नेगेटिव नहीं
says: Mars in sign 3, air, merely heats the air, so it is not negative in that sign.
cells_derived_method: Energetic, communicative results in the house topics at Gemini.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): lively, bold communication.
Mars in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius): sharp-tongued partner.
Mars in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): active, talkative career.

classical_check: Mars in Gemini (Mercury's sign) is classically neutral to uncomfortable; he calls it fine.

hindi: ये इसलिए समझ पदार्थ ताकि आप पकड़ लें कि अच्छा इस राशि में ये होता है ये किसी बुक की कहानी नहीं है हमने जैसे जाना है
says: He explains planets through material substances (fire, water, air, ghee, oil) so you can grasp what happens in each sign; this is his own way of knowing, not a story from a book.
classical_check: Classics derive sign effects through tattva (elements) and friendships; his material images are an informal version.

gist: Jab at other teachers who use guesswork and 'stolen goods'; says this way is easy and will come quickly.

hindi: बृहस्पति ज्ञान मंगल नौ नंबर में जाएगा ज्ञान का है ज्ञान को और उबाल देगा वेरी गुड बहुत ही शानदार
says: Mars in sign 9, Jupiter's knowledge sign, heats the knowledge further and is very good.
cells_derived_method: Energetic wisdom, enthusiasm for the topics at Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): zeal in dharma and fortune.
Mars in Sagittarius in the 5th (lagna Leo): sharp mantra-minded intellect.
Mars in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces): action-oriented guidance career.

classical_check: Mars in Sagittarius (friend's sign) is classically good; agrees.

hindi: शुक्र घी दही अब दो नंबर में आ गया शुक्र के साथ ये बड़ा लफड़ा है यार
says: Mars arriving in sign 2, Venus's ghee-and-curd sign, makes for a big complication.
classical_check: Mars in Taurus (enemy sign) is classically uncomfortable; agrees on 'complication'.

gist: Says the entire class turned into a Mars class and that he is 'cutting a lot' today.

hindi: साथ शुक्र क्या है वैभव है आनंद है करोड़पति बना देता है
says: Venus brings splendour and pleasure, and in the Mars context can make one a crorepati.
ambiguity: The subject of 'बना देता है' could be Venus or the Mars-Venus combination.
classical_check: Venus as wealth karaka agrees.

hindi: मंगल दो नंबर का होता है करोड़पति होते हैं वो लोग दूसरे घर में यूजुअली कॉम्बिनेशन सेट होना चाहिए
says: Mars in sign 2, and usually in the 2nd house, makes such people crorepatis if the combination sets right.
cells_derived_method: Other houses with Mars in Taurus carry the same wealth push to that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): wealth and family heat, crorepati chances.
Mars in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer): large gains through ambitious networks.
Mars in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio): wealth through partner or business, but heated marriage.

ambiguity: Caption says 'चार नंबर का' but the context is sign 2 and the second house; read as 2.
classical_check: Mars in the 2nd house is classically mixed (harsh speech, but wealth by effort); this is more optimistic.

hindi: पर पैसा अंधा दे सकता है लेकिन कर्जे के द्वारा
says: Money can pour in, but by way of loans or debt.
ambiguity: Not investment advice; recorded as his claim.
classical_check: Mars is the classical karaka of debts; agrees.

hindi: दो नंबर के साथ मंगल का हिसाब किताब लिंक हो गया यह क्या करेगा यह पर पुरुष या पर स्त्री के पास भी ये इतनी अधिक सेक्सुअल ऊर्जा बढ़ा देगा
says: When Mars gets linked with sign 2 or Venus, it raises sexual energy so much that the person may go toward other men or other women.
cells_derived_method: The 7th and 12th houses show where the extra passion plays out.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio): passion outside the marriage.
Mars in Taurus in the 12th (lagna Gemini): secret pleasures.
Mars in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): romance-driven affairs.

hindi: तो ऐसा व्यक्ति व्यभिचारी हो जाएगा यह लोग कैसे नोवास बन जाते हैं कई बार ऐसी स्थिति बन जाएगी अब वो क्या करे ऑटोमेटिक मजबूर है बेचारा
says: Such a person will turn adulterous, and the situation arises many times; the poor man is compelled automatically and cannot help it.
ambiguity: 'नोवास' is garbled; may mean 'notorious'.
classical_check: Classics link Mars-Venus to promiscuity but not to compulsion; the compulsion is his framing.

hindi: और भयंकर शार्प होगा क्योंकि आग घी हवन हो जाता है पूरा देवता प्रसन्न हो जाते हैं शार्प इतना होगा
says: Such a Mars-Venus person is also extremely sharp, because fire plus ghee becomes a havan and the gods are pleased.
classical_check: Not classical; sharp intellect from Mars is acceptable.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक शार्पनेस बहुत ज्यादा ऑटोमेटिक अग्नि की तरह बात होगी जो काम हाथ में ले लिया करके ही छोड़ेंगे
says: The sharpness is automatic and fiery in speech, and whatever task he takes up he will finish before leaving it.
classical_check: Mars gives persistence and drive; agrees.

hindi: और सोचो है क्या घी को जला रहा है क्योंकि मंगल अग्नि और भड़क गई घी के साथ
says: Think what is happening: Mars burns the ghee, and since Mars is fire it flares up even more with ghee, the Venus matter.
classical_check: Imagery only.

hindi: अब यही मंगल घी से भड़का था अब यह आ गया तेल पेट्रोल मिल गया इसको अब सोचो अब कितना भड़के अब तो बम बना देगा आकाश की रिकॉर्ड्स निकाल देगा
says: The Mars already flared by ghee now meets oil and petrol, which is Saturn, and flares so much that it makes a bomb and breaks sky-high records.
cells_derived_method: Record-breaking energy and results in the house topics at Capricorn.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): towering career.
Mars in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn): explosive willpower.
Mars in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer): driven, high-achieving partner.

ambiguity: Sign 10 is named in the next sentence; Aquarius (11) could also be Saturn's.
classical_check: Mars exalted in Capricorn (Saturn's sign) is a classically powerful placement; agrees.

hindi: यह मंगल अकेला ग्रह है जो आपको पूर्व जन्म की कृपा के द्वारा पितरों के द्वारा जो मिलती है या मंगल के 10 नंबर राशि से लिंक होने से आपको एक स्पेसिफिक योग देता है कुंडली में
says: Mars is the only planet that, through grace from past births or ancestors, or through a link with sign 10, gives a specific yoga in the chart.
cells_derived_method: The yoga shows in the house where Mars-Capricorn falls.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): Ruchaka-like yoga, career grace.
Mars in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn): Ruchaka-like yoga, personal power.
Mars in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): Ruchaka-like yoga, property and home comfort.

classical_check: Ruchaka yoga arises from Mars in Capricorn, Aries or Scorpio in a kendra; this particular grace-yoga is his own.

hindi: कि बेटा जितना कम पढ़ोगे उतने अच्छे मार्क्स आएंगे जितना कम मेहनत करोगे उतना ज्यादा नोट छापोगे
says: The yoga's result: the less you study the better your marks, and the less effort you put in the more money you make; the results come without much labour.
ambiguity: Statement about money is a claim, not investment advice.
classical_check: Not classical; Ruchaka gives fame and wealth but not effortlessness.

hindi: आग आप समझ लें धीमी आंच पर पकाया भयंकर टेस्टी खाना बनता है वो हांडी के ऊपर खाना बनाते हैं
says: Analogy: food cooked on a slow flame in a handi tastes superb, so a steady slow fire gives a better result than a raging one.
classical_check: Imagery only.

gist: Aside that slow-cooked dal sells well on food apps like Zomato, with a taste people rave about.

hindi: ये तेल है इसमें अग्नि धधक है चली हुई है ये इतना पावरफुल चलेगा कि आपको कम से कम मेहनत करनी है कम से कम प्रयास
says: Here the oil has a fire burning in it, and it runs so powerfully that you need the least labour and the least effort.
classical_check: Not classical.

gist: Example of a billionaire who works two hours, flies around, parties and goes to hotels.
Example of Ambani: 24 hours a day like everyone, announcements, inaugurations and signing; his actual work is only two hours and the rest he delegates.

hindi: यह मंगल जैसे ग्रह होते हैं जो आपको रॉकेट बनाने पर तुले हैं लेकिन शर्त ये है कि मेहनत कम करनी है
says: Planets like Mars are bent on making you a rocket, on the condition that you work less hard.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: अब हमें सिखाया गया है मेहनत कर खेलोगे कूदोगे बनोगे खराब पढ़ोगे लिखोगे होगा सत्यानाश ऐसे ग्रह का स्वामी मंगल बन जाता है
says: Against the proverb 'work hard, play and you'll be spoiled', in this yoga he reverses the advice: the person thrives by playing and rushing about, and hard study ruins him; Mars becomes the lord of such a person.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled: 'ध्वनि' for 'नवाब', and the proverb is inverted. Read loosely.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति अपना चैनल चलाते हैं अपनी किताब
says: Such Mars-driven people run their own channel and bring out their own book, becoming self-made media figures; the sentence is cut off.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut by the end of the chunk.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: लिखते हैं ई यह मंगल की कृपा है क्योंकि आग धधक रही है यही आग जब यम के है बर्फ पिघल के पानी बना देती है मौत की मौत हो जाती है यह भी नीच उच्च का समान फल है
says: Mars is a blazing fire. When that fire sits with Yama (Pluto, the death planet) it melts Pluto's ice into water, so the death effect of Pluto is itself killed. He adds that this Mars-Pluto result is the same whether the planet is in an exalted or a debilitated state.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction of Mars and Pluto in any house: the house topic decides where the death-type threat (loss, crisis, sudden ending) shows and gets neutralised; the sign decides how hot or cold the meeting is (fire signs let Mars dominate, water or air signs dilute it).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars (own sign) with Pluto in the house of crisis and longevity: sudden-loss indications are said to melt away, strongest case of fire defeating ice.
Derived: Mars in own sign with Pluto in the house of disease and enemies: illness or enemy threats get burned off, victory over opposition.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer with Pluto in the house of home: by his claim the effect is still protective, but a watery sign weakens the fire so the home-related loss is only partly removed.

ambiguity: 'Nich uchch ka saman phal' could mean the Mars-Pluto result is equal in exalted and debilitated Mars, or that Pluto's exalted/debilitated state does not matter; Pluto has no agreed exaltation in classical texts.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not in classical Jyotish, this is his own scheme.

hindi: मतलब यमराज है ये मौत है हनुमान इसकी भी नास पीट के खत्म कर देते हैं
says: He equates Pluto with Yamaraj, meaning death itself, and says Hanuman, who stands for Mars, wipes even this out. So Mars is presented as the one planet that can overcome the Pluto death energy.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts assign Mars to Hanuman-type strength but never link Mars to Pluto.

gist: Who won over death: Ram and Lakshman bound in the serpent noose, Garuda freed them, Hanuman brought the Sanjeevani herb, Sita refused to be carried off.
Whether the Ramayana is true or false does not matter to him; he only takes the remedy and the reading of planets from it.

hindi: हनुमान मंगल अग्नि बर्फ जमा हुआ दिमाग भी खुल जाता है पाताल से रावण को नास पीट पाट के लेया पंचमुखी हनुमान कितना कितना मशहूर यह मंगल है यह
says: Hanuman is Mars, which is fire. Fire can thaw a frozen, stuck mind and open it up. He cites Panchmukhi Hanuman dragging Ravana back from the underworld as proof of how famous and powerful Mars is.
cells_derived_method: Mars's thawing power shows where in the chart a stuck situation opens: the house Mars occupies is where blocked matters start moving, and fire signs give it free play while water signs slow it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the house of effort and courage: stuck initiatives open fast through personal drive.
Derived: Mars exalted in the house of career: a frozen career situation thaws through forceful action.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the house of intelligence: the thawing of the mind is weaker, comes in bursts of anger rather than clear thought.

classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe Mars as thawing the mind; this is his imagery.

hindi: मौत को भी मात दे सकता है और मंगल का स्थान क्या है नाभी नाभी पर बैठ के अग्नि क्या करती है सब साफ
says: Mars can defeat death, and the body seat of Mars is the navel. Fire sitting at the navel burns everything and cleans it, which is the digestive fire.
cells_derived_method: Mars as navel and digestive fire: in a chart, Mars strong in a fire sign or in the 1st/3rd/10th shows a strong digestive system tradition-wise, Mars in water signs or the 6th/8th/12th shows a weaker fire.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign in the lagna house: strong body fire and good digestion tradition claim.
Derived: Mars debilitated in a water sign in the house of loss: the navel fire is weak, digestion said to be unreliable.
Derived: Mars own sign in the house of disease: strong fire fights disorders, good digestion held to resist illness.

ambiguity: This is a body-part karaka only, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Mars as jatharagni (digestive fire) is a classical idea; navel as seat of Mars is common in folk astrology.

hindi: अगर आपने अपने जीवन में आदत डाल ली भाड़ में जाए आपकी नाभी इतनी पावरफुल होगी पहले तो आपका हाजमा सेट है दूसरा आपको मित्र बहुत मिलेंगे
says: If you build the habit (of the clean-fire practice he was describing), your navel becomes very powerful. First your digestion is set right, and second you will gain many friends.
ambiguity: The habit he refers to is not clear in the caption (a garbled phrase before it); the result named is a strong navel, digestion and friends.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि हनुमान मित्र मंगल मित्र इतने बनाता है ऐसे ऐसे मित्र बनाएगा भाइयों से बढ़ के भाइयों का स्थान खराब हो मित्र ही आपको पार लगा देगा
says: Mars makes friends, as Hanuman is the friend. Mars gives friends who are better than brothers, so even if the house of brothers (the 3rd) is spoiled, a friend will carry you across.
cells_derived_method: Mars's friend-giving shows where friends help: Mars in the 11th gives gains through friends, Mars in the 3rd with a spoiled 3rd house gives friends in place of siblings, Mars in a water sign makes the friendships emotional but less loyal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign in the house of gains: a wide circle of strong friends who fund and support.
Derived: Mars own sign in the sibling house: friends take the place of brothers.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the house of partnership: friends turn into dependants or quarrel.

ambiguity: Whether he means the 3rd house (siblings) by 'brothers ka sthan' or the 11th is not stated; 3rd is the usual brother house.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Mars is brother karaka, friends are the 11th; his extension of Mars to friends is his own.

hindi: ये मंगल राहु के पास जाता है बेबसी का है अब हनुमान जी हैं ये बेबस करोगे ना इनको ये खासियत है बस मंगल की खासियत है कि यह राहु जो है ना इसकी जो ऐसी तैसी फेरता है
says: When Mars goes near Rahu, it is the helplessness situation (bebasi, Rahu being helplessness). But Hanuman cannot really be made helpless; the special quality of Mars is that it overpowers Rahu and wrecks Rahu's game.
cells_derived_method: Mars with Rahu: the house shows where helplessness is felt and then broken by action; the sign shows the type: fire signs give explosive breaking out, earth signs slow grinding, water signs emotional struggle.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign with Rahu in the career house: pressure and obstruction at work are broken through by sheer force.
Derived: Mars own sign with Rahu at home: domestic helplessness and unrest, but the native overpowers it.
Derived: Mars debilitated with Rahu in the 8th: the helplessness is stronger as Mars has less power to overpower Rahu.

classical_check: Differs in tone: classical texts call Mars-Rahu (angaraka yoga) troublesome; he says Mars overpowers Rahu.

hindi: वो फेर ही मंगल सकता है ये सूर्य की भी ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है लेकिन मंगल हनुमान है बांध दिया ये अपनी पूंछ सेही मरवा देगा
says: Only Mars can do that to Rahu; Mars can also wreck the Sun's game, but since Mars is Hanuman it ties up and finishes off its enemy with its own tail. The second half of the caption is partly garbled.
cells_derived_method: Mars over the Sun: in a chart the Sun's matters (father, authority, status) are the ones Mars can disturb; the house of the conjunction decides the area and the sign the strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars with the Sun in the career house with the Sun exalted: authority and drive combine, Mars pushes and overrides the Sun's calm.
Derived: Mars with the Sun in the house of father and fortune in Leo: friction with father or authority figures, Mars's heat overpowers.

ambiguity: The part about tying with its tail and killing is garbled and may belong to the Ravana story; recorded only as Mars overpowers Rahu and Sun.
classical_check: Silent on Mars overpowering the Sun; classical texts call Sun and Mars friends.

hindi: कहां से तबाह करता है केतु से तो केतु मंगल का एजेंट है अगर आपके पास राहु एक्चुअली एजेंट है अभी राहु की बात करेंगे शनि का केतु मंगल का एजेंट है
says: Mars does its destroying through Ketu, so Ketu is Mars's agent. Rahu is the agent of Saturn (he will discuss Rahu later). The rule is: Rahu works for Saturn and Ketu works for Mars.
cells_derived_method: Agent logic: a strong Ketu in a house executes what Mars signifies there, and a strong Rahu executes what Saturn signifies; so read Ketu's house through Mars topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the sibling house with Mars as sign lord: Ketu acts as Mars's hand, sudden bold action, argument with siblings.
Derived: Rahu in the career house with Saturn as sign lord: Rahu acts as Saturn's agent, hard work and structure through unusual means.

classical_check: Differs/silent: classical texts give Rahu and Ketu the lordship of the sign they occupy; Ketu-as-Mars-agent follows older Ketu-Mars similarity but Rahu-as-Saturn-agent is more common.

hindi: अगर आपको बेबसी ने बांध दी है मंगल क्या है पुरुषार्थ कोई काम करने में बेबस हो आप कर नहीं पा रहे तो केतु करेगा आपका काम
says: If helplessness has bound you, remember that Mars is purushartha (effort). When you are helpless to do a task, Ketu will do your work for you.
ambiguity: Caption jumps over the 1:47:05 timestamp; the line is one sentence about Mars as purushartha and Ketu as the doer.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: केतु क्या करता है हनुमान जी की पूंछ ये शब्द बने हुए हैं कौन है केतु कुत्ता केतु है सबसे बढ़िया कुत्ते की सेवा करो बात ही खत्म
says: Ketu is Hanuman's tail, so the word-image fits. Ketu is the dog. The best remedy is to serve dogs, and that settles it.
classical_check: Agrees: dog as Ketu karaka and dog service as a Ketu remedy is a standard tradition.

hindi: बाकी ये इतनी लंबी लिस्ट है केतु की अगर हम ढूंढेंगे आपके पास कार्य करने वाले बच्चे भी है वहां पर भी केतु आपको मिलेगा उनकी सेवा कर सकते हैं
says: The list of Ketu things is long. Children or helpers who do work for you are also Ketu, so you can serve them as a Ketu remedy.
ambiguity: 'Kaarya karne wale bachche' may mean children, juniors or helpers/servants.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu as servants and subordinates appears in some traditions.

hindi: आपको कुछ नहीं करना अपने कुत्ते की सेवा करनी है कुत्ते को आप नॉनवेज खिलाओ चाहे कुत्ते को चाहे रोटी खिलाओ ब्रेड खिलाओ कुत्ते की सेवा करनी है
says: You need to do nothing else; only serve your dog. Feeding the dog non-veg, roti or bread are all fine, the point is service to the dog.
classical_check: Differs partly: classical remedies prefer roti and milk to dogs; non-veg is not usually prescribed.

hindi: कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा कोई वेट ढूंढ लो विदेशों में कुत्ते की कितनी सेवा की पालतू कर लेते हैं इंसान की कदर होए ना होए कुत्ते की बहुत कदर है
says: If nothing is clear to you, find a vet and look after a dog. In foreign countries people keep dogs as pets and value them more than people, which is why those countries show Ketu's results.
classical_check: Silent on the foreign-country comparison.

hindi: लेकिन प्रोस्पेरिटी आती है बड़ी जबरदस्त सोने की लंका भी जेब में है साजो समान चीजें प्रेम नहीं हो प्रेम की बात नहीं हो रही है पार्टी खूब होती है लेकिन प्रेम नहीं
says: Ketu service brings great prosperity, like having golden Lanka in your pocket, with goods and comforts, and many parties. But love is not part of it; there is no real love in this result.
cells_derived_method: Ketu strong gives material comfort without emotional bond; houses of gain and comfort show the prosperity, while the 5th and 7th house of love stay dry.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: strong Ketu in the house of gains with Mars lord: large gains and many contacts, little affection.
Derived: Ketu in the house of partnership in a sign where Ketu has strength: comfort and social life from partner, but detached relationship.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: प्रेम के लिए आपको चंद्रमा सेट करना पड़ेगा बृहस्पति को समझना पड़ेगा शुक्र को आधार लेना पड़ेगा भोग के लिए भोग उसके पास
says: For love you must set the Moon, understand Jupiter and take Venus as the base. Bhoga (sensual enjoyment) lies with Venus, so Venus is the planet of that.
cells_derived_method: Love in the chart: judge Moon (feeling), Jupiter (care, wisdom), Venus (attraction); a weak one in the 5th or 7th shows the gap.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus own sign in the house of partnership: gives enjoyment and the base of love.
Derived: Moon own sign in the house of romance: strong feeling base for love.

ambiguity: The last words continue on the next timestamp (bhoga belongs to Venus).
classical_check: Agrees: Moon, Jupiter and Venus as love planets is standard; Venus as bhoga karaka is classical.

hindi: है अयाशी के लिए इंद्र को सेट करना पड़ेगा प्रेम भले ना हो लेकिन कुत्ते की सेवा मात्र से केतु सेट हो जाता है
says: For debauchery or luxury indulgence one must set Indra (Uranus). Even without love, simply serving a dog sets Ketu right.
classical_check: Silent on Indra as the luxury planet.

hindi: सारा घर साफ सुथरा रखने से धूल मिट्टी हटा देने से मकड़ी के जाले ना हो रंग कर चलने वाले जितने भी जानवर है ये जिनसे स्त्रियां विशेष तौर से डरती है ये छिपकली इत्यादि सब ये राहु और केतु के खेल है
says: Keeping the whole house clean, removing dust, and having no spider webs is a Ketu remedy. Crawling animals such as lizards, which women fear, are all Rahu-Ketu play.
classical_check: Agrees partly: creeping creatures and dirt as Rahu-Ketu karakas is traditional.

hindi: करते हैं बात इनकी फिर मंगल केतु के साथ है ये तो पूछ है इसकी बादल है अग्नि के पीछे धुआ तो होएगा ही बादल धुए का होता है
says: Mars with Ketu: Ketu is its tail and its cloud. Smoke follows fire, and a cloud is made of smoke, so Ketu is the natural companion of Mars.
cells_derived_method: Mars-Ketu conjunction: house gives area where action and its smoke (side effects) happen; own-sign Mars gives clean fire, debilitated Mars gives only smoke.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign with Ketu in the lagna house: energy with side effects, strong bold body with frequent minor injuries.
Derived: Mars own sign with Ketu in the house of courage: action without noise, effective silent strength.
Derived: debilitated Mars with Ketu in the house of fortune: smoke without fire, lots of intention little result.

classical_check: Agrees partly: Ketu is said to act like Mars in classical texts.

hindi: केतु के बिना तो मंगल एजिस्ट ही नहीं कर सकता तो ये तो इसका परम परम परम मित्र है और केतु कोने दे दैत्य है बेसिकली
says: Mars cannot exist without Ketu, so Ketu is its closest friend. Ketu is basically a demon (daitya) in the story.
ambiguity: 'Kone de daitya' is a garbled phrase; read as 'Ketu is basically a daitya'.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Ketu as a demon head-less body is classical; Mars as its closest friend is his claim.

gist: Dramatic dialogue of Ketu welcoming Hanuman: 'Come Lord, I have been longing for you'.

hindi: क्योंकि पुरुषार्थ यानी कार्य करने की क्षमता बॉडी के इस्य से है यह सिर्फ डायरेक्शन देता है केतु है
says: Purushartha means the ability to do work. Ketu only gives direction to the action, it does not give the strength.
ambiguity: Caption 'bodi ke isy se' garbled; reading as the work capacity coming from the body.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और जिसमें जान गुर्दे में कहते हैं वो ऑटोमेटिक सेट करता है यह राहु है ना तो बॉडी को जान देता है बॉडी काम किससे करेगी मंगल से केतु किसके निर्धारण पर चल रही है मंगल के
says: What gives the body life, the thing said to be in the kidneys, runs automatically and is Rahu, which gives the body its life. The body does the work through Mars, and Ketu follows Mars's decision.
ambiguity: Rahu as the life-giver in the body is his claim; the caption mix of kidneys and life is hard to parse.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give life force (prana) to Sun.

hindi: है पुरुषार्थ करना है यार कहते हैं ना गुर्दे में जान है यानी मंगल का दोष होगा तो आपकी किडनी में स्टोन हो जाएगा किडनी खराब हो जाएगी
says: Mars is purushartha and the common phrase says the strength is in the kidneys. He says that if Mars is afflicted, kidney stones or kidney damage can occur (a tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis).
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Mars gives kidney trouble per his claim; the house of the affliction (6th, 8th) adds disease, and a Mars debilitated in Cancer or in dusthana would be the worst case.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the house of disease: kidney weakness flagged tradition-wise.
Derived: Mars own sign in the 8th: strong but sudden problems, lowest kidney risk of the cases.

ambiguity: Medical claim, flagged only as tradition.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars governs kidneys and bile in some body maps; Scorpio region.

hindi: सूर्य में दोष होता है तो किडनी स्टोन बनता है और मंगल में दोष होगा तो किडनी कट लगाता है की खासियत है जहां गड़बड़ होगा वहां कट लगा देगा
says: He says Sun affliction forms kidney stone, while Mars affliction brings cuts: Mars's special trait is that wherever there is a fault in the body it makes a cut there (tradition claim only).
