hindi: आपको बच्चे को निशान लगे हैं बाहर गिर गया ई मम्मी खून निकला बधाई हो भगवान की कृपा है यहां का बाहर कट लग गया अंदर नहीं जाएगा आपके बच्चे ने कह दिया ओ यहां चोट लग गई बच गया बधाई हो कृपा है
says: When a child gets an outside cut and bleeds, congratulations: it is God's grace because the injury stayed outside and the problem will not go inside. He reads an external Mars cut as a protective sign.
classical_check: Silent: his own interpretation of Mars injuries.

hindi: आंख बचेगी बच्चे की आंख का ऑपरेशन नहीं होगा इसलिए उसकी चोट लग लेने दो और रोने बाद में यह ना कहो नहीं कमांड मत दो भगवान इससे तो अच्छा मुझे दे देता
says: The child's eye will be saved from an operation because the outside hurt happened, so let the hurt happen and do not complain or give God commands. Complaining may make God cancel the favour.
ambiguity: Medical outcome is his claim only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भगवान कहेगा ठीक है कैंसिल अंदर से आंख ही फोडा आपको कट लगा कर के ठीक भी कर दे तो भी मंगल की कृपा है यह मंगल इंद्र के पास है आठ नंबर
says: If you complain, God will cancel the favour and the problem can go inside the eye. Even if Mars cuts you open to fix something, that is Mars's grace. Then he turns to Mars with Indra (Uranus) at number 8.

hindi: पार्टी इंद्र की सभा में भी मंगल का स्वागत है अग्नि का स्वागत वहां भी है
says: Mars (with Indra) is welcome in Indra's court of parties and pleasure, just as fire is welcome at every feast.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Scorpio or with Uranus: the house shows where enjoyment and social glamour fall; Scorpio's water element tempers the fire.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign in the house of entertainment: strong party and romance life.
Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the house of gains: social networks bring pleasures and income.
Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the house of family and food: indulgence in food, family parties.

classical_check: Silent on Indra: Uranus is not classical.

hindi: अग्नि राग रंग इत्यादि हर चीज में आती है जबरदस्त फल है यह दोनों एक ही स्थान पर रहते हैं मंगल और इंद्र आठ नंबर और एक नंबर

classical_check: Partly agrees: Aries and Scorpio are Mars's own signs; Indra's lordship of Scorpio is his scheme.

hindi: वरुण समुद्र देवता यहां पंगा है अग्नि समुद्र का कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ सकती यहां पर अंडर परफॉर्मेंस हो जाएगी मंगल की मंगल पूर्ण कार्य नहीं कर पाएगा यहां पर नष्ट तो होएगा ही नहीं आग का गोला है
says: Mars with Varuna (Neptune), the sea deity, is the problem spot. Fire cannot spoil the sea, so Mars underperforms and cannot do its full work, but it will not be destroyed since it is a ball of fire.
cells_derived_method: Mars with Neptune: the house of the pairing is where effort fizzles; water signs strengthen Neptune's dampening, fire signs help Mars hold out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Neptune-type water sign at career house: effort gets diluted, work feels foggy, no collapse.
Derived: Mars own sign in house of enemies with Neptune: still fights, but less decisively.
Derived: Mars in Libra (sign of Neptune in his scheme) in the house of courage: reduced drive.

ambiguity: The sign of Varuna is unstated; he said '1 number' before; the Neptune sign (Libra or Pisces) is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Neptune.

hindi: लेकिन प्रेम की मजे की बात यहां है मंगल नेगेटिव नहीं करेगा समुद्र की याद करिए कथा बनिए सुरसा नाम की राक्षसी के लिए हनुमान जी जब उड़ते हुए गए लंका तो बीच में आ गई समुद्र आ गया एक प्रकार से
says: The interesting thing is that Mars does not turn negative here. He recalls Hanuman crossing the sea to Lanka, where the demoness Surasa blocked him, as the sea in another form.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फिर हनुमान जी ने छोटे बड़े होकर ड्रामा करके उससे मुकाबला नहीं किया लड़ाई नहीं करी तो मंगल लड़ेगा नहीं यहां पर लड़ाका नहीं बनेगा लेकिन निकल आएगा
says: Hanuman did not fight Surasa; he changed size and found a way past. So Mars with Varuna will not fight and will not become a fighter, but it will find its way out.
cells_derived_method: Mars with Neptune: avoidance rather than conflict; house tells where conflict is dodged (6th enemies, 7th partners, 3rd rivals).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars own sign in the house of enemies: enemies avoided by clever escape rather than fight.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह यमराज है मौत यहां भी सर्वश्रेष्ठ 11 नंबर में भी सबसे सुंदर लाजवाब भयंकर पावरफुल इफेक्ट देगा मंगल
says: With Yamaraj (Pluto, death) Mars is again at its best, and in number 11 (Aquarius, the sign linked to Pluto) it gives a very beautiful, wonderful, fearsome and powerful effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Pluto in the career house: powerful, feared position, authority through force.

classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not classical.

hindi: ये बुध है हवा हवा रोशनी में भी बढ़िया है जल में होती है हवा जल में होती है अग्नि बहुत बढ़िया यहां एक

hindi: नंबर में भी बढ़िया है ज्ञान में भी बहुत बढ़िया है घी और दही यहां पर भी बहुत बढ़िया हवा के द्वारा ही बनती है दही पड़े रहो छोड़ दो बनती रहेगी
says: Mercury (air) is good at number 1 (Aries) and with knowledge (Jupiter), and good with ghee and curd (Venus-type things), because curd is made by air: just leave it and it sets on its own.

hindi: तेल में भी बहुत बढ़िया है हवा बेबसी में भी बहुत बढ़िया है हवा सांस चलती रहेगी हवा बादल के लिए भी बहुत बढ़िया है हवा इंद्र के लिए भी बहुत बढ़िया है हवा
says: Mercury (air) works well with oil (Saturn), with helplessness (Rahu), since breath keeps going even then, with clouds (Ketu) and with Indra (Uranus). In other words Mercury is comfortable with Saturn, Rahu, Ketu and Uranus.

hindi: हवा वरुण समुद्र में भी है कैसा यूनिवर्स देवता है इसीलिए यह नपुंसक ग्रह है बुध को नपुंसक कहते हैं स्त्री नपुंसक ग्रह है

hindi: देवी कौन है इसकी दुर्गा अब दुर्गा माता को समझे दुर्गा का पति नहीं माना जाता कोई दुर्गा देवी है वोह भगवती है ऐसा नहीं भगवती के पार्वती के पति हैं
says: Mercury's goddess is Durga. Durga is not considered to have a husband; she is the Bhagwati. Parvati has a husband, but Durga as Bhagwati stands alone.

hindi: पार्वती रूप में जो भगवती है दुर्गा है वह शिव है लेकिन भगवती जो है वह स्वयंभू है वो ऑटो है उनका ऐसा नहीं है कि पति है या उनके कोई बच्चे हैं संकेतिक माने जाएंगे सब बच्चे
says: In the Parvati form the goddess has Shiva as husband, but Bhagwati herself is self-born and independent, with no husband; any children are only symbolic. This fits Mercury's neuter, independent nature.

hindi: भगवती दुर्गा तो बुद्ध यहां भी लाजवाब बुद्ध यहां भी बहुत बढ़िया अब बुद्ध 12 नंबर में नीच का होता है यह इसकी नीचता भी चित्र है
says: Bhagwati Durga goes with Mercury, who is excellent here too. He then says Mercury is debilitated in number 12 (Pisces); its debasement is also a picture, an image he will explain.

Derived: Mercury debilitated in the partner house: confusion in partnerships and contracts.

ambiguity: '12 number' read as sign 12 (Pisces), and it matches Mercury's debilitation.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces.

hindi: देखो बुध 12 नंबर में नीच है बादल है धुआ अंगीठी जला दी अंगीठी जला दी जहर निकाल दिया अंगीठी ने कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड हवा कैसी हो गई हवा तो फिर भी है हवा तो कहीं जाने वाली नहीं है लेकिन हवा दूषित हो गई
says: Mercury is debilitated in number 12 (Pisces) and he pictures it as cloud and smoke. If you light a coal stove, it gives off poison, carbon monoxide: the air is still there and does not go anywhere, but it is polluted. So debilitated Mercury is polluted intellect, not absent intellect.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mercury in Pisces: the knowledge and speech faculty exists but is contaminated; the house decides which area of life gets the polluted thinking (4th education, 7th contracts, 10th business, 3rd communication).

ambiguity: '12 number' is read as Pisces (sign 12), which matches Mercury's debilitation.
classical_check: Agrees on the debilitation; the polluted-air imagery is his own.

hindi: अब अगर च तो आपने बुद्धि द्वारा यानी कि जानकारी द्वारा अंदर एक ज्ञान है लेकिन बुद्ध खराब है तो बोलोगे नहीं ढंग से और बोलोगे नहीं ढंग से तो बुद्ध का दोष है अगर ये दोष आ गया तो जहर विषैला बादल बना देगा इसका ये
says: You may have knowledge inside through intellect and information, but if Mercury is spoiled you will not be able to speak properly. Improper speech is Mercury's fault, and that fault turns the cloud into a poisonous cloud.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in the house of speech: this problem is absent, speech is clear and persuasive.

hindi: लेकिन अगर यह विषैला नहीं है यानी कि 12 नंबर का केतु आपकी कुंडली में ठीक है और बृहस्पति ठीक है यानी बुध का लफड़ा क्या है
says: The cloud is not poisonous if the number-12 Ketu in your chart is fine and Jupiter is fine. So the problem of debilitated Mercury depends on the condition of Ketu and Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter is exalted in the lagna house (Cancer), so the Mercury weakness gets cleaned.

classical_check: Partly agrees with neecha-bhanga ideas (cancellation by dispositor), but here Ketu and Jupiter act as the cancelling pair, which is his scheme.

hindi: ये अपने जिस घर में गया उसके मालिक के हिसाब से नाश करेगा या मालिक के हिसाब से खराब अगर केतु खराब है या बृहस्पति
says: Mercury will do damage according to the lord of the house it has gone into; it spoils things as that lord would. This damage happens if Ketu or Jupiter is bad.

hindi: बृहस्पति और केतु काम करेंगे 12 नंबर के लिए उसके साथ अगर बुध बैठ गया अगर बुध 12 नंबर का है कुंडली में अब देखना ये पड़ेगा कि केतु क्योंकि सबसे बुरा फल देता है ये देखना पड़ेगा केतु और
says: Jupiter and Ketu are the ones who work for number 12; if Mercury sits with them, that is a Mercury in sign 12. You must then check Ketu, because it gives the worst fruit, and Jupiter.

says: If Jupiter and Ketu are both fine, debilitated Mercury in sign 12 makes a person a crorepati. The cloud then covers all negative things. (Wealth claim recorded as his statement only, not financial advice.)

hindi: यह क्या करेगा आपको बहुत कंट्रोवर्सी में डालेगा और राजा बना देगा अच्छा बुध क्या करता है मान लो कर्म स्थान में बैठ गया ये काम के स्थान में अब नीच रहे

classical_check: Agrees partly: 12th house as the house of charity to unknown people is traditional.

hindi: अब यहां पर हमने शनि है एक नंबर हो गया नीच का है तबाह बर्बाद अब हमने अनजान लोगों को बैठ कर के शनि का दान देना शुरू कर दिया हमने
says: Now in the 12th house with Saturn in sign number 1 (Aries) Saturn is debilitated, ruined and destroyed; so we began giving Saturn donations to unknown people, matching a bad planet with a bad place. The slice ends before the result.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated planet in a loss-type house: donate that planet's goods to strangers, as bad planet goes to bad place.

derived_examples.reading: Stated: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 12th: donate Saturn items to strangers.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 8th: unknown people and hidden giving also fit, as 8th is a hidden house.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 6th: donate to the needy and servants, not to family.

ambiguity: The result of the donation is cut off at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Agrees on Saturn being debilitated in Aries.

hindi: जूते बांट दिए यहां से बीमारी होती है अगले दिन ही माथा फटेगा पता नहीं कोई नस फटेगी पैरों में थकान आएगी बीवी से लड़ाई होगी बेड टूटेगा
says: He warns that a wrongly chosen donation (here shoes, a Saturn-type item) can backfire the very next day: headache, leg tiredness, a quarrel with the wife, furniture breaking and hospital expense. Wrong charity is claimed to bring on the troubles it was meant to remove. The health items are his tradition-claim colour, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Whether a Saturn donation helps or harms depends on the house Saturn occupies and rules in this lagna: from a house of loss or disease (6, 8, 12) it is read as more dangerous, from a supportive house less so. Sign nature of Saturn's sign (own, exalted, debilitated) modifies the same.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 8th (lagna Pisces, since 7 minus 8 plus 1 = 0 which is 12). Saturn rules the 11th and 12th and sits in the 8th; donating might feed sudden events, so by his logic check before giving.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn, its own sign, in the 10th (lagna Aries). Saturn is strong in the karma house, so a Saturn donation is less likely to be the damaging kind by his logic.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries). Weak Saturn on the self house; a donation would feed a debilitated planet and he would call it risky.

ambiguity: Caption does not say which item or which planet the shoe donation belongs to; shoes are linked to Saturn only by tradition.
classical_check: Classical texts list shoes among Saturn's donation items but do not warn of next-day harm; the warning is his own.

hindi: अब यहां शनि का दान कैसे करें मारे गए गुलफाम बिल्कुल जिंदगी नर्क हो जाएगी तो वो कर बहुत नेगेटिव है यहां पर
says: For a chart where Saturn sits in a bad position, he says doing Saturn donation is a disaster: life turns hellish because the planet is very negative in that spot, so the usual Saturn charity must not be done mechanically.
cells_derived_method: The 'here' points to a board position he drew that the caption lost. Derived: Saturn donation is reasoned from Saturn's house (dusthana, kendra) and sign dignity; harmful when it feeds a planet already damaging a house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries). Saturn rules the 10th and 11th and sits in the loss house; he would ask which role is being fed before donating.

Derived: Saturn in Cancer in the 6th (lagna Aquarius, since 4 minus 6 plus 1 = -1 which is 11). Saturn is lagna lord, in the sign of enemy Moon, in the disease-and-enemy house; a donation might feed that clash.

ambiguity: The exact placement he is pointing at is not in the caption, so which cell is meant is unknown.
classical_check: Classical remedial texts prescribe Saturn donation for afflicted Saturn; he reverses that when the planet is the troublemaker in that spot, which differs from the standard rule.

hindi: आप कौन से ग्रह का दान कर रहे हो अच्छे बुरे नहीं होते ग्रह कहां कर रहे हो वो नुकसान है
says: Before donating, ask which planet you are feeding and where it sits: planets are not good or bad in themselves, their house and role decide the effect, and donating to a planet that is doing damage in its place causes loss.
cells_derived_method: Planet valence is derived from house lordship plus occupied house plus sign dignity, so the same planet is good in one lagna and harmful in another.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries). Mars is lagna lord and 8th lord, strong in a kendra; feeding it may help the career.

Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini, since 8 minus 6 plus 1 = 3). Mars rules the 6th and 11th and sits in the 6th, the enemy-fighting house; feeding it differs from the previous case.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer, since 3 minus 12 plus 1 = -8 which is 4). Jupiter rules the 6th and 9th and sits in the loss house, a mixed reading.

classical_check: Agrees with the standard functional benefic-malefic idea by lagna; differs from the natural benefic-malefic labelling used in popular remedies.

hindi: अब यहां बृहस्पति है नीच का होता है बृहस्पति नीच का गुरु को मानते हैं आप और आपने मंदिर में गुरु जी की फोटो रख ली खून के आंशु रोगे आपके घुटने किडनी लिवर सब बोल जाएंगे
says: If Jupiter is debilitated in the chart and you honour a guru and install the guru's photo in the home temple, he claims it will bring tears of blood, since worshipping a debilitated Jupiter strengthens it. He lists knees, kidney and liver as areas that would suffer; this is his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Jupiter is Capricorn, in any house. How hard the damage falls changes with the house: a Capricorn Jupiter in a kendra or trine is read differently from one in a dusthana. The listed body areas are his Jupiter-related house associations.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 1st (lagna Capricorn). Self and body themes; he would say guru worship here inflates the weak planet in the self house.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 5th (lagna Virgo, since 10 minus 5 plus 1 = 6). Children, intellect and mentors are affected; guru-worship is risky by his rule.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th (lagna Taurus, since 10 minus 9 plus 1 = 2). The dharma and teacher house, so the guru theme is most exposed.

ambiguity: The caption says only 'neech ka'; Capricorn is inferred from the standard debilitation sign. The words 'all will speak' about knees, kidney, liver are his scare phrasing.
classical_check: Classical remedial texts would worship Jupiter to help a weak Jupiter; he says the opposite for a debilitated one. This differs from the usual remedy rule.

gist: Mock dialogue: 'worshipping the guru is a sin? No, leave God and worship the guru, the guru-ghantaal who gets himself worshipped' - a jibe at self-styled gurus.

hindi: अबे यहां गुरु की गुरु ही बैंड बजा देगा बृहस्पति य बैठा हुआ है उसकी यहां से यहां दृष्टि है नीच प नौवी दृष्टि होती है
says: He says the Jupiter that sits in the debilitated place will itself ruin the guru-worshipper, because Jupiter's aspect from its seat goes onward, and the 9th aspect (a special Jupiter aspect) falls onto a debilitated position. So he explains the damage by Jupiter's 9th-house aspect landing on the debilitated point.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th houses from itself. A 9th aspect from a house H falls on house H+8. The sign it hits is that house's sign. Which planet or house is hit decides the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 1st (Capricorn lagna); its 9th aspect falls on the 9th house, Virgo.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 5th (Virgo lagna); its 9th aspect falls on the 1st house, Virgo.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 10th (Aries lagna); its 9th aspect falls on the 6th house, Virgo.

ambiguity: 'नीच प नौवी दृष्टि' could mean the 9th aspect on a debilitated planet or from a debilitated planet; the board gestures ('यहां से यहां') are lost, so the target cell is unknown.
classical_check: Jupiter's 5th, 7th, 9th aspects are classical; the claim that this aspect from a debilitated Jupiter spoils worship is his own and not in classics.

hindi: आपने गुरु जी की पूजा करके मंदिर में डाल दी नाश पिट जाएगा आपका आपने धर्म ग्रंथ की पूजा कर ली आपका बर्बाद हो
says: Repeats that worshipping the guru's picture, or worshipping a religious scripture (both Jupiter things), while Jupiter is debilitated will wreck your life. Jupiter symbols (guru, scripture) must not be strengthened when the planet is already a damaging one in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Same as the debilitated-Jupiter rule: scripture and teacher worship feeds Jupiter, so its effect follows Jupiter's house for the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 6th (lagna Leo, since 10 minus 6 plus 1 = 5). Worship feeds a planet in the disease and debt house; he would warn against it.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 12th (lagna Aquarius, since 10 minus 12 plus 1 = -1 which is 11). Loss house; scripture worship is read as pushing expenses.

ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk edge; 'बर्बाद हो' continues as 'जाओगे' in the next chunk.
classical_check: Differs from the classical advice to read scripture and worship the guru for Jupiter's strength.

gist: Says this topic is very deep and a whole separate class will cover it.
Host-style question: if a retrograde planet is in the 6th, 8th or 12th house or linked to those houses or is their lord, should a gem be worn.

hindi: ऐसा तो नहीं है कि ऐसा करने अनफेवरेबल हाउस एक्टिवेट हो जाता है 101 पर एक्टिवेट होगा
says: His answer about wearing a gem for a planet tied to the bad houses (6, 8, 12): the gem activates the unfavourable house, and he says it is 101 percent certain to do so. So a gem is not a safe default for a planet linked to a dusthana.
cells_derived_method: A gem enlarges the planet's house results: for a planet lording or sitting in 6, 8 or 12 it feeds that house's matters (disease, debt, sudden events, loss). Result varies by which house and what that house covers in the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries, since 6 minus 6 plus 1 = 1). Mercury rules the 3rd and 6th; emerald would feed the 6th house, so by him it activates 6th matters.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo, since 12 minus 8 plus 1 = 5). Jupiter rules the 5th and 8th; yellow sapphire would feed the 8th house.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo, since 4 minus 12 plus 1 = -7 which is 5). Moon rules the 12th; pearl would feed the 12th, a loss-and-foreign house.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('ऐसा तो नहीं है कि ऐसा करने...'); I read it as an affirmation, not a denial, because '101 पर' follows. The '6 आ 12' in the question was probably 6, 8, 12.
classical_check: Classical rule is that gems are worn for lords of trikona and kendra and avoided for dusthana lords; this agrees.

hindi: आपको जेम स्टोन चाहिए पन्ना और सूट आपको करता नहीं तो उसको पहनाने का तरीका ढूंढना पड़ेगा यह बहुत बड़ा चैलेंज है एक एस्ट्रोलॉजर के लिए
says: If the chart needs a gem such as emerald but it does not suit the person, the astrologer must find a method of wearing it that does suit, which he calls a big challenge. The remedy is about how and where to wear it, not only which stone.
classical_check: Classical texts give a fixed stone and finger per planet; he adds individual tailoring, which is outside the texts.

hindi: मान लेते हैं जी आपका तीन नंबर राशि है यहां पर यहां पर यहां पर और बुध में दोष है बुध में दोष सिर्फ वक्री से नहीं है
says: Example case: the number 3 (Gemini) is in the chart and Mercury has a fault, and he adds that a Mercury fault is not caused only by retrogression. Other afflictions can also make Mercury faulty.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's fault is read from sign, house and aspects, not only from motion. A Gemini placement is Mercury's own sign, so the fault depends on which house Gemini falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries). Own sign in a communication house; a fault here would come from affliction, not sign.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius, since 3 minus 7 plus 1 = -3 which is 9). Mercury rules the 7th and 10th and is in own sign; a fault would be read from aspects, not sign.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer, since 3 minus 12 plus 1 = -8 which is 4). Mercury rules the 3rd and 12th; a fault there arises from the house, not the sign.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर राशि' could mean sign number 3 (Gemini) or house number 3; the series usually means signs but he sometimes mixes. The board positions 'यहां पर' are lost.
classical_check: Classical texts list combustion, enemy sign, malefic aspect and dusthana placement as ways a planet is afflicted, so this agrees.

gist: Says the discussion will run long; retrograde has been covered, and 'vakri' is just a word to take for now.

hindi: अब यह तीन नंबर का जो है इसकी सूटेबिलिटी में हमें देखना पड़ेगा यहां दो नंबर एक्टिवेट है चार नंबर एक्टिवेट है या सिर्फ तीन ही है
says: To judge whether the gem suits for the 3 position, check whether the neighbouring 2 and 4 are also activated, or only 3. The sign or house spills into the ones next to it, so suitability depends on how many positions are active.
cells_derived_method: A house is touched by two or three signs, so the activation of the adjoining signs or houses (2 and 4 around 3) changes what the gem enlarges. Read across the neighbouring cell.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 3rd, Gemini (Aries lagna); if the 2nd (Taurus) is also active, wealth and speech join the effect.
Derived: Cancer in the 3rd (lagna Taurus, since 4 minus 3 plus 1 = 2); if the 4th (Leo) is also active, home and mother matters join.

ambiguity: Number 3 could be sign or house; the neighbour logic works for either.
classical_check: Classical texts do not weigh neighbouring activation for gems; this agrees with the multi-sign house idea but is not textual.

hindi: पता लगा वो फिक्स ही है हिलेगा ही नहीं हिलता ही नहीं है या ऐसा भी हो सकता है तो आपको तीन स्थान मिलेंगे पन्ना पहनने के
says: Next you find out whether the position is fixed and does not shift, or whether it can shift into the neighbours; if it can, you get three possible places to wear the emerald. The chart's boundary can be fixed or movable, and the result is the placement choice.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a house boundary may fall into the next house in a bhava chart. A boundary-fixed planet gives one wear position; a boundary-moving one gives up to three.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury at the start of Gemini in the 3rd could shift to the 2nd under a bhava-chalit chart, creating the second wear position.
Derived: Mercury at the end of Virgo in the 4th could shift into the 5th and give a third position. Lagna there is Gemini (6 minus 4 plus 1 = 3).

ambiguity: The caption does not say what 'fixed' refers to: the planet, the house boundary or the sign. I read it as house boundary or position.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not map house shifts to gem wearing places.

hindi: इसमें पहनना या इसमें पहनना या गले में यह बहुत डेप्थ है उसके बाद पन्ना आपका गाढ़े हरे रंग का होगा कि लाइट हरे रंग का होगा यह अलग देखना पड़ेगा
says: The three options are wearing it on one finger, on another finger, or around the neck; then the shade of the emerald, deep green or light green, is a separate decision. He stresses that gem fitting has depth: place of wearing and colour intensity are both determined individually.
ambiguity: The two fingers pointed at ('इसमें') are not named in the caption. Colour shade is carried over into the next chunk.
classical_check: Classics specify the little finger or ring finger for emerald and a good green; individual shade selection is his own addition.

hindi: इसमें जांबियन पन्ना आएगा या कोलंबियन यह अलग देखना पड़ेगा यह बहुत खिचड़ी है
says: Even the origin of the emerald, Zambian or Colombian, has to be decided separately for each person. This is another variable in gem selection that he says makes it a complicated mixture.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss gem origins by country.

gist: Begins an analogy about a doctor's skill and what the doctor's art is.
Story: his son fell ill, a doctor specified the exact tablet and told him to cut it into three, give two parts and throw one away; he obeyed and the boy recovered fully from a 104 fever.

hindi: तो पन्ना कैसा चाहिए पुखराज कैसा चाहिए खेल यही है
says: The moral of the doctor story: as the doctor prescribed a precise dose, the real skill in gem work is stating exactly what kind of emerald or yellow sapphire is needed, in what specification. The game is in the specification.
classical_check: Classical gem texts speak of quality defects but not individual dosage; the dosage view is his.

gist: Says this dosing discipline comes from medicine; all Ayurveda doctors and all acupuncture treatment work on precise dose, as an analogy for gems.
Story of a homeopath acquaintance who lets slip prescriptions while chatting; the speaker jokes that he sells stolen goods, and the doctor says take two drops not three.
Says he used to think a bigger dose would heal faster, then understood that dose has a hidden importance.

hindi: कि चार ही रत्ती पहनना छह नहीं पहनना किसी को छह रत्ती बताया पुखराज उसने 17 रत्ती पहन लिया 15 पहन लिया उसका सत्यानाश पिट गया
says: Gem weight must be exact: wear four ratti, not six. He cites a person told six ratti of yellow sapphire who wore fifteen or seventeen and was ruined. The claim is that overdosing a gem harms. I record it but do not endorse any weight.
ambiguity: Numbers in the caption (15, 17, 4, 6) may be mis-transcribed.
classical_check: Classical texts give minimum weights for gems (yellow sapphire about 3 ratti and upward) rather than a maximum; the overdose warning is his own.

hindi: इतनी ओवरडोज कर दी कि जिंदगी का एक हिस्सा इतना उखाड़ दिया और एक हिस्सा इतना बढ़ा दिया कि वो सोच रहा है बढ़ाई इसकी वजह से जो सत्यानाश पिटेगा वो दिखानी
says: An overdosed gem uproots one area of life and inflates another so much that the person suffers from the over-growth; the damage is that the gem skews life balance. Garbled ending about what he will show.
cells_derived_method: A gem enlarges the planet's house and sign matters; in excess, it enlarges its house at the cost of the opposite or neighbouring house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries); an overweight diamond may swell the wealth theme and push out the 1st-house self themes.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio, since 5 minus 10 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). Overweight ruby may swell career at the cost of the 4th house, home.

ambiguity: Last clause is garbled and I could not read it.
classical_check: Silent on gem balance effects.

hindi: ये जो स्टोन की ट्रीटमेंट है ये बहुत ज्यादा हार्ड और टेक्निकल है यह आसान नहीं है कि ऐसे ही हवा में कर दी
says: Stone treatment is very hard and technical, not something that can be handed out casually, so advising gems needs careful per-person analysis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि कोई भी दो स्टोन एक जैसी शक्ल के नहीं होते
says: The reason gem advice cannot be generic: no two stones are alike in appearance and make, so each stone has to be judged on its own.
classical_check: Classical texts list gem faults, which implicitly agrees that stones differ.

hindi: स्टोन सूट कराने के तीन तरीके हैं कि कौन सी उंगली में डालेंगे
says: There are three ways of making a stone suit a person, and one of them is deciding which finger it goes on. So the finger is a tuning knob for the same stone.
ambiguity: He names only one of the three ways here (the finger); the caption has a garbled phrase 'तो कोई दिक्कत नहीं है' before it.
classical_check: Classics fix one finger per gem; choosing the finger by suitability is a departure.

hindi: ऐसा भी हमने केसेस में देखा है जिसके अंतर्गत हमने मूंगा शनि की उंगली में भी पहना के देखा है उसने भी कमाल काम किया है
says: From cases he has seen, red coral worn on Saturn's finger (the middle finger) also worked remarkably, even though coral belongs to Mars. Experience shows finger choice can break the textbook pairing.
ambiguity: 'Shani ki ungli' taken as the middle finger, the usual Saturn finger.
classical_check: Classical rule gives coral on the ring finger for Mars; this differs.

hindi: विचित्र के ऐसा है जबक शनि से मंगल का लिंक नहीं है लेकिन वहां मूंगा उंगली सबसे लंबी में ही कमाल की है
says: It is odd that coral worked on the longest finger even in charts where Mars has no link to Saturn. So the effect of the longest finger does not depend on a Mars-Saturn connection in the chart.
ambiguity: Caption 'जबक' read as 'जब'; the sentence could also mean that coral is wonderful on the longest finger generally.
classical_check: Classics are silent; this is his empirical observation.

gist: Says it is no longer strange to him; earlier they used to lie and take shots in the dark and still do, and asks what to do if it works.
Host cue: 'yes sir, next question'; says the question is a little AI related and tea disturbed the delivery.
Question: tools like ChatGPT work on data like an astrologer does, so can they predict your horoscope accurately and give results.
Jokes it will be possible when ChatGPT version 2725 or 48 arrives.
Says human consciousness evolves and mentions a movie about AI, whose actor he cannot name.
Describes a film where a computer changes all paths and says AI could one day learn to download consciousness, as in Terminator films.
Says dogs and cats have consciousness but do not evolve while humans do; so a human-machine conflict is inevitable.
Sentence about making a dog more intelligent than us ends mid-way at the chunk edge.
Continues the AI talk with a mock line a grown machine or child would say: 'now what do I need you for, go to hell'.
Analogy: when parents make a child capable and the child says he no longer needs them, parents should not feel bad that the child stops asking after them.
Says AI will one day rise so high that it can give predictions, but consciousness will rise even higher than that.
Says humans will tune the machines through consciousness, some machines will help humans and some will help other machines, and evolution will happen.
Points to the films Chappie and Lucy, where the character becomes a chip or pen drive, as showing the same idea.
Host question: how does prarabdha work for someone of another religion such as a Muslim, whose definition of right and wrong differs.

hindi: उसके लिए प्रारब्ध वैसे ही काम करेगा जैसे करना है उसको शिक्षा नहीं है उसको सिखाया गया क्या होता ही कुछ नहीं उसकी हार्ट वैसे ही काम करेगी उसकी चेस्ट वैसे ही चलेगी
says: Prarabdha (the destiny already in motion) works the same way for a person of any religion; what he was taught or not taught does not alter it, just as his heart and chest work the same as anyone's. Destiny acts at the level of the body and life, not belief.
ambiguity: The caption gives 'उसको शिक्षा नहीं है' which probably means that religious teaching has no bearing on how the chart acts; not a claim that the person lacks education.
classical_check: Classical texts apply the horoscope to all births without distinction of faith, so this agrees; the heart-and-chest example is his own.

hindi: फेफड़े वैसे ही चलेंगे उसने क्या सीखा नहीं सीखा कोई फर्क नहीं है
says: Finishes the thought: lungs and other organs will work in the same way, and what the person did or did not learn makes no difference to how destiny plays out through him.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not address religious teaching as such.

gist: Says there are Muslims who drink although Islam calls it forbidden; religious rules are not what people actually follow.
Example of a Jain told not to eat non-veg or eat at night: if they do eat, will they be ruined? Rhetorical question, with the answer that they will not.

hindi: बॉडी नहीं सुनती है धर्म फर्म यह मुन्ना का खेल है बॉडी ने सांस ही लेनी है बॉडी ने सोना ही है
says: The body does not listen to religion; it has to breathe and sleep regardless. So he argues that the destiny the chart describes runs through the body's basic workings and is therefore the same for all faiths.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना का खेल' is slang for something trivial or a child's game; used here to belittle religious rules.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम अमेरिकंस नहीं है हम भारतीय हैं जापानी चाइनीज नहीं है लेकिन सारी दुनिया में अलग-अलग भाषा में बात करने वाले लोग एक दूसरे के साथ एक्सप्रेशन सेम शेयर करते हैं स्माइल कैसे करते हैं गुस्सा कैसे करते हैं
says: Though nations and languages differ, people everywhere share the same expressions of smiling and anger. He uses this to say humans are alike at the basic level, so the same chart logic applies to all of them.
ambiguity: He does not state the astrological conclusion in this sentence; I link it to the prarabdha question being answered.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says in the same way people abuse and threaten alike in every language, because at that level we are all dogs; asks if you have seen how Japanese and British dogs bark.
Says Canadian and Indian dogs bark exactly the same way, so there is no difference.

hindi: वह लैंग्वेज सेम है जो हमने अपनी बनाई है उससे हम अपने आप को चौधरी बना के अलग कर रहे हैं अंदरूनी तौर पर सेम ही है सारा कुछ
says: The language and labels that people have made for themselves only make them feel superior and separate; inside, everything is the same. So differences of religion or language are man-made and do not change how destiny works.
ambiguity: 'चौधरी' means a village headman; used to mean pretending to be a big man.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says because of such learned labels people became Hindu, Muslim, Christian and so on, and that is the cause of wars like Iran-Iraq.
Claims Sanskrit is the language a computer decodes most easily, takes the least space and has powerful vibration.
Recites the opening of the Gita, 'Dharmakshetre Kurukshetre... Mamakah Pandavashchaiva Sanjaya', with garbled captions.
Quips that one person could have recited it just to show style, and a learned verse gets out in a flash; the rest is garbled.
Host question: have you accepted me as guru, is that enough, or is formal guru diksha also needed.
Jokes that accepting a guru is enough only if you do not want to pay dakshina; calls it a cheap deal.
Says he has not formally taken anyone as disciple and no fee has been paid; there is a crowd and calling him guru will not do anything.

hindi: मेरे कुंडली में भगवान ने ऐसे ग्रह डाले हैं कि मेरे को गुरु के बिना ज्ञान होना है अब कुंडली में हमारे ग्रह बिना गुरु के ज्ञान प्राप्त होना है
says: About his own horoscope: he says the planets in it are placed so that he gets knowledge without a guru. He treats the lack of a teacher as written in the chart, which is why he never found one, though he does not name the planets.
cells_derived_method: Not house or sign specific as stated. Classically a self-taught pattern is read from Jupiter, the 5th and 9th houses and their lords, but he does not say which cells, so none are derived.
ambiguity: He names no planet, house or sign; the claim is personal and cannot be turned into a cell rule.
classical_check: Classical texts read teachers and learning from the 5th, 9th and Jupiter; he gives no such mapping here.

gist: Says what can anyone teach him now, and he understood he should not make a guru; restates the previous point.
Begins a story: after deciding on a guru he went to a few gurus.
Repeats that he went to a few gurus.
Story: gurus first ask for a large fee and then agree to teach once the money is paid.
Story: after the fee, the condition is that you never teach this to anyone free and keep the knowledge secret; he cancelled on the spot.
Argues that once he pays, the bond is a contract, not guru-disciple, so the teacher cannot order him to tell no one.
Says he did not learn some things that way because his own mind would not accept being bound; he could write a book and wants to distribute everything.

hindi: अब तुमने मेरे कसम दिला दी मेरे को तो गुरु का दोष लग जाएगा तुम्हारी वजह से मेरा बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब हो जाएगा भाड़ में जाओ
says: If a teacher makes you swear to keep knowledge secret and you later break it, guru dosha attaches to you and your Jupiter is disturbed. He cites this as his reason for refusing such an oath. A tradition claim that breaking a pledge to a guru damages Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter stands for guru and teachings, so guru dosha is read through Jupiter's house, sign and dignity: the 9th (teacher and dharma) and 5th (mantra and learning) show where it bites.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio, since 4 minus 9 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). Strong teacher house; the dosha would show as breaking with a teacher.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo). Weak Jupiter in the learning and mantra house; the dosha would hit more.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius, since 3 minus 7 plus 1 = -3 which is 9). Jupiter rules the lagna; the teacher tie would show through partners and public dealings.

ambiguity: 'गुरु का दोष' could mean offence against a guru or a defect in Jupiter; I read it as offence leading to Jupiter disturbance, as the next clause says.
classical_check: Classical texts mention guru-shapa and Jupiter afflictions but not an oath-breaking mechanism; this is his own link.

gist: Says he has not yet met a guru who teaches free, since such a teacher takes money and not energy, and he wants energy, not money.
Says 'big power' is what he wants, because nothing comes from fame alone; he is already famous with TV interviews and many offers.
Admits he cannot be sure of himself and is slipping a little, because maya feels good while it lasts.
Says his classes are a cheap deal and the fee is kept low so people can attend; he would not go where more money is offered, since 20 people would attend and he is useful to them.
Says he will keep going as long as his judgement is not corrupted, because nothing in life is truly one's own.
Jokes that if you take him as guru for free and he is displeased you will cry, since he has many tantrums.

hindi: अगर तुमने मुझे नाराज कर दिया तुम्हारा बृहस्पति नष्ट हो जाएगा और तुम्हें पता भी नहीं चलेगा इसलिए मत बनाओ
says: If you take someone as your guru and then displease him, your Jupiter will be destroyed and you will not even know it, so he advises not to adopt him as guru. A tradition claim that offending a guru ruins the follower's Jupiter; stated about himself.
cells_derived_method: The damage lands on Jupiter's house matters for the follower's lagna: fortune and teachers if Jupiter rules or holds the 9th, children and learning for the 5th, wealth for the 2nd or 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius, since 12 minus 2 plus 1 = 11). Jupiter rules the 2nd and 11th; wealth and family speech would suffer.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 11th (lagna Aquarius, since 9 minus 11 plus 1 = -1 which is 11). Jupiter rules the 2nd and 11th; gains would suffer.

ambiguity: Half a sentence is in the next clause: 'because you will not be able to follow me'.
classical_check: Classical texts treat insulting a guru as a cause of Jupiter affliction and loss of fortune; this agrees in spirit.

gist: Says do not take him as guru because you will not be able to follow him; to follow him you would have to be blind.
Says that if a true guru told you to sign over your property you would have to, and calls such followers easy to loot; the opening of the sentence is in the previous chunk.
Advises first completing the training of being a disciple and only then choosing a guru; says he has no mood to pose as a guru for nothing.
Tells people not to chase gurus but to switch on their own inner guru, since the class has run for many years.
Says to prove you can follow blindly and become a disciple, then the guru himself will pick you up as someone obedient; most people do not even obey.
Story: a young man who paid a fee then texted instructions on how often he should be called and what he should do, since he had paid.
Story: the speaker returned the fee and told him to take it back, calling such episodes funny and typical of the public.
Story: the young man said the swagger was gone, threw the money back at him, then sent the money again saying he owed it for what he learned.
Student's message continues: he learned so much and owes this much, but asks that the speaker note how often he should talk to him.
Speaker replies that he has hundreds of people, people are always upset with him, and returns the money again after saying he cannot make him understand.
Says that after two refunds he warned that the next payment would be kept and donated; the student was wise and did not pay again.
Point of the story: people adopt a guru casually, like putting on a blue T-shirt and changing it tomorrow.

hindi: उसे फॉलो करना पड़ेगा वो जुपिटर है
says: Once you take a guru you have to follow him, because the guru stands for Jupiter. He links the guru role to Jupiter as its significator, so following a guru is the same as honouring Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'उसे' refers to the guru just discussed; 'वो जुपिटर है' is a claim about the role, not about the planet in any chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of guru, teachers and dharma.

gist: Host says 'yes sir, last two questions'.
Quip from the audience that the last two are the best ones.
Question: if someone gives me a gift that belongs to a planet which is negative in my horoscope, what should I do.
Garbled lines that seem to say the giver knows which planet is negative in his own chart, asking for a number and address, and 'I also have to show my chart'.
Garbled opening that seems to say we are in agony, such a great maharaj, and nothing is negative.

hindi: फ्री गिफ्ट आयर रख लो और आगे बाट दो हिम्मत ये करके दिखाओ कि खुद खानी ही नहीं सब आगे बैटा दी कोई दोष नहीं है
says: A free gift, even one of a planet that is negative for you, can be accepted and then passed on to others without keeping any of it, and then no dosha attaches. Receiving and distributing it, instead of consuming it, cancels the fault.
ambiguity: The caption 'आयर रख लो' is probably 'ले लो, रख लो'; I read the sentence as: accept the gift and pass it all on.
classical_check: Classical remedial texts mostly say to avoid or donate items of an affliction planet; passing on a free gift is his own advice.

hindi: मल्टीप्लिकेटिव इफेक्ट मिलेगा किसी ऐसे संत को दान देकर देखो जिसको आपने कुछ दिया उसने आगे दे डाला 100 गुना ताकत से उसने आपको उल्टा और बेहतर कर दिया है
says: Give donations to a saint who passes on whatever he receives, and you get a multiplied return: he gives it onward with about a hundred times the force and returns you something better. Donation to a giver who redistributes is claimed to multiply.
ambiguity: '100 गुना' is a figure of speech and not a measured factor.
classical_check: Classical texts praise dana to a worthy recipient (supatra); the 'multiplied if he passes it on' idea matches the general principle but not a specific rule.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे का दान इसीलिए तो महान है आपने सिर्फ गुल्लक में डाला व आगे शौक हो गया आपको पता ही नहीं आप क्या कमा बैठे
says: Gurdwara donation is great for this reason: you only drop it in the box, it then goes out to many people, and you do not realise how much merit you have earned. A donation that is redistributed brings unseen merit.
ambiguity: 'शौक हो गया' is garbled; likely 'बंट गया' or 'शेयर हो गया', meaning it was shared onward.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not single out gurdwara donation; this is a general dana principle.

gist: Says this is the story of the culture of the word guru, and it would be wonderful if it existed everywhere.
Describes a guru who has passed away, yet satsang is held with his photo, and calls it beautiful that fifty people meet and share.

hindi: बात समझ के इसका कांसेप्ट कितना स्ट्रांग है मल्टीप्लिकेटिव
says: He asks you to see how strong the concept of multiplication is: when a group meets and shares onward, what each gets is multiplied. Sharing in a gathering is presented as the mechanism of multiplied grace.
ambiguity: The sentence continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शिष्य जो कर रहे हैं वो अपने अंदर का गुरु इवोक कर रहे हैं उस गुरु की कृपा यही बहुत है
says: What the disciples do in such a gathering is to evoke the guru within themselves, and the grace of that inner guru is enough. The photo of a departed teacher works as a prompt for awakening one's own inner teacher.
ambiguity: He does not name Jupiter here; I added it because he ties guru to Jupiter earlier.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says the guru has done this favour and he bows to him.
Last question: about house number 15 in Khari Baoli, a Jain Agrawal family who had a guru's photo hung, from the year 1999.
Story: told to come at 5:30 in the morning to an ashram that was earlier in Loni, from which food rations are sent out.
Says the guru is only a medium and what you do is the rocket; where it goes is not known.
Garbled fragments about a property and what to do with it; cannot be made out.
Garbled fragment ending with 'keep taking, keep looting'.
Question: Ketu is number 12, so is Ketu in sign number 12 more effective or Ketu in the 12th house; confusion between house and sign.

hindi: 12 नंबर का केतु सारी कुंडली में किसी भी भाव में आ सकता है
says: Ketu in sign number 12 (Pisces) can fall in any house of the chart, depending on the lagna. So the sign and the house are separate things and both must be checked.
cells_derived_method: For Ketu in Pisces the house changes with the lagna and so does the reading: the house gives the area of life and the sign gives the style of the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 1st (Pisces lagna). Detachment and spiritual tilt on the self.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra, since 12 minus 6 plus 1 = 7). Detachment in the enemy and debt house, often read as helping against opponents.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini, since 12 minus 10 plus 1 = 3). Detachment from career and status, spiritual or behind-the-scenes work.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर का केतु' means sign 12 here, since he then asks about the house separately.
classical_check: Agrees with standard practice: sign and house are two coordinates of a placement.

hindi: 12वें भाव में अगर केतु बैठा है तो किस राशि का बैठा है ये अलग काउंट करेगा क्योंकि 12वें भाव में केतु कैसा फल दे रहा है बहुत अच्छा लेकिन केतु किस राशि का है वैसा वाला फल देगा बीमार भी कर सकता है प्लस भी माइनस भी
says: Ketu in the 12th house gives very good results by house, but the sign it sits in counts separately and colours the result, so it can also go bad, plus or minus. The house gives the base and the sign shifts it; the illness remark is his tradition-claim colour, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The 12th house is good for Ketu; the sign decides the modification by the sign lord's friendship with Ketu and the sign's nature (fire, water, etc.). The lagna follows from sign minus house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries). Own-type water sign in the 12th, where he calls Ketu especially good; spiritual loss of attachments.
Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius, since 8 minus 12 plus 1 = -3 which is 9). Mars-ruled sign, intense and secretive; the same house with a sharper result.
Derived: Ketu in Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo, since 4 minus 12 plus 1 = -7 which is 5). Moon-ruled sign; emotional detachment, with sleep and foreign themes mixed.

ambiguity: 'बहुत अच्छा' might refer to the house alone or to Ketu in the 12th in general; I read it as the house result before the sign modification.
classical_check: Classical texts name Ketu in the 12th as favourable for moksha; the sign-modifies-house idea is general practice.

hindi: वैसे 12वां भाव केतु का काल पुरुष की कुंडली में अपना ही घर है
says: In the natural zodiac chart (Kaal Purush, Aries as first house) the 12th house is Ketu's own home. Pisces, the 12th sign there, is treated as Ketu's seat, which is why Ketu behaves well in it.
ambiguity: In his scheme Pisces is ruled by Jupiter or Ketu; here he picks Ketu.
classical_check: Differs from the standard rule, which gives Pisces to Jupiter; some authors assign Ketu to Pisces or Scorpio as a secondary lordship.

gist: Says this is the last chart question; further questions will be stopped since he has no more notes.

hindi: यह लाल किताब में यह चीज का प्रिंसिपल चलता है लाल किताब में भाव भी फिक्स है
says: The principle of reading a fixed number is used in the Lal Kitab, where the houses are fixed as well. So a number in this system means a fixed house with its own fixed sign.
ambiguity: The sentence runs on to the next chunk and the word 'काल' there starts 'Kaal Purush'.
classical_check: Agrees: the Lal Kitab uses a fixed house-to-sign layout in which Aries is always the first house.

hindi: पुरुष में भी भाव फिक्स है कोई लेनन राशि का भाड़ में जा
says: In the Kaal Purush chart too the houses are fixed in the same way, so the sign of the actual horoscope has no bearing on that fixed reading. He sets aside the personal sign for this method.
ambiguity: 'कोई लेनन' is garbled and probably means 'कोई लेना देना'.
classical_check: Kaal Purush assigns Aries to the 1st house through Pisces to the 12th; this agrees.

hindi: तो यह पहला है य एक नंबर जो है यह एक ही नंबर है यह एक है दो है तीन तो एक नंबर है ही मंगल का बात ही खत्म
says: In the fixed scheme number 1 is simply Mars's, and the matter ends there; it is the first place and no further sign test is needed for it.
ambiguity: Whether 'एक नंबर' means house 1 or sign 1 is not clear, but in the fixed scheme they coincide as Aries.
classical_check: Agrees: in the natural zodiac the first house is Aries, ruled by Mars.

hindi: यह है ही शुक्र का किसी भी राशि का हो कोई लेना देना ही नहीं है
says: The next place in the fixed scheme belongs to Venus whatever sign is actually there, with no link to the actual sign. The caption does not give its number, so the second house is the likely target.
ambiguity: He does not say the number; 'यह' follows house 1 so house 2 (Taurus) is assumed. The 7th (Libra) is also Venus's but is not the next one.
classical_check: Agrees with Kaal Purush: 2nd house is Taurus, ruled by Venus.

hindi: यह केतु 12 नंबर का केतु बहुत बढ़िया है 12 नंबर का केतु कहीं भी मीन राशि का है बहुत बढ़िया है
says: Ketu at number 12 is very good, and Ketu in Pisces is very good wherever it sits in the chart. So both the fixed 12th place and the Pisces sign are favourable for Ketu.
cells_derived_method: The sign is good for Ketu in any house, but the house decides which area of life gets the detachment or spiritual effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius, since 12 minus 4 plus 1 = 9). Detachment from home and mother, with a spiritual home life.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo, since 12 minus 7 plus 1 = 6). Detachment in partnership, a spiritual or distant spouse.
Derived: Ketu in Libra in the 12th (lagna Scorpio, since 7 minus 12 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). House is favourable but the sign is not Pisces, so only the house part applies.

ambiguity: He contrasts here the 12th-number and the Pisces sign as both good; he does not combine them.
classical_check: Classics give Ketu in the 12th as favourable; Ketu in Pisces is not singled out as good in standard texts, so that part is his own.

hindi: लेकिन इसकी दृष्टियां काउंट करती है 12 नंबर का केतु तीन नंबर की दृष्टियां देगा नेगेटिव है
says: Ketu's aspects also count: Ketu at 12 will throw the aspect of number 3, which is a negative one. So the good result from Ketu's seat is offset by what it aspects.
cells_derived_method: The house or sign that receives the aspect carries the Ketu effect, so the result depends on what the 3rd position holds in the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the 3rd place is Gemini (Aries lagna), Ketu's aspect there affects effort, courage and siblings.
Derived: if the 3rd place is Sagittarius (lagna Libra, since 9 minus 3 plus 1 = 7), the aspect falls on effort and writing with a Jupiter-ruled sign.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर की दृष्टि' could mean the 3rd house, the 3rd sign (Gemini) or an aspect count; no standard aspect of Ketu from the 12th falls on house 3 by 5, 7, 9 counting, so I could not confirm.
classical_check: Classical texts give Rahu and Ketu the 5th, 7th and 9th aspects in some schools; from the 12th those are the 4th, 6th and 8th, not the 3rd, so this differs.

hindi: लेकिन यह नेगेटिव ही एरिया है तीन नंबर नछ आ 12 नेगेटिव है
says: He defines the numbers 3, 6, 8 and 12 as the negative areas of the chart. These are the places where difficulties live in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Each of these houses is read as a trouble area: 3 for effort and conflict, 6 for enemies and disease, 8 for sudden change and obstruction, 12 for loss and expense.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 3rd with Gemini (Aries lagna) is the effort house, a mild negative.
Derived: the 8th with Scorpio (lagna Aries, since 8 minus 8 plus 1 = 1) is the obstruction and sudden-change house, the strongest negative.
Derived: the 12th with Capricorn (lagna Aquarius, since 10 minus 12 plus 1 = -1 which is 11). The loss house.

ambiguity: The caption reads 'नछ आ 12'; I read it as 6, 8, 12 matching his earlier '6 आ 12'. The 3 comes from 'तीन नंबर' just before.
classical_check: The classical dusthanas are 6, 8, 12; the 3rd is an upachaya and sometimes counted as a trouble house, so adding 3 is a variation.

hindi: नेगेटिव में नेगेटिव होगा और अच्छा करेगा
says: A negative planet in a negative house will turn out to do good, since negative on negative cancels. A malefic placed in one of the trouble houses is claimed to give favourable results.
cells_derived_method: For a malefic in 3, 6, 8 or 12 the benefit comes in the matters of that house: enemies defeated in the 6th, hidden gains in the 8th, spiritual release in the 12th, courage in the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio, since 1 minus 6 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). Saturn is debilitated, so this reading is weaker.
Derived: Rahu in Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo, since 12 minus 8 plus 1 = 5). A malefic in the obstruction house might give hidden gains.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius, since 8 minus 12 plus 1 = -3 which is 9). Strong malefic in the loss house, read as a gain through expenses.

ambiguity: He does not say which planets count as negative; I assume the usual malefics.
classical_check: Agrees with the viparita idea that dusthana lords in dusthanas give good results, and with the saying that malefics do well in the 3rd, 6th and 11th; differs where he applies it to all malefics in the 8th and 12th.

gist: Says this mess is what makes astrology very complex.

hindi: केतु अलग तरह से बिहेव करेगा मंगल अलग करेगा बुध अलग करेगा राहु अलग करेगा
says: Ketu, Mars, Mercury and Rahu each behave in their own way in the same house or sign, so the same placement cannot be read with one rule across planets. Each planet needs its own reading.
cells_derived_method: The same cell is read separately for each planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the 10th with Aries (lagna Cancer, since 1 minus 10 plus 1 = -8 which is 4). Mars there is in own sign and strong, while Ketu or Rahu in the same cell act as outsiders.
Derived: in the 12th with Virgo (lagna Libra, since 6 minus 12 plus 1 = -5 which is 7). Mercury there is exalted but in the loss house, while Ketu would behave as detached.

classical_check: Agrees with the standard use of planet-specific karakas.

gist: Says there is no single principle, each one is a principle of its own, and this is the complication.

hindi: इसके अंदर ये कालय लाल किताब के अनुसार चलता है ये राशि फिक्स है
says: This fixed arrangement follows the Kaal Purush and Lal Kitab pattern, in which the sign of each house is fixed. He ties the fixed house-sign layout to those two systems.
ambiguity: 'कालय' is garbled, probably 'काल पुरुष'.
classical_check: Agrees: both systems use a fixed Aries-to-Pisces layout.

hindi: हालांकि लाल किताब वगैरह या किसी भी फिक्स में वरुण इंद्र के यम का स्यापा डाला ही नहीं हुआ घोल मोल खत्म
says: The Lal Kitab and other fixed schemes never included Varun (Neptune), Indra (Uranus) and Yama (Pluto), so the picture is incomplete and mixed up. He favours a scheme that includes the three outer planets.
ambiguity: 'घोल मोल खत्म' is slang for a jumble or a finished mess; the sense is that the system is muddled.
classical_check: Agrees that classical Jyotish and the Lal Kitab use the seven planets plus Rahu and Ketu; the outer planets are his addition.

hindi: राहु केतो की भी भयंकर कंफ्यूजन है
says: There is also terrible confusion about Rahu and Ketu, such as which signs they own, exalt or are placed well in. Different authors give different answers.
ambiguity: He does not say which points are confused; the examples given earlier were sign lordship and dignity.
classical_check: Agrees: texts differ on Rahu and Ketu's own and exaltation signs.

hindi: सात ही ग्रहों की अक्सर बात होती है
says: Usually only seven planets are talked about, meaning the Sun to Saturn, and the other points and planets are left out of common discussion.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts mainly use the seven visible planets plus the two nodes.
